blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Transformer replaced sequential recurrent propagation with self-attention, allowing each token to aggregate contextual information through direct, content-dependent interactions [ 161 ] . This mechanism enabled highly parallel training and established the computational foundation of modern large language models (LLMs) [ 16 ] . Its explicit representation of preceding tokens provides fine-grained, query-dependent access to context and supports in-context learning, long-range dependency modeling, and flexible reuse of information within a sequence. The same interaction pattern, however, creates the principal scaling limitations of dense attention. During prefill, the number of query-key comparisons grows quadratically with sequence length; during autoregressive decoding, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the accumulated context. Moreover, a longer nominal context window does not by itself ensure reliable use of distant evidence: an expanding candidate set can increase retrieval interference and weaken long-range recall [ 11 , 63 ] . These limitations have driven the evolution of attention along several interacting architectural directions, including approaches that store token memories more compactly, consult only selected past positions, carry context in recurrent states, structure how those states evolve, and combine different mechanisms within one model.
blocks.zh: " 变形器 " 以自觉取代了相继的经常性传播,使每个信使能够通过直接的、与内容相依的相互作用来汇总背景信息[161]。 这一机制使培训得以高度平行,并为现代大语言模型建立了计算基础[16]。 它对前作的清晰表述提供了精细的,依赖查询的上下文访问,并支持内文学习,远程依赖模型化,在一个序列中灵活地再利用信息. 然而,同样的相互作用模式造成了密集关注的主要规模限制。 在预填时,查询-键比较的数量会与序列长度成四倍地增长;在自旋解码时,键值(KV)缓存会随累积上下文而线性地增长. 此外,较长的名义上下文窗口本身并不能确保可靠地使用远方证据:扩大的候选组合可以增加检索干扰并削弱远程召回[11,63]. 这些限制促使人们沿着一些相互作用的建筑方向逐步关注,包括更紧凑地存储象征记忆的方法,只参考某些过去的立场,反复出现的情况,这些状态如何演变的结构,以及在一个模式内结合不同的机制。

blocks.en: We organize this literature into four mechanism-centered research lines and one composition-centered line 1 1 1 In this survey, Softmax Attention , Sparse Attention , Linear Attention , and State Space Models denote the four mechanism-centered research lines, while Hybrid Architecture denotes the composition-centered line. Other lowercase attention terms describe particular operators, access patterns, layers, heads, or paths rather than survey-level categories. Established method names retain their original capitalization. : • Softmax Attention stores context in an enumerable collection of memory units, such as token KVs, latent entries, or summaries, and retrieves from them through normalized query–key weights [ 161 , 30 , 26 ] . Recent variants share or compress these units across heads, layers, or time [ 142 , 2 , 15 ] . This reduces KV storage and data movement while preserving content-dependent retrieval, although cost still grows with the number and size of retained units. • Sparse Attention keeps explicit content memory but lets each query consult only a subset of the available tokens or blocks [ 14 , 186 , 182 ] . Selection ranges from fixed patterns to learned or compressed indexes [ 128 , 64 ] , with some decisions reused across layers [ 10 , 187 ] . This reduces score computation and memory traffic, but its effectiveness depends on retaining the evidence relevant to each query. • Linear Attention folds the preceding context into one or more recurrent associative states rather than keeping a growing list of token memories [ 74 ] . Later work improves how these states retain and revise information [ 148 , 140 , 177 ] or expands their capacity and temporal coverage [ 121 , 18 , 60 , 163 ] . This avoids a token-growing KV cache during decoding, but individual past tokens are no longer directly retrievable. • State Space Models also carry context in recurrent states, but derive their updates from structured dynamical systems rather than an associative reformulation of attention. Their structured and input-dependent transitions seek to combine parallelizable training with bounded-state recurrent decoding. As with other compressed-state designs, individual past tokens are not preserved as separate retrievable entries [ 56 , 55 , 28 ] . • Hybrid Architecture retains context through combinations of explicit, sparse, linear, and state-space paths placed across layers, heads, branches, or tokens. They distribute fine-grained token retrieval, local modeling, compressed long-term memory, and computation across different parts of a model. This provides complementary capabilities within one architecture, while introducing additional placement, routing, and coordination decisions [ 85 , 39 , 113 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们把这个文献组织成四条以机制为中心的研究线和一条以成分为中心的11号线 在本次调查中,Softmax 注意,Sparse 注意,线性注意,州空间模型表示四条以机制为中心的研究线,而混合建筑则表示以成分为中心的线. 其他小写注意术语描述特定的运算符,访问模式,层,头,或路径,而不是调查级别类别. 既定方法名称保留原资本化。 二. 支助 Softmax Content将上下文存储在可假设的内存单元集合中,例如令牌 KV,潜入条目,或摘要,并通过正常查询-键重取出 [161, 30, 26]. 最近的变体在头,地层或时间上共享或压缩这些单位[142,2,15]. 这减少了KV存储和数据移动,同时保留了依赖内容的检索,尽管随着保留单位的数量和规模,成本仍然会增加. · Sparse Reference 保留了明确的内容内存,但让每个查询只查询一个子集的可使用符号或块[14, 186, 182]. 选择范围从固定模式到学到的或压缩的指数[128,64],有些决定可跨层重复使用[10,187]。 这降低了分数计算和内存流量,但其有效性取决于保留与每个查询相关的证据. • 线性注意将前述内容折叠为一个或多个反复出现的关联状态,而不是保留越来越多的象征记忆[74]。 后来的工作改善了这些国家如何保留和修订资料[148、140、177]或扩大其能力和时间覆盖面[121、18、60、163]。 这避免了在解码过程中出现一个正兆增长的 KV 缓存,但单个过去的正兆已经无法直接取回. • 国家空间模型也经常出现这种情况,但从结构化动态系统而不是从对注意力的关联性重构中获取其更新。 它们的结构化和投入依赖型的过渡设法将平行培训与有界状态的经常性解码相结合。 和其他压缩态设计一样,单个过去的活符无法作为单独的可检索条目保存 [56, 55, 28]. ^ Hybrid Architecture保留了上下文,通过放置在地层,头,分支,或活符之间的明确,稀疏,线性,和状态-空间路径的组合. 它们分配精细的纹章检索,局部建模,压缩长期内存,并跨模型的不同部分进行计算. 这在一个架构内提供了互补能力,同时引入了额外的安置、路由和协调决定[85、39、113、40]。

blocks.en: These categories are intentionally not a mutually exclusive partition. Most sparse mechanisms, for example, still apply Softmax after selecting a subset of keys; linear or state-space modules may also use selective operations; and Hybrid Architectures may contain members of every other line. We therefore place each method in the chapter that best matches its principal technical contribution and lineage.
blocks.zh: 这些类别并非故意相互排斥。 例如,大多数稀有的机制在选择一个密钥子集后仍然应用Softmax;线性或状态-空间模块也可能使用选择性操作;而Hybrid Architectures可能包含每个其它行的成员. 因此,我们将每一种方法放在最符合其主要技术贡献和血统的一章中。

blocks.en: Prior surveys offer several complementary ways to navigate this rapidly expanding literature. General Transformer surveys organize architectural variants and applications, while efficient-Transformer surveys emphasize computational patterns, approximation strategies, and complexity [ 86 , 154 ] . Long-context surveys examine context extension, length extrapolation, training strategies, retrieval, and application settings [ 65 , 164 , 89 ] . More specialized reviews provide detailed treatments of efficient sparse and linear attention [ 149 ] , state space models [ 122 ] , and KV-cache management and compression [ 80 ] . More recently, an architecture-centric memory survey organizes LLM memory along representation form, update dynamics, and persistence, covering a broader range of implicit and explicit memory mechanisms beyond attention [ 193 ] . Table 1 summarizes the primary organizing principles of these complementary survey perspectives.
blocks.zh: 以前的调查为浏览这种迅速扩展的文献提供了几种补充方式。 一般变形人调查组织建筑变体和应用,而高效变形人调查则强调计算规律,近似策略,和复杂性[86,154]. 长文调查审查上下文延伸、长度外推、培训战略、检索和应用设置[65、164、89]。 更专业的回顾提供了高效的稀有和线性关注[149],状态空间模型[122],和KV-cache管理和压缩[80]的详细处理. 最近,一个以架构为中心的记忆调查沿着表现形式组织LLM记忆,更新动态和持久性,涵盖范围更广的隐含而明确的记忆机制,超出关注范围[193]. 表1概述了这些补充调查前景的主要组织原则。

blocks.en: Table 1: Representative survey perspectives relevant to this work and their primary organizing principles. The table summarizes the dominant perspective of each survey category rather than its complete coverage.
blocks.zh: 表1:与这项工作及其主要组织原则有关的代表性调查观点。 该表总结了每个调查类别的主导观点,而不是其全部覆盖面。

blocks.en: Taken together, these surveys provide complementary architecture-, efficiency-, context-, state-, cache-, and memory-centered views of the field. In comparison with broader memory-centered surveys, this survey focuses specifically on attention and adjacent sequence mixers. We adopt contextual memory as a shared unit of analysis and examine these mechanisms through five analytical dimensions : Memory Representation , Memory Update , Access , Readout , and Integration . In brief, they ask what historical information remains represented, how the represented memory changes, what is made eligible for the current query, how eligible memory is read, and how one or more completed readouts are transformed or coordinated into the module output. The five dimensions and the chapter-level research lines serve different purposes: the chapter labels provide a readable historical and technical organization, whereas the analytical dimensions provide a multi-label description of the functions modified by an individual method. This lens thereby complements classifications based on architectural lineage, computational complexity, or application setting.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些调查提供了互补的架构,效率,上下文,状态,缓存,以及以内存为中心的领域观点. 与更广泛的以记忆为中心的调查相比,这次调查特别侧重于注意和相邻的序列混合器. 我们采用背景记忆作为共同的分析单位,并通过五个分析层面审查这些机制: 记忆代表 记忆更新 访问 读取 和整合 . 简言之,他们询问哪些历史信息仍然代表着什么,代表的内存的变化如何,使哪些内容符合当前查询的条件,符合条件的内存是如何被读取的,以及完成的一个或多个读取是如何转换或协调成模块输出的. 五维和分章级研究行服务于不同的目的:分章标签提供了可读的历史和技术组织,而分析维则提供了由单个方法修改的功能的多标签描述. 这个镜头从而补充了基于建筑学行法,计算复杂性,或应用设置的分类.

blocks.en: This survey focuses on model-level mechanisms used by autoregressive LLMs and closely related causal sequence mixers, with model-internal contextual memory as the shared unit of analysis. We cover representative work publicly available through September 22, 2026, identified through targeted literature searches, relevant prior surveys, backward and forward citation tracing, and primary technical documentation. The coverage is structured but not intended as an exhaustive systematic review: we emphasize foundational methods, major architectural transitions, and representative extensions that clarify recurring design choices across Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration. Test-time learning, retrieval from external databases, multimodal-specific memory designs, and implementation-only optimizations remain outside the core taxonomy unless they directly alter the model’s contextual-memory semantics.
blocks.zh: 本调查侧重于自递回式LLMS和密切相关的因果序列搅拌器所使用的模型级机制,以模型-内部背景内存为共享分析单元. 我们涵盖到2026年9月22日公开提供的代表性工作,通过有针对性的文献搜索、相关的前期调查、前后引文追踪和主要技术文件确定。 我们强调基础方法、重大建筑过渡和代表性扩展,这些扩展澄清了记忆代表、记忆更新、访问、读取和整合等反复出现的设计选择。 测试时间的学习,从外部数据库取回,多模式特定的内存设计,以及只执行的优化,除非它们直接改变模型的上下文语义,否则仍然处于核心分类之外.

blocks.en: At the architecture level, the mechanism review is complemented by a curated longitudinal inventory of publicly documented model releases and a frozen comparison of high-performing open-weight model endpoints, both closed on September 22, 2026. The inventory is based primarily on official papers, technical reports, model cards, and released configurations. Models released together are grouped when they share the same language-model attention backbone, whereas separately released versions or documented changes to that backbone form separate records. Records with insufficient architectural disclosure are marked as undisclosed rather than inferred. Natively multimodal models are included only when the relevant autoregressive language backbone is documented; visual encoders, modality interfaces, and other modality-specific components are excluded from the classification. The inventory is purposively curated rather than exhaustive or market-share weighted, and the inventory and frontier comparison are used to characterize documented adoption and coexistence rather than to attribute model quality causally to an attention mechanism.
blocks.zh: 在架构层面,机制审查得到一份公开记录的模型发布内容的纵向目录和高性能开放量模型端点的冻结比较的补充,两者均于2026年9月22日关闭. 清册主要以公文,技术报告,模版卡,发布配置为主. 共同发布的模型在共享相同的语言-模型关注主干时被分组,而单独发布的版本或记录中对该主干构成单独记录的修改. 建筑披露不充分的记录被标为未披露而非推断. 本土多模式模式只有在相关自相递回语言主干被记录下来时才会被纳入;可视化编码器,模式界面,以及其他模式特定组件被排除在分类之外. 清单是有目的的,而不是详尽无遗的或市场份额加权的,清单和前沿比较被用来描述有文件记载的收养和共存的特点,而不是将模型质量因果归属于关注机制。

blocks.en: The principal contributions of this survey are fourfold: 1. We introduce a five-dimensional analytical lens—Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration—for comparing how sequence mechanisms retain and use contextual memory. It provides a common vocabulary for Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, State Space Models, and Hybrid Architectures without reducing them to one computational model. 2. We reconstruct the development of Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, and State Space Models by examining how their representative methods intervene in Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration, while preserving overlaps among these historically defined research lines. 3. We connect mechanism-level developments with two complementary analyses of publicly documented LLM architectures. A longitudinal inventory of 59 release-level records spanning 14 major model lineages traces the diversification of attention design, the growing use of layer-wise hybrid composition, and the emergence of cross-layer artifact reuse. A frozen comparison of 11 high-performing open-weight model endpoints provides a cross-sectional view of the attention structures represented near the performance frontier. Together, these analyses show continued architectural heterogeneity and the persistent role of explicit token retrieval in contemporary high-performing models. 4. We develop a three-level memory-centric synthesis of the surveyed literature. At the mechanism level, explicit-memory and state-based methods retain different memory interfaces while expanding design control across an increasingly overlapping set of memory functions. At the architecture level, layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse extends the lifetime of selected memory and routing artifacts across those stages. Together, these developments make network depth an emerging dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. At the forward-looking level, this depth-wise perspective combines with temporal scope, substrate type, and representation granularity to motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis governed by coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read.
blocks.zh: 这项调查的主要贡献有四: 1. 我们采用了五维分析镜头——记忆表现、记忆更新、访问、读取和整合,以比较序列机制如何保留和使用背景记忆。 它为Softmax Content, Sparse Content, Linear Content, State Space Models, 和混合结构提供了共同的词汇,而不将其降低为一个计算模型. 2. 我们重建Softmax Records、Sparse Records、Linear Records和State Space Models的发展,方法是审查它们的代表性方法如何干预记忆表达、记忆更新、访问、读取和整合,同时保留这些历史界定的研究线之间的重叠。 3. 我们把机制一级的事态发展同对公开记录的LLM架构的两项补充分析联系起来。 横跨14个主要模型线的59个释放层记录的纵向清点可以追溯到注意力设计多样化,层相相混合成分的日益被使用,并出现了跨层文物再利用. 冷冻地比较了11个高性能的开量模型端点,提供了对表现前沿附近所代表的关注结构的截面观察. 这些分析加在一起表明,建筑结构仍然不均匀,在当代高性能模型中,明确符号检索的持续作用。 4. 我们制定了以记忆为中心的三级综合调查文献。 在机制层面,清晰的记忆和基于状态的方法保留了不同的内存接口,同时将设计控制扩展至日益重叠的一套内存功能. 在建筑层面,分层构成在整个代表阶段分配互补的内存处理,而跨层再利用则延长了选定内存的寿命并贯穿这些阶段。 这些发展共同使网络深度成为一个新兴维度,据此构建和管理背景记忆。 在前瞻层面,这种有深度的视角结合了时间范围,底物类型,和表现颗粒性,以激励一种由协调的Sparse Write和Sparse Read所规范的状态多维内存-路由假说.

blocks.en: We introduce a five-dimensional analytical lens—Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration—for comparing how sequence mechanisms retain and use contextual memory. It provides a common vocabulary for Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, State Space Models, and Hybrid Architectures without reducing them to one computational model.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了五维分析镜头——记忆代表、记忆更新、访问、读取和整合——用于比较序列机制如何保留和使用背景记忆。 它为Softmax Note, Sparse Note, Linear Note, State Space Models, 和混合结构提供了通用的词汇,而不将其简化为一个计算模型.

blocks.en: We reconstruct the development of Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, and State Space Models by examining how their representative methods intervene in Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration, while preserving overlaps among these historically defined research lines.
blocks.zh: 我们重建Softmax 注意、Sparse 注意、线性注意和州空间模型的发展,方法是审查它们的代表性方法如何干预记忆代表、记忆更新、访问、读取和融合,同时保留这些历史界定的研究线之间的重叠。

blocks.en: We connect mechanism-level developments with two complementary analyses of publicly documented LLM architectures. A longitudinal inventory of 59 release-level records spanning 14 major model lineages traces the diversification of attention design, the growing use of layer-wise hybrid composition, and the emergence of cross-layer artifact reuse. A frozen comparison of 11 high-performing open-weight model endpoints provides a cross-sectional view of the attention structures represented near the performance frontier. Together, these analyses show continued architectural heterogeneity and the persistent role of explicit token retrieval in contemporary high-performing models.
blocks.zh: 我们把机制一级的事态发展与对公开记录的LLM结构的两项补充分析联系起来。 横跨14个主要模型线的59个释放层记录的纵向清点可以追溯到注意力设计多样化,层相相混合成分的日益被使用,并出现了跨层文物再利用. 冷冻地比较了11个高性能的开量模型端点,提供了对表现前沿附近所代表的关注结构的截面观察. 这些分析加在一起表明,建筑结构仍然不均匀,在当代高性能模型中,明确符号检索的持续作用。

blocks.en: We develop a three-level memory-centric synthesis of the surveyed literature. At the mechanism level, explicit-memory and state-based methods retain different memory interfaces while expanding design control across an increasingly overlapping set of memory functions. At the architecture level, layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse extends the lifetime of selected memory and routing artifacts across those stages. Together, these developments make network depth an emerging dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. At the forward-looking level, this depth-wise perspective combines with temporal scope, substrate type, and representation granularity to motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis governed by coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一套以记忆为中心的三级综合调查文献。 在机制层面,清晰的记忆和基于状态的方法保留了不同的内存接口,同时将设计控制扩展至日益重叠的一套内存功能. 在建筑层面,分层构成在整个代表阶段分配互补的内存处理,而跨层再利用则延长了选定内存的寿命并贯穿这些阶段。 这些发展共同使网络深度成为一个新兴维度,据此构建和管理背景记忆。 在前瞻性层面,这种深度视角结合了时间范围,底物类型,和表现颗粒性,以激励由协调的Sparse Write和Sparse Read所规范的状态多维内存-路由假说.

blocks.en: The remainder of this survey is organized as follows. Section 2 introduces the memory-centric analytical lens and its classification principles. Sections 3 - 6 examine Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, and State Space Models, respectively. Section 7 analyzes the composition of heterogeneous memory mechanisms across layers, heads, branches, and tokens. Section 8 examines architectural evolution and coordination through a longitudinal model inventory and a frozen comparison of high-performing open-weight models. Section 9 develops the mechanism-level and architecture-level syntheses and introduces the forward-looking multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis. Finally, Section 10 concludes the survey.
blocks.zh: 本次调查的其余部分如下: 第二节介绍了以记忆为中心的分析镜头及其分类原则. 第3至6节分别审查了Softmax注意力、Sparse注意力、线性注意力和州空间模型。 第7节分析了不同层次、头部、分支和象征的不同记忆机制的构成。 第8节通过纵向模型清单和高性能开放量模型的冻结比较,审查建筑的演变和协调。 第9节发展出机制层面和架构层面的综合,并引入了前瞻性多维记忆-路由假设. 最后,第10节结束了调查。

blocks.en: 2 A Unified Memory-Centric View of Attention
blocks.zh: 2 统一记忆-儿科 注意视图

blocks.en: When a model processes a token, it must make information from the preceding context available to the current computation. Different sequence architectures do this in visibly different ways. Softmax Attention retains separately addressable memory units; Sparse Attention limits which of those units are examined; and recurrent mechanisms continually compress the preceding context into one or more states. Looking only at these surface-level operators makes the families appear difficult to compare. At a functional level, however, each can be viewed as a system that maintains and uses internal memory while processing a sequence.
blocks.zh: 当一个模型处理一个符号时,它必须把来自前上下文的信息提供给目前的计算. 不同的顺序结构以明显不同的方式做到这一点。 Softmax Records保留单独的可地址存储单元; Sparse Records 限制其中哪些单元被检查; 经常性机制不断将上下文压缩为一个或多个状态. 仅仅看这些地表操作员,家庭似乎难以比较。 然而,在功能层面,可以将每个系统视为一个在处理一个序列时维护和使用内部内存的系统.

blocks.en: This memory-oriented interpretation is already present in several lines of research. Prior work has described linear attention as associative or fast-weight memory, related attention and state-space recurrences through their memory structure, and studied compressive, bounded, or growing recurrent memories [ 74 , 28 , 113 , 73 , 72 , 12 ] . Building on this shared perspective, we use contextual memory as a common term for the model-internal, input-dependent information that remains available while a sequence is being processed. Depending on the architecture, that information may take the form of token KV representations, compressed tokens or chunks, memory slots, associative matrices, structured recurrent states, or heterogeneous combinations of these forms. The term does not refer to the model’s pretrained parameters, an external retrieval corpus, or biological memory.
blocks.zh: 这种面向记忆的解释已经存在于多行研究中. 先前的工作将线性关注描述为关联或快重记忆,相关关注和状态-空间通过记忆结构的重现,并研究了压缩,受约束,或不断增长的重复记忆[74,28,113,73,72,12]. 基于这一共同的观点,我们使用背景内存作为模式-内部、投入依赖信息的共同术语,在处理一个序列时仍然可用。 根据架构的不同,该信息可能采取符号KV表示,压缩表示或块,内存插槽,关联矩阵,结构式常态,或这些形式的不同组合等形式. 该词不指模型的先入为主的参数、外部检索程序或生物记忆。

blocks.en: Once these mechanisms are viewed in terms of contextual memory, their design differences can be organized around five questions: 1. Memory Representation: What information from the past is still represented, and in what form? 2. Memory Update: How does the current input add to, modify, compress, or overwrite that memory? 3. Access: Which represented information is eligible to be used for the current query? 4. Readout: How is the eligible information weighted, decoded, or aggregated? 5. Integration: How are one or more completed readouts transformed or combined into the module output? These questions form the analytical lens used throughout this survey. They describe functional roles rather than five components that every architecture must implement separately. A single operation may perform several roles at once, and the roles need not appear as a fixed sequence of implementation stages. Figure 1 provides an architectural primer for this view: it illustrates the five dimensions through representative memory operations and maps them onto example Linear Attention and Sparse Attention blocks within a schematic layer-wise hybrid model. The concrete operations and block arrangement are illustrative rather than universal; the roles are defined formally below.
blocks.zh: 一旦从背景记忆的角度看待这些机制,它们的设计差异就可以围绕五个问题来安排: 1. 记忆代表: 从过去得到的哪些信息仍以何种形式存在? 2. 记忆最新情况: 当前输入如何增加、修改、压缩或覆盖内存? 3. 访问:哪些资料有资格用于当前查询? 4. 读出: 合格信息如何加权、解码或汇总? 5. 一体化: 一个或多个完成的读取是如何转换或合并成模块输出的? 这些问题构成了本次调查中所用的分析镜头. 它们描述了职能作用,而不是每个架构必须分别执行的五个组成部分。 单一行动可以同时发挥几个作用,这些作用不需要作为固定的执行阶段的顺序出现. 图1为这个观点提供了一个建筑入门:它通过代表性的内存操作来说明这五个维度,并将它们映射到一个图层相向的混合模型中的例子Linear 注意和Sparse 注意块上. 具体行动和块状安排是说明性的,而不是普遍性的;下文正式界定了作用。

blocks.en: Memory Representation: What information from the past is still represented, and in what form?
blocks.zh: 内存代表: 从过去得到的哪些信息仍以何种形式存在?

blocks.en: Memory Update: How does the current input add to, modify, compress, or overwrite that memory?
blocks.zh: 内存更新 : 当前输入如何增加、修改、压缩或覆盖内存?

blocks.en: Access: Which represented information is eligible to be used for the current query?
blocks.zh: 访问: 哪些代表的信息有资格用于当前查询?

blocks.en: Readout: How is the eligible information weighted, decoded, or aggregated?
blocks.zh: 读出 : 合格信息如何加权、解码或汇总?

blocks.en: Integration: How are one or more completed readouts transformed or combined into the module output?
blocks.zh: 一体化: 一个或多个完成的读取是如何转换或合并成模块输出的?

blocks.en: Figure 1: An architectural primer for the five-dimensional memory-centric view. The left panel illustrates Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration through typical explicit-memory and recurrent-state operations. The center and right panels map these dimensions onto representative Linear Attention and Sparse Attention blocks, respectively, while the top row places the two mechanisms in a schematic layer-wise hybrid model. In the Linear Attention example, a delta-style update maintains a fixed-size recurrent state that is read through state contraction; in the Sparse Attention example, candidate selection restricts access to a token KV cache before the core attention readout. Gates and output projections illustrate Integration. The displayed update rule, gates, and block ratio are representative design choices rather than universal properties of these families, and the colored labels denote analytical roles rather than a mandatory execution sequence.
blocks.zh: 图 1:五维内存-以景为主的建筑入门. 左侧面板通过典型的明镜和常态操作来显示内存表现,内存更新,访问,读出和整合. 中央和右面板分别将这两个维度映射到具有代表性的线性注意和Sparse Content块上,而上行将这两个机制放入一个图层相向的混合模型中. 在"Linear Content"的例子中,一个delta风格的更新保持了通过状态收缩读取的固定大小的经常性状态;在"Sparse Content"的例子中,候选人选择在核心注意力读取出之前限制对一个符号KV缓存的访问. 盖茨和产出预测说明了一体化。 所显示的更新规则,闸门,和块比是具有代表性的设计选择,而不是这些家族的通用属性,有色标签表示分析角色而不是强制执行序列.

blocks.en: 2.1 Five Analytical Dimensions
blocks.zh: 2.1 五个分析层面

blocks.en: We now formalize the five questions one at a time. As a running setting, suppose that a model has processed the first t − 1 t-1 tokens of a document and is processing token t t . It may retain every preceding token as a separate KV entry, retain only selected or compressed entries, or carry the preceding context in a fixed-size recurrent state. Let x t x_{t} denote the current input to the memory mechanism, and let q t q_{t} denote the representation used to request information relevant to the current position.
blocks.zh: 我们现在一次正式确定五个问题。 作为运行的设置,假设一个模型已经处理过文件的第一个 t − 1 t 1 个令牌,并且正在处理令牌 t 。 它可以保留前作的每一个符号作为单独的KV条目,只保留所选入的或压缩的条目,或者在固定大小的经常性状态下携带上下文. 让 x t x_{t} 表示当前对内存机制的输入, 让 q t q_{t} 表示用于请求与当前位置有关的信息的表示 。

blocks.en: The first question is what the model has retained before it attempts to retrieve anything. Memory Representation specifies the form and organization of the maintained information, the granularity at which historical content remains distinguishable, and the amount of information the representation can carry. Softmax Attention retains separately addressable memory units. Multi-query attention (MQA) [ 142 ] , grouped-query attention (GQA) [ 2 ] , and multi-head latent attention (MLA) [ 30 ] reduce redundancy across heads or channels while preserving token-level memory units. Linear Attention instead compresses history into an associative recurrent state [ 74 ] , whereas SSMs maintain structured recurrent states [ 56 , 55 ] .
blocks.zh: 第一个问题是,在试图取回任何东西之前,模型保留了什么。 内存表达方式规定了所保存信息的形式与组织,历史内容保持可分辨的颗粒性,以及表达方式能够携带的信息量. Softmax 注意保留单独的可地址存储单元. 多点关注 (MQA) [142],分组关注 (GQA) [2],多点潜在关注 (MLA) [30] 在保留符号级内存单位的同时,减少头部或频道的冗余. 线性注意将历史压缩为关联性重复状态[74],而SSM则保持结构化的重复状态[56,55].

blocks.en: These examples expose two properties that recur throughout the survey. History coverage describes how much of the preceding sequence may influence the maintained memory, whereas addressability describes whether a particular historical unit remains separately selectable. A fixed-size state may cover the entire preceding sequence but no longer preserve every token as an individually addressable item. Conversely, an explicit KV cache preserves token-level addressability but grows as more tokens are retained.
blocks.zh: 这些例子暴露出在整个调查中反复出现的两种属性. 历史覆盖描述之前的序列可在多大程度上影响所保存的记忆,而可处理性则描述某一特定历史单位是否仍可单独选择. 固定大小的状态可能涵盖前述所有序列,但不再将每个标志保存为可单独处理的物品。 反之,一个明确的KV缓存保留了符号级别的可处理性,但随着更多的符号被保留而增长.

blocks.en: To express these alternatives uniformly, let ρ \rho denote a memory schema that specifies the type, organization, granularity, capacity, and persistence of the representation. The maintained memory ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} belongs to the state space permitted by that schema: ℳ t ∈ 𝔐 ρ . \mathcal{M}_{t}\in\mathfrak{M}_{\rho}. (1) For example, ρ \rho may describe a growing list of token KVs, a bounded collection of summary slots, one associative matrix, a structured recurrent state, or several heterogeneous memory paths. This notation describes the information made available by the mechanism rather than requiring one physical realization: the memory may be materialized as a decoding cache, constructed in parallel during training, or carried recurrently as a state. The subscript ρ \rho on each operator below indicates that the concrete Update, Access, Readout, and Integration rules depend on the schema; a heterogeneous schema may therefore apply different rules to different memory units
blocks.zh: 为了统一表达这些替代方案,让我们表示一种内存计划,其中具体说明代表的种类、组织、颗粒性、能力和持久性。 所维护的内存 Mt\ mathcal{M}_{t} 属于该 schema 允许的状态空间 : Mt\ m ^. mathcal{M}_{t\in\ mathfrak{M}_{\rho} 。 (1)例如 ^rho 可以描述一个不断增长的符号KV列表,一个被捆绑的汇总槽集合,一个关联矩阵,一个结构化的重复状态,或者几个不同的内存路径. 这种注解描述了机制提供的信息,而不是要求一种物理实现:内存可能作为解码缓存被实现,在训练中平行地构建,或者作为一个状态反复地被携带. 下面每个运算符的下标 $\rho 表示,混凝土更新、访问、读取和集成规则取决于计划;因此,一个不同的计划可能对不同的内存单位适用不同的规则

blocks.en: Once the form of memory has been identified, the next question is how it changes when the model receives x t x_{t} . Memory Update covers the operations that write new information, preserve existing information, or remove and revise what was previously stored. In Softmax Attention, the standard update appends a key and value derived from the current input. A bounded or compressed memory may instead merge the new information with an existing summary. Recurrent mechanisms may use additive writes, multiplicative decay, input-dependent retention, delta correction, or explicit erase–write operations [ 74 , 177 , 55 ] .
blocks.zh: 一旦识别出内存的形式,下一个问题是当模型收到xt x_{t}时它会怎样变化. 内存更新涵盖了写出新信息,保存现有信息,或去除并修改之前所存储内容的操作. 在Softmax Content中,标准更新附加从当前输入中得出的密钥和值. 受约束或被压缩的内存可能转而将新信息与已存在的摘要合并. 经常性机制可能使用添加剂书写、多相衰变、依赖输入的留存、三角体校正,或明确去除-写入操作[74、177、55]。

blocks.en: Let ℳ t − \mathcal{M}_{t}^{-} and ℳ t + \mathcal{M}_{t}^{+} denote the memory immediately before and after the current update. The update is written abstractly as ℳ t + = Update ρ ⁡ ( ℳ t − , x t ) . \mathcal{M}_{t}^{+}=\operatorname{Update}_{\rho}\left(\mathcal{M}_{t}^{-},x_{t}\right). (2) The same expression therefore covers append-only KV caches, recurrent state transitions, compression into fixed-capacity slots, and controlled erase–write rules. The concrete equations differ across families and are introduced in the corresponding chapters. At this stage, the important distinction is that Update determines how memory changes; it does not determine which parts of the updated memory a particular query will use.
blocks.zh: 让 Mt −\ mathcal{M}_{t}^{-} 和 Mt +\ mathcal{M}_{t}^{+}- 表示当前更新前后的内存 。 更新被抽象地写为Mt + = 更新 ^ (Mt −, x t ). \ mathcal{M}_{t}^{+}=\t}^{+}=\operatorname{ Update}_{\rho}\左 (\mathcal{M}_{t}^{-},x_{t}\t}\rright右). (2) 因此,同一表达式覆盖了仅附件 KV 缓存,经常状态过渡,压缩到固定容量槽,以及可控去除-写入规则. 具体方程式因家庭而异,在相应的章节中被引入. 在这个阶段,重要的区别在于更新决定了内存的改变方式;它没有决定更新后内存中某个特定查询会使用哪些部分.

blocks.en: That latter decision belongs to Access. Given a represented memory, Access determines which memory units or state interfaces are eligible to participate in the current read. Let ℳ ^ t \widehat{\mathcal{M}}_{t} denote the memory visible to the read path. Depending on the mechanism’s read–write convention, it may be the state before the current update, the state after the update, or an implementation-specific view constructed during the same computation. Access exposes an eligible memory view 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} : 𝒞 t = Access ρ ⁡ ( q t , ℳ ^ t ) . \mathcal{C}_{t}=\operatorname{Access}_{\rho}\left(q_{t},\widehat{\mathcal{M}}_{t}\right). (3) Softmax Attention exposes all causally available memory units. Local or block-sparse patterns expose only positions allowed by a prescribed structure [ 14 , 186 ] , while learned sparse mechanisms use routers, indexes, or Top- k k selection to construct a query-dependent candidate set [ 182 ] . For a recurrent mechanism, Access instead exposes the current state interface: that state may carry information influenced by the complete causal history, but the individual historical tokens are no longer separately selectable. Accordingly, 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} may contain all represented token memories, a selected set of tokens or blocks, one or more recurrent states, or another mechanism-specific interface. It may also carry local metadata required by Readout, such as routing scores or group-level normalization quantities.
blocks.zh: 后一决定属于Access. 给一个具有代表性的内存,Access会决定哪些内存单位或状态接口有资格参与当前已读. 让 M^ t\ glashhat\ mathcal{M}}_{t} 表示读取路径可见的内存 。 根据机制的读写常规,它可能是当前更新之前的状态,更新之后的状态,或者在同一计算过程中构建的特定执行视图. 访问会暴露一个符合条件的内存视图 C t\ mathcal{C}_{t}: Ct = 访问 ^ (q t, M ^ t). \ mathcal{ C}_{t}=\- operatorname{Access}_{\rho}\- left (q_{t}),\ gladhat\ mathcal{ M}}_{t}\- 右 。 (3)Softmax Content暴露出所有因果可用的内存单位. 本地或区块分隔模式只暴露一个规定结构[14,186]允许的职位,而所学的稀有机制则使用路由器,索引,或Top-k 选择来构建一个依赖查询的候选人集[182]. 对于一个反复出现的机制,Access转而暴露出当前状态界面:该状态可能携带受完全因果历史所影响的信息,但单个历史符号已不再可以单独选择. 因此, C t\ mathcal{C}_{t} 可能包含所有代表的符号记忆, 一组选定的符号或块, 一个或多个经常状态, 或另一个机制特定界面 。 它还可能携带Readout所需的本地元数据,如路由分数或组级正常化数量.

blocks.en: Once Access has established the eligible view 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} , Readout determines how the query extracts contextual information from it. Softmax Attention computes normalized query–key similarities over the eligible memory units and aggregates their values [ 161 ] . Sparse Attention commonly changes the candidate set while retaining the same Softmax Readout over the selected memory units. Linear Attention reads an associative state through a kernelized contraction or a related state operation [ 74 ] , whereas an SSM produces a contextual representation through a structured projection of its recurrent state [ 28 ] . Access therefore answers what may be read , while Readout answers how the eligible information is read .
blocks.zh: 一旦 Access 建立了符合条件的视图 C t\ mathcal{C}_{t},Readout 将决定查询如何从中提取上下文信息 。 Softmax Content 计算正常的查询 - 与合格内存单位的密钥相似,并汇总其值 [161]. Sparse Content 通常修改候选设置,同时保留所选内存单元上相同的Softmax Readout. 线性注意通过内核化收缩或相关状态操作读取关联状态[74],而SSM则通过对其反复状态的结构化预测产生上下文代表[28]. 因此,访问可以回答可能读取的内容,而读取则可以回答如何读取合格信息。

blocks.en: The resulting contextual representation is written as r t = Readout ρ ⁡ ( q t , 𝒞 t ) . r_{t}=\operatorname{Readout}_{\rho}\left(q_{t},\mathcal{C}_{t}\right). (4) This separation allows two methods to expose different candidate sets while using the same readout rule, or to expose similar state interfaces while decoding them differently.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的上下文表示写为r t = Readout ^ (q t, C t). r_{t}=\operatorname{ readout}_{\rho}\left (q_{t}),\ mathcal{ C}_{t}\r}\rright right. (4)这种分离允许两种方法在使用相同的读出规则的同时曝光不同的候选集,或者在对相似的状态接口进行不同编码的同时曝光.

blocks.en: Integration determines how completed readouts are combined into the representation returned by the memory mechanism. With a single readout, this operation may reduce to an identity mapping or a fixed projection. In multi-head Softmax Attention, the contextual representations produced by the individual heads are concatenated and then mixed by the output projection, allowing information recovered by different heads to contribute jointly to the module output. Parallel branches and heterogeneous memory paths follow the same general principle, but may combine their readouts through summation, gating, routing, or other learned fusion rules.
blocks.zh: 整合决定了完成的读取如何被合并到内存机制返回的表示. 单读后,此操作可能会被缩小为身份映射或固定投影. 在多头Softmax Content中,单个头所制作的上下文表述被调和后被输出投影所混合,使得不同头所回收的信息能够共同为模块输出出力. 平行分支和多相异的内存路径遵循相同的通则,但可能通过归纳,取出,取出,取出等学习到的聚变规则来结合.

blocks.en: Specific mechanisms illustrate how this stage can be modified. Gated Attention applies an input-dependent sigmoid gate to each head output before the heads are combined, allowing the contribution of retrieved information to vary across tokens [ 129 ] . At the branch level, Infini-attention uses a learned gate to combine the readout from local causal Softmax Attention with the readout from its compressive memory [ 113 ] . These mechanisms alter how completed readouts contribute to the output without changing which historical memory units were eligible for the preceding read.
blocks.zh: 具体的机制说明了如何修改这一阶段。 Gated Content在将头部合并之前,对每个头部输出都应用了以输入为主的sigmoid门,使得所检索到的信息的贡献在不同符号上有所变化[129]. 在分行层面,Infini-attention使用一个已学到的门将从本地因子Softmax Record的读取与其压缩内存的读取结合[113]. 这些机制改变了完成的读取如何有助于输出,而不改变哪些历史记忆单位符合前一个读取的条件。

blocks.en: When multiple paths participate, r t r_{t} may therefore denote a collection such as { r t ( p ) } p ∈ 𝒫 t \{r_{t}^{(p)}\}_{p\in\mathcal{P}_{t}} rather than a single vector. The general Integration rule is written as o t = Integration ρ ⁡ ( r t ; x t ) , o_{t}=\operatorname{Integration}_{\rho}\left(r_{t};x_{t}\right), (5) where o t o_{t} is the output of the memory mechanism. Concatenation followed by the output projection is the inherited Integration rule of standard multi-head Softmax Attention. A method directly modifies Integration when it changes how completed readouts contribute to the output, for example through learned gating, conditional routing, or fusion across heterogeneous memory paths.

blocks.en: The five dimensions are functionally distinguishable, but they are not necessarily orthogonal or separately implemented. Changing Representation can alter what remains accessible; an input-dependent state transition can jointly affect Representation and Update; and a hierarchical sparse index can change both the address representation and the candidate set. Equations ( 1 )–( 5 ) should therefore be read as a shared analytical vocabulary rather than a universal computational graph.
blocks.zh: 这五个维是功能上可以区分的,但不一定是正统的或单独实施的. 改变代表制可以改变仍然可以使用的情况;依赖投入的状态过渡可以共同影响代表制和更新;分级分散的指数可以改变地址代表制和候选人组合。 因此,方程式(一)-(五)应该被解读为共享分析词汇,而不是通用计算图.

blocks.en: Table 2 collects the terminology, abbreviations, and framework-level symbols that recur across the survey. In this survey, Softmax Attention denotes the broader explicit-memory lineage in which contextual information is retained as separately addressable representations and read through normalized query–key interactions. Sparse Attention is discussed separately because candidate selection and access-budget allocation form its central design problem. Later chapters also introduce local notation for mechanism-specific equations. Such local symbols retain the definitions given in their own sections and should not be interpreted as additions to the global framework notation below.
blocks.zh: 表2收集了在整个调查中反复出现的术语、缩写和框架一级的符号。 在这项调查中,Softmax Reference表示的是广义的明分分界线,在这种界线中,背景信息作为可单独处理的表述保留,并通过正常的查询-关键交互来读取。 Sparse Content被单独讨论,因为候选人的甄选和访问预算分配构成其中心设计问题. 后几章还引入了特定机制等式的局部标记. 这种地方符号保留了各自章节中给出的定义,不应被解释为对下面全球框架的加注。

blocks.en: Table 2: Core terminology, abbreviations, and framework-level notation used throughout the survey. Chapter-specific symbols are defined locally in the corresponding sections.

Mechanism-specific papers often use o o for the immediate output of an attention head or recurrent operator. Under the present framework, such a quantity functions as a readout r t r_{t} when a subsequent head-, branch-, or path-level Integration step is modeled explicitly; it can coincide with the module output o t o_{t} when Integration is the identity or is left implicit.

blocks.en: 2.2 Classification Principles and Family-Level Mapping
blocks.zh: 2.2 分类原则和家庭一级的绘图

blocks.en: With the five dimensions and their notation in place, we now use the framework to compare the research lines surveyed in the following chapters. These lines reflect their principal technical questions and historical development rather than being derived mechanically from the five dimensions. The chapter labels therefore indicate the primary context in which a method is discussed, whereas the dimensions provide a multi-label description of the memory functions it modifies.
blocks.zh: 随着五个层面及其标记的落实,我们现在利用该框架来比较以下各章所调查的研究线索。 这些线反映了它们的主要技术问题和历史发展,而不是机械地从五个层面推导出来的. 因此分章标签表示讨论方法的主要上下文,而维度则提供它所修改的内存函数的多标签描述.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the dimensions most frequently emphasized in each research line. P marks a dimension commonly treated as a direct design target, whereas S marks one usually inherited or modified only in particular subfamilies. These labels are interpretive rather than exhaustive, and all five dimensions remain applicable to every research line.
blocks.zh: 表3概述了每一研究项目最经常强调的方面。 P标记一个通常被视为直接设计目标的维度,而S标记一个通常只继承或修改到特定的子家庭. 这些标签是解释性的,而不是详尽无遗的,所有五个维度仍然适用于每一个研究线.

blocks.en: Table 3: Qualitative emphasis of the surveyed research lines across the five analytical dimensions. P denotes a dimension commonly treated as a direct design target in the selected works, while S denotes a dimension inherited from the underlying mechanism or modified in particular subfamilies and extensions. The labels are intended as an interpretive guide rather than an exhaustive quantitative coding of the literature.
blocks.zh: 表3:所调查研究线在五个分析层面的质量重点。 P指在所选作品中通常被视为直接设计目标的维度,而S指从基础机制中继承或修改的维度,特别是子家庭与扩展. 标签的用意是作为解释性指南,而不是文献的详尽定量编码.

blocks.en: Across the four mechanism-centered research lines, design effort is concentrated at different stages of memory processing. Softmax Attention primarily develops Memory Representation and Memory Update by reducing redundancy in explicit memory and changing how bounded or compressed memories are maintained [ 142 , 2 , 17 , 30 ] . Sparse Attention instead concentrates on Access: most methods preserve explicit token- or block-level content memory and apply a Softmax Readout over a restricted candidate set [ 14 , 182 ] . Routing keys, hierarchical indexes, compressed addresses, and cross-layer index reuse make Representation and Update secondary innovation axes, but these structures primarily support candidate construction rather than replace the underlying content memory [ 64 , 10 ] . Linear Attention and State Space Models concentrate on Representation and Update because their principal developments concern the organization and evolution of recurrent states [ 74 , 177 , 55 , 28 ] . Access, Readout, and Integration become more explicit mainly in multi-state, routed, gated, or otherwise specialized variants.
blocks.zh: 在以机制为中心的四条研究线上,设计努力集中在内存处理的不同阶段. Softmax Content主要通过减少显性内存中的冗余,并改变受约束或被压缩的记忆如何被维持[142,2,17,30]来开发内存代表和内存更新. 相反,Sparse Content专注于Access:大多数方法都保留了显式的符号或块级内容内存,并在受限制的候选集[14,182]上应用了Softmax Readout. 运行键,分级索引,压缩地址,和跨层索引再用,使得能代表和更新二级创新轴,但这些结构主要支持候选构建,而不是取代基本内容内存[64,10]. 线性关注和州空间模型侧重于代表性和更新,因为它们的主要发展涉及经常性状态的组织和演变[74、177、55、28]。 Access,Readout,和Institution主要在多态,路由,出闸等专用变体中变得更加明确.

blocks.en: Hybrid Architecture requires a different interpretation because it composes multiple memory mechanisms or access regimes rather than defining a single internal memory operator. Memory Representation is therefore its primary family-level axis, while whether a particular design also modifies Memory Update, Access, Readout, or Integration depends on its composition granularity, as analyzed in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: Hybrid Architecture需要不同的解释,因为它组成了多个内存机制或访问系统,而不是定义一个单一的内部内存操作员. 因此,记忆代表是其家庭一级的主要轴心,而某一特定设计是否也修改了记忆更新、访问、读取或融合,则取决于其组成,如第7节所分析的那样。

blocks.en: The resulting pattern highlights complementary design priorities. Softmax Attention reduces redundancy and reorganizes explicit memory while retaining a Softmax-compatible Readout; Sparse Attention allocates a limited Access budget over that memory; and Linear Attention and State Space Models develop the representation and update of recurrent states. Hybrid Architectures instead primarily diversify and allocate heterogeneous memory representations across layers, heads, branches, or tokens. Their effects on the remaining dimensions depend on the composition granularity and are examined in Section 7 . The research lines intersect when an individual method modifies several dimensions, shifting the design problem from optimizing an isolated operator toward coordinating Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration under practical compute and storage constraints.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的模式突出了相辅相成的设计优先事项。 Softmax Content减少了冗余并重组了明显的内存,同时保留了一个Softmax相容的Readout;Sparse Content为这个内存分配了有限的访问预算;Linear Content和State Space Models开发了经常状态的表示和更新. 相反,混合结构主要使不同层次、头、分支或标志的记忆表现多样化和分配。 它们对其他维度的影响取决于颗粒性的组成,并在第7节中加以审查。 当单个方法修改了几个维度时,研究线相互交织,将设计问题从优化一个孤立的操作员转向协调记忆代表、记忆更新、访问、读取和整合在实际计算和存储限制下。

blocks.en: 3 Softmax Attention
blocks.zh: 3 软最大注意

blocks.en: Softmax Attention is the explicit-memory lineage in which a query compares itself with an enumerable set of memory units, normalizes the resulting scores, and aggregates the corresponding values. For query position t t and attention head h h , let q t , h q_{t,h} , k i , h k_{i,h} , and v i , h v_{i,h} be the query, key, and value vectors obtained by linearly projecting the layer input. The standard formulation is then a t , i , h \displaystyle a_{t,i,h} = exp ⁡ ( q t , h ​ k i , h ⊤ / d h ) ∑ j ∈ ℛ t exp ⁡ ( q t , h ​ k j , h ⊤ / d h ) , \displaystyle=\frac{\exp\!\left(q_{t,h}k_{i,h}^{\top}/\sqrt{d_{h}}\right)}{\sum_{j\in\mathcal{R}_{t}}\exp\!\left(q_{t,h}k_{j,h}^{\top}/\sqrt{d_{h}}\right)}, o t , h \displaystyle o_{t,h} = ∑ i ∈ ℛ t a t , i , h ​ v i , h , \displaystyle=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{R}_{t}}a_{t,i,h}v_{i,h}, (6) where ℛ t \mathcal{R}_{t} is the set of memory positions eligible for query t t . In the baseline Transformer, Memory Representation consists of token-wise key–value pairs, Memory Update appends a new pair at each decoding step, Access exposes all positions allowed by the causal mask, Readout is the normalized query–key weighting in Eq. ( 6 ), and Integration concatenates the head outputs and applies the output projection [ 161 ] . This five-dimensional description is more precise than treating every efficiency modification as a change to “attention” in general: two methods can use the same Softmax Readout while changing entirely different memory functions.

(6)中的正向查询-键加权,整合会调和头部输出并应用输出预测[161]. 这种五维描述比将每一次效率修改都当作一般的"意向"的改变更为精确:两种方法可以在改变完全不同的内存功能的同时使用同一种Softmax Readout.

blocks.en: Because each retained token adds an independently addressable key–value entry, the cache size and per-step readout cost both grow with context length. Consequently, efforts to reduce this cost while preserving the benefits of explicit memory can be organized around three optimization directions. First, memory-representation efficiency preserves token-level addressability but reduces the amount of information stored per token or the number of redundant copies across heads and layers. Second, sequence-representation compression changes both Representation and Update by consolidating a growing history into bounded states or lower-resolution remote memories. Third, readout and integration modulation leaves the underlying memory largely intact while changing either how eligible values are weighted or how completed head outputs are transformed or combined into the attention-module output. These directions are composable: a model may use grouped-query or latent KV storage, compress remote history, and gate attention outputs at the same time.
blocks.zh: 由于每个保留符件都增加了一个可独立地址的密钥-值条目,缓存大小和每步读出的成本都随上下文长度而增加. 因此,可以围绕三个优化方向来努力降低这一成本,同时保留明确记忆的好处。 首先,内存表示效率保留了象征级可处理性,但减少了每个象征所存储的信息量,也减少了跨头和多层的冗余拷贝数量. 第二,序列表示压缩通过将不断增长的历史整合为有界限的状态或更低分辨率的远程记忆来改变代表性和更新。 第三,读出和集成调制使基本内存基本完好,同时改变合格值的加权方式或完成后头输出如何被转换或合并为注意-模块输出. 这些方向是可相容的:一个模型可能同时使用分组-query或潜伏的KV存储,压缩远程历史,并同时使用闸门注意输出.

blocks.en: The boundary with neighboring families follows the primary intervention. Methods that retain fine-grained KV memory but restrict the query-specific candidate set are treated as Sparse Attention, whereas methods that replace enumerable content-bearing units with a recurrent associative statistic are treated as Linear Attention. This section covers mechanisms that maintain an enumerable set of token, latent, slot, or summary units and use Softmax normalization either directly or within the readout; token-level addressability is typical but not required.
blocks.zh: 与相邻家庭的边界遵循主要干预。 保留精细的 KV 内存但限制特定查询对象集的方法作为Sparse 注意处理,而用经常性关联统计取代可假设内容单元的方法则作为线性注意处理。 本节涵盖维持一套可假设的代号、潜在号、插槽或摘要单元的机制,并直接或在读出时使用Softmax正常化;代号的可处理性是典型的,但并不需要。

blocks.en: 3.1 Memory-Representation Efficiency
blocks.zh: 3.1 内存-代表效率

blocks.en: A baseline autoregressive Transformer caches a key and value for each position, KV head, and KV-producing layer. For batch size B B , cached length T T , L KV L_{\mathrm{KV}} distinct KV layers, H KV H_{\mathrm{KV}} stored heads per layer, head dimension d h d_{h} , and s s bytes per scalar, the cache size is M KV = 2 ​ B ​ T ​ L KV ​ H KV ​ d h ​ s , M_{\mathrm{KV}}=2BTL_{\mathrm{KV}}H_{\mathrm{KV}}d_{h}s, (7) where the factor of two accounts for keys and values. These factors motivate three representation-efficiency directions: sharing across heads reduces H KV H_{\mathrm{KV}} by allowing multiple query heads to reuse KV states; compression along channels replaces full-width per-token KV states with a narrower latent payload; and sharing across layers reduces L KV L_{\mathrm{KV}} by allowing multiple consumer layers to reuse source-layer KV states. All three preserve token-level addressability and reduce only the coefficient of cache growth, not its linear dependence on T T .
blocks.zh: 基线自旋变形器缓存每个位置的键和值, KV 头和 KV 生成层. 对于批量大小 B B ,缓存长度 T T , L KV L_{\- mathrm{ KV}}- 不同的 KV 层, HKV H_{\mathrm{KV}}被存储的每层头,头尺寸 d h_{d}h} 和 s 字节/每卡,缓存大小为 MKV = 2 B T L KV H KV d hh s, M_{\mathrm{KV}}=2 BTL_{\mathrm{KV}}-H_{\mathrm{KV}}d_{h}, (7) 其中键和值两个账户的因子. 这些因素激励了三个表达效率方向:通过允许多位查询头重新使用KV状态,共享头部减少H KV H_{\mathrm{KV}};通过通道的压缩,以更窄的潜在有效载荷来取代全宽的每盘KV状态;通过允许多位消费层再利用源级KV状态,共享层间减少L KV L_{\mathrm{KV}}. 三者都保留了符号级可处理性,只减少缓存增长的系数,而不是对TT的线性依赖.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Sharing across Heads
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 首长分享

blocks.en: Head sharing asks whether every query head requires an independently stored key and value for the same token. Let H q H_{q} be the number of query heads and let g : { 1 , … , H q } → { 1 , … , H KV } g:\{1,\ldots,H_{q}\}\rightarrow\{1,\ldots,H_{\mathrm{KV}}\} assign each query head to a stored KV head. Query head h h then evaluates Eq. ( 6 ) with ( k i , h , v i , h ) (k_{i,h},v_{i,h}) replaced by ( k i , g ⁡ ( h ) , v i , g ⁡ ( h ) ) (k_{i,g(h)},v_{i,g(h)}) . The access set ℛ t \mathcal{R}_{t} and the Softmax Readout remain unchanged; only the multiplicity of token representations differs.
blocks.zh: 头共享询问每个查询头是否需要独立存储的密钥和对同物的值. 让 H q H q q } 成为查询头的数量, 让 g : { 1, ..., H q } { 1, ..., H KV } g :\ 1,\ ldots, H_{q rightarrow\ 1,\ ldots, H_{\mathrm{ KV} 将每个查询头指定给存储的 KV 头 。 查询头hh后评价 Eq. (6),用(ki,h,vi,h) (k_{i,h},v_{i,h)取而代之的是(ki,g⁡ (h),v gi,g⁡ (h)) (k_{i,g (h)},v_{i,g (h)}). 访问设置 R t\ mathcal{R}_{t} 和 Softmax Readout 仍然不变; 只有符号表示的多样性不同.

blocks.en: Standard multi-head attention (MHA) uses H KV = H q H_{\mathrm{KV}}=H_{q} and assigns every query head its own key and value projections. The arrangement offers maximal head-specific representational freedom but requires the cache to store and the decoder to load a distinct KV pair for every head and token [ 161 ] .
blocks.zh: 标准多头注意 (MHA)使用HKV = Hq H_{\mathrm{KV}}=H_{q},并指定每个查询头都是自己的键和值预测. 这种安排提供了最大程度的头特异性代表自由,但要求缓存存储和解码器为每个头和指针装入一对不同的KV配对 [161].

blocks.en: Multi-query attention (MQA) sets H KV = 1 H_{\mathrm{KV}}=1 : all query heads retain distinct query projections but read from one shared key head and one shared value head. It therefore removes most head-wise duplication in the cache and reduces memory bandwidth during incremental decoding, at the cost of sharing the same key and value representations across query heads [ 142 ] .
blocks.zh: 多克的注意 (MQA) 设置了 H KV = 1 H_{\ mathrm{KV}}=1 :所有查询头保留了不同的查询预测,但从一个共享密钥头和一个共享值头读取. 因此,它消除了缓存中大多数的头部重复,并减少了增量解码过程中的内存带宽,其代价是在查询头之间共享相同的密钥和值表示 [142].

blocks.en: Grouped-query attention (GQA) partitions query heads into groups, with one KV head shared inside each group. Varying the number of groups creates a continuum between MHA and MQA, allowing model designers to trade head-specific memory representations for cache and bandwidth efficiency. GQA can also be obtained by adapting an MHA checkpoint, which makes it a practical architectural compromise rather than only a design for training from scratch [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 分组-query注意 (GQA) 分区将头查询成组,每组内部共享一个KV头. 组数的不同在MHA和MQA之间形成了一个连续体,使模型设计师可以交易针对头的内存表示来进行缓存和带宽效率. GQA也可以通过改造一个MHA检查站获得,这使得它成为一个实用的建筑折衷方案,而不只是从零开始训练的设计[2].

blocks.en: The resulting continuum reduces the number of KV representations stored per token without changing the token candidate set, as summarized in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 如图2所概述,由此产生的连续程序减少了每个信使存储的KV表示数,而没有改变信使候选人集。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Head-sharing continuum from multi-head attention (MHA) to grouped-query attention (GQA) and multi-query attention (MQA). Each box represents one head; the number of query heads is fixed while the number of independently stored KV heads decreases.
blocks.zh: 图 2:从多头关注(MHA)到分组-克热关注(GQA)和多克热关注(MQA)的相接性. 每个框代表一个头;查询头数固定而独立存储的KV头数减少.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Compression along Channels
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 沿海峡进行压缩

blocks.en: Channel compression reduces the width of each token memory rather than the number of its copies. Multi-head latent attention (MLA) maps each hidden state to a compact KV latent and derives the head-specific content keys and values from that shared latent. During decoding, the latent can be cached instead of the expanded multi-head tensors, and suitable projection matrices can be algebraically absorbed into the query and output paths so that the full keys and values need not be materialized at every step [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 通道压缩会减少每个符号内存的宽度,而不是其副本的数量. 多头潜在注意(MLA)将每个隐藏状态映射到一个紧凑的KV潜在状态,并从该共享潜在状态中得出了头特有的内容键和值. 在解码过程中,可以缓存潜伏而不用被扩展的多头活计,合适的投影矩阵可以被代数吸收到查询和输出路径中,这样不需要在每一个步骤[30]中实现全部键和值.

blocks.en: Rotary positional encoding complicates this factorization because applying RoPE to reconstructed content keys prevents the key up-projection from being absorbed into the query path. MLA therefore separates content and positional components and caches the compact KV latent together with a shared positional component, preserving token-level addressability through a low-rank bottleneck [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 扶轮定位编码使这种因子化变得复杂了,因为将RoPE应用到重建内容密钥上可以防止将密钥向上预测被吸收到查询路径中去. 因此,司法协助将内容和位置元件分开,并缓存紧凑的KV潜伏和共享位置元件,通过低级瓶颈保留了符号级可处理性[30].

blocks.en: TransMLA studies the complementary deployment problem of converting an existing GQA checkpoint into an MLA-compatible parameterization. It rewrites the shared GQA projections into an equivalent multi-head form, applies low-rank factorization to obtain a common down-projection and head-specific up-projections, and uses continued training to adapt the model to the new latent representation [ 97 ] . This distinction is important for evaluation: latent KV is an architectural representation change, not merely a post-hoc compression of already generated cache tensors. Its realized benefit depends on latent width, approximation error, positional treatment, projection fusion, cache layout, and kernel support.
blocks.zh: TransMLA研究了将现有的GQA检查站转换为符合司法协助参数的辅助部署问题。 它将共享的GQA预测重写成等同的多头形式,采用低等分级因子化,以获得共同的下行预测和头特异性的上行预测,并使用持续培训来使模型适应新的潜在代表[97]. 这种区分对于评价很重要:潜在的KV是一种建筑代表变化,而不只是对已经生成的缓存分数进行后压缩. 它实现的好处取决于潜在的宽度,近似误差,位置处理,投影聚变,缓存布局,以及内核支持.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Sharing across Layers
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 跨层共享

blocks.en: Layer sharing targets redundancy along network depth. A conventional Transformer produces and stores new keys and values in every attention layer, so the cache grows approximately linearly with the number of such layers even after MQA or GQA has reduced the number of stored KV heads. Cross-Layer Attention (CLA) computes KV activations only in selected source layers and allows one or more subsequent consumer layers to reuse them [ 15 ] . Consumer layers retain their own queries, Softmax weights, output projections, residual paths, and feed-forward transformations; what is shared is the memory content, not the entire attention computation.
blocks.zh: 沿网络深度共享目标冗余层 。 常规变形器在每个注意层中产生并存储了新的密钥和值,因此即使MQA或GQA减少了所存储的KV头数后,缓存也会随着这些层的数量而约线性地增长. Cross-Layer Content(CLA)只在所选源层中计算出KV活化,并允许之后的一个或多个消费层再用它们[15]. 消费层保留了自己的查询,Softmax权重,输出预测,剩余路径,以及feed-forward转化;共享的是内存内容,而不是整个注意力计算.

blocks.en: If one source layer serves c c adjacent layers, the number of independently cached KV layers decreases by approximately a factor of c c . Head and layer sharing are orthogonal: an MLA, GQA, or MQA source layer can itself be shared by multiple consumers. This also distinguishes cross-layer KV sharing from cross-layer index reuse in sparse attention: the former shares content-bearing KV activations, whereas the latter shares an Access decision while each layer retains different KV content.
blocks.zh: 如果一个源层服务于相邻的 c 层,则独立缓存的 KV 层的数量会减少大约一个系数 c. 头和地层共享是正交的:一个MLA,GQA,或MQA源地层本身可以被多个消费者共享. 这也区分了跨层的KV共享与跨层索引再利用的稀有关注:前者共享包含内容的KV活化,而后者共享一个Access决定而每一层保留不同的KV内容.

blocks.en: 3.2 Sequence-Representation Compression
blocks.zh: 3.2 序列-代表压缩

blocks.en: The preceding methods reduce the cost of each token memory while retaining all token identities. Sequence-representation compression instead reorganizes history over time in two ways. Fixed-capacity recurrent memory repeatedly writes accumulated content into a bounded set of persistent states, while dynamic-resolution memory retains recent tokens at fine granularity and represents remote context with fewer, coarser units. The first bounds persistent state but may still use temporary local representations; the second may continue to grow with history, but more slowly than a token-wise cache.
blocks.zh: 前面的方法可以降低每个符号存储器的成本,同时保留所有符号身份. 序列表示压缩反而以两种方式重组历史。 固定容量的经常性内存会再三将所累积的内容写入一组有边框的持久性状态中,而动态分辨率内存则保留了精细颗粒的近代符号并代表了边框较少的,相近的单位. 第一个限制持续状态,但可能仍然使用临时的本地代表;第二个可能随着历史而继续增长,但比一个按符号的缓存要慢.

blocks.en: Segment recurrence and compressed segment memory provide important precursors. Transformer-XL [ 27 ] reuses hidden states from previous segments as an extended context, whereas Compressive Transformer [ 136 ] adds a lower-resolution memory for states displaced from the recent cache. Later methods make the update process more explicit, place stricter bounds on the recurrent state, or design learned summary units for very long contexts.
blocks.zh: 片段重现和压缩片段内存提供了重要的先导. Transformer-XL [27] 将前几段的隐藏状态作为扩展上下文再用,而压缩变形器 [136] 则为从最近缓存中流出状态添加了更低分辨率的内存. 后期方法使更新过程更加明确,对常态设置更严格的界限,或者为非常长的上下文设计所学到的总结单元.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Fixed-Capacity Recurrent Memory
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 固定能力

blocks.en: Fixed-capacity methods maintain K K persistent memory units and repeatedly update their contents as new tokens or blocks arrive. Historical tokens therefore cease to exist as independently recoverable entries once their information has been consolidated. The central problem shifts from storing every token to controlling what a bounded memory retains, overwrites, and exposes to future queries.
blocks.zh: 固定容量方法保持了K K 持续内存单元,并随着新符号或块的到来而反复更新其内容. 因此,一旦其信息合并,历史标志就不再作为独立可收回的条目存在。 中心问题从存储每个符号转向控制有限度的内存所保留的东西,覆盖并暴露于未来的查询.

blocks.en: Recurrent Memory Transformer (RMT) inserts special memory tokens into each segment. Read-memory tokens carry the state produced by the preceding segment, participate in attention with the current tokens, and are transformed into write-memory tokens that become the state for the next segment [ 17 ] . The update is therefore performed within the Transformer computation rather than by an external pooling step. TransformerFAM similarly uses a block-wise feedback interface: token queries read the previous Feedback Attention Memory, while memory queries selectively aggregate the current block and return updated latent states to the next block. The mechanism reuses existing attention and feed-forward parameters instead of introducing a separate memory network [ 68 ] .
blocks.zh: 经常性内存变形器(RMT)将特殊的内存符号插入到每个段. Read-memory 符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符 因此,更新是在 " 变形器 " 计算范围内进行的,而不是通过外部集合步骤进行的。 变形器FAM同样使用分块的反馈接口:令牌查询读取了之前的反馈注意内存,而内存查询则有选择地将当前块组合起来,并将更新后的潜在状态返回到下一个块. 该机制重新使用现有的注意和向导参数,而不是引入单独的内存网络[68].

blocks.en: For both models, the persistent memory is a fixed set of hidden-state-like vectors updated at segment or block boundaries. Queries attend to these latent units rather than to the original tokens from earlier segments, so recurrence can propagate information across segment boundaries but does not preserve exact historical addressability: multiple past tokens may be entangled in the same state.
blocks.zh: 对于这两个模型,持久的内存是一组固定的隐藏状态等向量,在片段或块边界上更新. 查询会关注这些潜在的单位,而不是来自更早部分的原始代号,因此再现可以跨段边界传播信息,但不会保存准确的历史可处理性:多个过去代号可能缠绕在同一状态.

blocks.en: Trellis and Lattice instead maintain explicit key and value slots. The keys define retrieval conditions and the values carry associated content, so current queries can attend directly to a bounded set of memory entries. Trellis uses a two-pass recurrent compression procedure and online-gradient-descent-inspired updates, together with forgetting that regulates the persistence of previous content [ 72 ] . Lattice formulates cache compression as online optimization, exploits low-rank structure in the KV matrices, and applies state- and input-dependent gates together with an orthogonal update intended to reduce redundant writes; chunkwise parallelization mitigates the sequential cost of recurrence [ 73 ] .
blocks.zh: Trellis和Lattice则保留了明确的密钥和值位. 密钥定义了检索条件,而值则携带了相关内容,因此当前的查询可以直接处理到一组被绑定的内存条目. Trellis使用双通的经常性压缩程序和在线升级-descent-inspired的更新,同时被遗忘,规范了以往内容的持久性[72]. Lattice 将缓存压缩作为在线优化,在 KV 矩阵中利用低等结构, 并应用状态和输入依赖的闸门, 以及旨在减少冗余写作的正向更新; 块相平行可以减轻重现的相继成本 [73].

blocks.en: The distinction between latent-state and KV-slot memory concerns the persistent interface rather than the update frequency. RMT and TransformerFAM are primarily block- or segment-recurrent, whereas Trellis and Lattice update at finer granularity in their proposed realizations. In both cases, bounded recurrent updates replace append-only token accumulation, and original token identities cease to be separately accessible once consolidated into latent states or slots.
blocks.zh: 潜在状态和KV-slot内存的区别涉及持续的界面而不是更新频率. RMT和变形器FAM主要为块式或段式相通,而Trellis和Lattice在其拟议实现中则以更细的颗粒性进行更新。 在这两种情况下,有边框的经常性更新都取代了仅附加的符号累积,而原始的符号身份一旦被合并成潜在状态或插槽,就不再单独访问.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Dynamic-Resolution Memory
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 动态分辨率内存

blocks.en: Dynamic-resolution memory assigns different granularities to different portions of history. Recent tokens remain explicit to preserve exact local dependencies, whereas older content is consolidated into fewer summaries or compressed global entries. Unlike fixed-capacity recurrence, the remote memory may continue to grow, but at a slower rate determined by chunk size, summary ratio, hierarchy depth, or consolidation policy.
blocks.zh: 动态分辨率内存为历史的不同部分分配了不同的颗粒. 近期的标志仍然明确,以保留准确的当地依赖性,而更古老的内容则被合并为更少的概要或压缩的全球条目. 与固定容量重现不同,远程内存可能会继续增长,但速度会以更慢的速度由块大小,汇总比,分级深度,或合并政策所决定.

blocks.en: Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) combines a fine-grained recent path with summary memory for earlier chunks. Sliding Chunk Attention preserves local continuity, while summary attention gives queries access to compressed remote context; the memory state therefore contains both token-level recent units and coarser content-bearing summaries [ 26 ] . HCA Core constructs a smaller collection of highly compressed global entries and performs dense Softmax attention over those entries [ 33 ] . The complete DeepSeek-V4 architecture additionally combines local sliding-window and compressed sparse pathways, so the full system is hybrid; HCA Core falls under sequence-representation compression because it replaces remote KV entries with compressed units and attends densely over those units rather than selecting a query-specific subset of the original cache.
blocks.zh: Kwai 汇总注意( KSA) 结合了一种精细的最近路径和早期块的汇总内存. 滑行Chunk Content保持了局部连续性,而简要的注意则给予被压缩的远程上下文的查询权限;因此内存状态既包含符号级的最近单位,也包含有相近内容的摘要[26]. 有害物质 核心构建了规模较小的高度压缩的全球条目集并对这些条目进行了密集的软最大关注[33]. 完整的DeepSeek-V4架构还结合了局部的滑窗和压缩的稀有路径,因此整个系统是混合的; HCA 核心属于序列表示压缩,因为它用被压缩的单位来取代远程 KV 条目,并且对这些单位进行密集的出席,而不是选择原始缓存中一个特定查询子集.

blocks.en: Dynamic-resolution memory therefore rewrites the units represented before readout, whereas Sparse Attention retains fine-grained memory and restricts the query-specific candidate set.
blocks.zh: 动态分辨率内存因此在读出前重写所代表单位,而Sparse Content则保留了精细的内存并限制特定查询候选集.

blocks.en: Both fixed-capacity and dynamic-resolution policies compress information before future queries are known. Bounded updaters trade retention against overwrite and interference, while dynamic-resolution systems must decide when to consolidate content and what their summaries should preserve. Once token states are overwritten or merged, omitted details are generally unrecoverable. Evaluation should therefore report persistent memory size, local-context budget, compression or update overhead, readout cost, and long-range recall; bounded persistent memory does not eliminate local or update computation, and dynamic-resolution state may still grow with history.
blocks.zh: 固定容量和动态解析政策都会在未来查询之前压缩信息. 受约束的更新者交易保留,以对抗覆盖和干扰,而动态解析系统则必须决定何时合并内容并保留其摘要。 一旦象征状态被覆盖或合并,省略的细节一般是无法收回的. 因此,评价应当报告持续的内存大小,本地文本预算,压缩或更新间接费用,读出成本,以及远程召回;有限度的持续内存并不能消除局部或更新计算,动态解析状态可能随着历史不断增长.

blocks.en: 3.3 Readout and Integration Modulation
blocks.zh: 3.3 读取和融合模块

blocks.en: The preceding mechanisms change the memory substrate or its update rule. A separate line of work preserves the underlying memory units but modifies either the Readout in Eq. ( 6 ) or the subsequent Integration stage. Readout modulation transforms query–key scores or combines attention maps before they weight the values, whereas Integration modulation routes or gates completed head outputs before the output projection. These interventions can alter selectivity and information flow without reducing the stored memory or token candidate set.
blocks.zh: 上述机制会改变内存基质或其更新规则. 单独一行的工作保留了基础内存单元,但要么修改了Eq. (6)中的Readout,要么修改了之后的整合阶段. 读出调制会转换查询 - 键分数或者在计分值前结合注意地图,而集成调制路由或闸门则在输出投影前完成头部输出. 这些干预措施可以改变选择性和信息流动,而不会减少存储的内存或象征性的候选集。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Score and Map Modulation
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 分数和地图模式

blocks.en: Talking-Heads Attention applies learned linear projections across heads both before Softmax and after Softmax. It therefore allows different heads to cooperate in forming attention maps, rather than requiring each head to generate and use its weights independently; the same learned mixing matrices are applied to every input [ 141 ] . Dynamically Composable Multi-Head Attention (DCMHA) makes the cross-head composition input-dependent and modulates both pre-Softmax scores and post-Softmax weight matrices, increasing adaptive expressivity at the cost of additional composition and implementation overhead [ 167 ] .
blocks.zh: 在Softmax和Softmax之前和之后,Talking-Heads Reocation在头部应用学到的线性预测。 因此,它允许不同的头在形成关注图方面进行合作,而不是要求每个头独立地产生和使用它的权重;同样的所学的混合矩阵适用于每一个输入 [141]. 动态可编译多头注意(DCMHA)使跨头组分的输入依赖并调取了"Softmax"前分数和"Softmax"后分数矩阵,以额外的组成和执行间接费用为代价提高了适应性表达力[167].

blocks.en: Differential Attention constructs two query–key paths, obtains two Softmax maps, and subtracts one from the other with a learned scale. Components that activate similarly in both paths can be suppressed, while their differences are retained. The effective weights may consequently be negative and no longer form a single probability distribution, although the component maps are Softmax-normalized [ 181 ] . Forgetting Transformer (FoX) instead introduces a data-dependent forget gate into the score path, allowing the contribution of historical positions to decay according to both content and distance before Softmax normalization [ 87 ] .
blocks.zh: 区别注意构建出两个查询 - 键路径, 获得两个 Softmax 地图, 并用学习的尺度从另一个图中减去一个. 在两种路径中同样激活的组件可以被压制,而它们的区别则被保留. 因此,有效权重可能是负的,不再形成单一概率分布,尽管组件图是Softmax-正态化的 [181]. 忘却变形器(FoX)转而将一个依赖数据的忘却门引入了分数路径,使得历史位置的贡献在Softmax正常化[87]之前既根据内容也根据距离衰减.

blocks.en: These methods leave the underlying candidate memory and, in their basic forms, the append-only cache unchanged. They alter the weights used to read that memory, but more concentrated or smaller effective weights do not imply fewer stored KV entries or fewer executed score computations.
blocks.zh: 这些方法留下了基本的候选内存,并且在其基本形式上,仅附加缓存不变. 它们改变用来读取该内存的权重,但更集中或更小的有效权重并不意味着存储的KV条目减少或者执行分数计算减少.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Head Routing and Gating
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 骑行和行走

blocks.en: Mixture of Attention Heads (MoH) treats heads as experts and uses a token-dependent router to select and weight their contributions. Shared heads remain active for all tokens, while routed heads provide conditional specialization [ 71 ] . Because the controlled object is the contribution of head-level readouts to the module output, the principal change is Integration . A sufficiently specialized implementation may skip inactive heads and obtain conditional computation, but this head-level sparsity is distinct from selecting historical tokens in the Access stage.
blocks.zh: 注意头的混合(MoH)将头作为专家对待,并使用一个依赖符号的路由器来选择和权衡其贡献. 共享头对所有符号仍然活跃,而路由头则提供有条件的专业化[71]. 由于被控制的对象是头级读取对模块输出的贡献,所以主要变化是集成. . 一个足够专业化的实现可能跳过不活动头并获得有条件的计算,但这种头级的收缩状态不同于在Access阶段选择历史符号.

blocks.en: Gated Attention introduces input-dependent sigmoid gates after the scaled dot-product attention outputs of individual heads and before their final combination [ 129 ] . The gates add a nonlinearity between value aggregation and output projection and allow the model to suppress a head’s retrieved information for a particular token. A near-zero post-readout gate, however, does not retroactively eliminate the score computation, Softmax normalization, or KV loads already performed for that head.
blocks.zh: Gated Content在单个头部的大小化点产品注意输出之后,并在最终组合之前,引入了依赖输入的sigmoid门 [129]. 这些门在数值聚合和输出投影之间增加了非线性,使模型能够压制一个头被检索到的某个特定信号的信息. 然而,近于零的后读出门并没有追溯取消分数计算,Softmax常态,或已经为该头完成的KV负载.

blocks.en: MoH and Gated Attention thus both modify Integration, but with different control semantics. MoH allocates contribution through routing and can support discrete conditional execution; Gated Attention continuously rescales head outputs and primarily regulates information flow. Whether either mechanism yields wall-clock savings depends on kernel and runtime support for the induced head-level sparsity.
blocks.zh: MoH和Gated Content因此都修改了集成,但具有不同的控制语义. 卫生部通过路由分配贡献,可以支持离散的有条件执行; Gated Content持续地调整头输出并主要调节信息流. 这两种机制是否产生壁点节省,取决于内核和运行时间对被诱发的头级痉挛的支持.

blocks.en: Readout and Integration modifications should therefore be evaluated separately from memory compression. Numerical sparsity in scores, routing probabilities, or gates reduces computation only when the implementation can skip the corresponding score, load, or head operations before execution; evidence should therefore pair model quality with FLOPs, memory traffic, kernel efficiency, and end-to-end latency.
blocks.zh: 因此,阅读和整合修改应与内存压缩分开评价。 分数中的数相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: 3.4 Summary
blocks.zh: 3.4 总结

blocks.en: Softmax Attention research has pursued several complementary ways to reduce the cost of explicit-memory retrieval while retaining normalized content-based readout. For autoregressive decoding, MQA and GQA reduce head-wise replication, while MLA and cross-layer sharing compress token memory along channel and depth axes while preserving token-level addressability. At longer contexts, lowering the cost of each token is no longer sufficient to control growth with sequence length, motivating bounded recurrent memories and dynamic-resolution summaries that trade exact historical granularity for capacity. Score and map modulation, head routing, and output gating developed as an orthogonal direction for improving selectivity and information flow without directly shrinking the represented memory.
blocks.zh: Softmax Content研究采取了几种互补的方法来降低明确内容检索的成本,同时保留基于内容的正常读取. 对于自递回式解码,MQA和GQA会减少头相机复制,而MLA和跨层共享沿通道和深度轴压缩符号内存,同时保留符号级可处理性. 在较长的环境下,降低每个信物的成本不再足以以序列长度控制增长,激发起固定的重复记忆和动态分辨率总结,以准确的历史颗粒度换取能力。 分数和映射调制,取头路由,输出取格被开发成正向方向来改进选择性和信息流,而不会直接收缩所显示的内存.

blocks.en: Head sharing is a common design for dense Softmax Attention in several mainstream model families: GQA is used across Llama 3/4 [ 53 , 100 ] and Qwen2/3 [ 175 , 174 ] , and remains as the periodic gated full-attention path 2 2 2 Here, full attention denotes full-context causal Softmax Attention, in which each query may attend to all causally eligible token positions represented at that layer. The term describes Access scope rather than head or KV parameterization; a full-attention path may use MHA, MQA, GQA, or MLA, and contrasts with local, streaming, or sparsely selected attention. in Qwen3.5 [ 131 ] , Qwen3.6 [ 133 , 132 ] , and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B . Latent KV compression forms a second major lineage. MLA, introduced in DeepSeek-V2 and retained in DeepSeek-V3/V3.2 [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] , is also used by Kimi K2 [ 112 ] , by the Gated MLA layers of Kimi K3 [ 76 ] , and as the content representation underlying DeepSeek Sparse Attention in the GLM-5 series [ 49 , 183 , 185 ] . More aggressive sequence compression appears in DeepSeek-V4’s Heavily Compressed Attention [ 33 ] , which applies dense Softmax readout to consolidated KV entries, while output gating accompanies both GQA in recent Qwen hybrids [ 131 , 129 ] and MLA in Kimi K3 [ 76 ] .

blocks.en: Across these systems, the GQA, latent-KV, compressed-memory, and gating components belong to the developments surveyed here; where recurrent or sparse paths are also present, those paths are treated in later sections. The next section turns to Sparse Attention, where the central question is which represented token- or block-level units are made eligible for each query.
blocks.zh: 在这些系统中,GQA、潜伏-KV、压缩-记忆和取景组件属于此处所调查的发展;在经常或稀有路径存在的地方,这些路径在后部分处理。 下一节转而介绍Sparse Reference,其中的中心问题是代表哪个符号-或块级单位有资格进行每次查询.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Attention-map comparison between dense and sparse access. Dense Attention retains every causal pair. Structure Sparse Attention combines a fixed four-token sliding window with a sink connection to the first token. Routing Sparse Attention retains the causal lower-triangular domain, selects the diagonal by default, and chooses up to three additional tokens per row. Self-routing from the main attention and auxiliary-proxy routing through an indexer are alternative ways to produce the same type of selected support; all selected routing cells therefore share one visual style, while unselected causal cells remain unfilled.

blocks.en: Sparse Attention is primarily an Access intervention: methods differ in whether support is prescribed structurally, inferred from backbone representations, predicted by an auxiliary index, or reused across steps and layers. Memory Representation and Memory Update become relevant when selection requires address memory—such as pooled summaries, projected keys, or binary codes—or when content itself is compressed, refreshed, or shared. Most methods retain the candidate-local Softmax Readout in Eq. ( 9 ); Readout changes directly only when routing scores also allocate probability mass, while Integration matters mainly in multi-branch designs that combine sparse, local, or compressed paths. The chapter therefore centers on support construction and its execution cost, noting the other dimensions only when a method changes them directly. Figure 3 contrasts dense causal access with representative structure-constrained and routing-based sparse supports.
blocks.zh: Sparse Content主要是一项Access干预:方法不同,是从结构上规定支持,是从骨干表示推论,由辅助指数预测,还是跨步骤和分层再利用. 当选择需要地址内存(如集合摘要、预测的密钥或二进制代码)或当内容本身被压缩、刷新或共享时,内存表示和内存更新就变得相关了。 多数方法保留Eq. (9)中候选-local Softmax Readout; Readout仅在路由分数也分配出概率质量时直接改变,而整合则主要在将稀有,局部,或压缩路径相结合的多分支设计中起重要作用. 因此,该章集中论述支助建造及其执行费用,仅当一种方法直接改变时才注意到其他方面。 图3将密集的因果接入与代表性结构受限和以路由为基础的稀有支持相对.

blocks.en: Sparse Attention methods are organized here by two questions: how candidate-support evidence is produced and how long a selection decision remains valid. Along the evidence-source axis, Structure-Constrained methods prescribe a topology or pattern family, Self-Routing methods derive evidence from backbone representations or execution state, and Auxiliary-Proxy Routing introduces a separate indexing space. Orthogonally, Temporal and Cross-Layer Reuse amortizes supports, indexes, or memory representations across time and depth and can be combined with any evidence source. These subsection labels therefore serve as editorial homes rather than mutually exclusive classes; routing granularity and training mode remain cross-cutting attributes.
blocks.zh: 在此,Sparse注意方法由两个问题组成:如何提供候选人支助证据以及甄选决定是否仍然有效。 沿着证据-来源轴线,结构-约束方法规定了地貌或模式家族,自旋方法从骨干代表或执行状态中取出证据,辅助-Proxy Routing引入了单独的索引空间. Orthogon,Tempolar和Cross-Layer再用分期摊还支持,索引,或内存在时间和深度上的表示,可以与任何证据来源结合. 因此,这些分节标签是编辑之家,而不是相互排斥的课程;路由颗粒性和培训模式仍然是贯穿各领域的属性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Structure-Constrained Sparse Attention
blocks.zh: 4.1 结构受限制的分层注意

blocks.en: Structure-constrained methods restrict Access using positional relations, distance schedules, or a predefined topology. Their distinguishing property is not a particular mask geometry, but that the admissible support is limited by a pattern established independently of unrestricted query-specific search. Let 𝒫 \mathcal{P} denote either a pattern designed before training or a pattern family discovered from a trained dense model. The instantiated support can be written as 𝒫 ∈ { 𝒫 design , 𝒫 observed } , ℐ t = Instantiate ⁡ ( 𝒫 , t , z t ) , | ℐ t | ≪ t , \mathcal{P}\in\{\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{design}},\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{observed}}\},\qquad\mathcal{I}_{t}=\operatorname{Instantiate}(\mathcal{P};t,z_{t}),\qquad|\mathcal{I}_{t}|\ll t, (10) where z t z_{t} is optional input-dependent information used only to instantiate positions within the permitted family. This distinction separates architecture-prescribed patterns, fixed before training so that parameters adapt to the restricted support, from post-hoc discovered patterns, inferred from an already-trained dense checkpoint and applied at inference. Figure 4 visualizes these two origins through representative causal attention maps.

Architecture-prescribed patterns—local windows with global or random edges, and strided/dilated schedules—are fixed before training so parameters adapt to them. Post-hoc patterns—sink-plus-window rules and offline-profiled vertical/slash/block families—are inferred from a trained dense model and applied at inference. The global token is drawn in causal-ized form: it attends all earlier positions (its causal row) and is attended by all later ones (its column), never accessing future keys; a sink instead contributes only a column.
