blocks.en: 4.1.1 Architecture-Prescribed Patterns
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 结构规定的模式

blocks.en: Architecture-prescribed patterns determine the attention topology before pretraining or task training, allowing the model parameters to adapt to the restricted support. A common construction combines a local backbone with a small number of long-range edges. Longformer uses a sliding window together with task-dependent global tokens that can read the full sequence and be read by all positions [ 14 ] . BigBird combines local, global, and random connections to provide local continuity, global aggregation, and additional long-range graph connectivity [ 186 ] . These local–global composites preserve a predictable memory-access pattern, although special nodes and heterogeneous edge types complicate both model design and implementation.
blocks.zh: 建筑定型模式在预训或任务训练前决定关注地貌,使模型参数能适应受限支持. 通俗建筑将局部骨干与少量长相边缘结合. Longformer使用滑动窗口与任务依赖的全局符号,可以读取全序并被所有位置所读取 [14]. BigBird将本地,全球,和随机的连接结合起来,提供本地的连续性,全球聚合,以及额外的长程图连接[186]. 这些本地-全球复合材料保持了可预测的内存存取模式,尽管特殊的节点和不同的边缘类型使模型设计和实施复杂化。

blocks.en: A second line organizes long-range access directly by distance. Sparse Transformer factorizes dense attention into complementary local and strided or fixed patterns, reducing the interaction count to approximately O ⁡ ( L ​ L ) O(L\sqrt{L}) for suitable factorizations [ 25 ] . LongNet uses progressively increasing segment sizes and dilation rates to form multi-scale Dilated Attention, thereby extending the receptive field while keeping the attention work linear in sequence length under its sparse schedule [ 38 ] . PowerAttention similarly uses power-of-two offsets to allocate a fixed budget across multiple distance scales [ 22 ] . Distance-structured patterns are regular and budgetable, but their ability to retrieve a remote item depends on the prescribed offsets and on information propagation through depth.
blocks.zh: 第二行按距离直接组织远程接入. Sparse Transformer 将密集的注意力分解为互补的局部和被扭曲或固定的图案,将相互作用计数降低到O → (L) O(L\sqrt{L})左右,用于合适的分解 [25]. LongNet使用逐渐增加的片段大小和扩展速率形成多尺度的分解注意力,从而扩展可被接受的场域,同时将注意力的线性工作按序长按其稀有的日程[38]. 电量同样利用两相抵消的力量,在多相距尺度之间分配固定预算[22]。 远程结构模式是正常的和可预算的,但是它们能否取回远程物品取决于规定的抵销额和通过深度传播信息。

blocks.en: The benefit of architecture-prescribed sparsity is training–inference consistency: the model learns under the same constrained Access used at deployment. The cost is limited input adaptivity. A fixed topology can retain irrelevant regions and omit evidence whose location or density does not match the structural prior. Enlarging windows or adding global edges improves coverage but directly consumes the compute and bandwidth savings that motivate sparsity.
blocks.zh: 架构规定的抽筋的好处是培训-推论一致性:模型在部署时使用的相同限制下学习。 成本是有限的投入适应性。 固定地貌可以保留不相干区域并省去其位置或密度与结构前作不符的证据. 扩大窗口或增加全球边缘可提高覆盖度,但直接消耗激发垃圾的计算和带宽节省。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Post-hoc Discovered Patterns
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 任务结束后c 发现的图案

blocks.en: Post-hoc methods analyze a trained dense model and convert recurring attention behavior or extrapolation failures into an inference-time rule. StreamingLLM identifies the importance of initial “attention sink” tokens and retains a small sink set together with a rolling recent window [ 170 ] . LM-Infinite similarly uses an initial-plus-recent Λ \Lambda -shaped mask and caps relative-position distances to improve zero-shot length extrapolation [ 61 ] . Their runtime Access is globally fixed rather than content-selected: the rule preserves empirically important positions but does not retrieve arbitrary middle-context tokens.

blocks.en: MInference occupies an intermediate point between fixed and fully content-adaptive routing. It profiles dense attention maps to assign each head an A-shape, vertical–slash, or block-sparse pattern family, and then instantiates columns, diagonals, or blocks from the current Q/K values at inference time [ 70 ] . The family is fixed by offline analysis, whereas the selected positions retain limited input dependence. This reduces the online search space and supports structured kernels, but the dense checkpoint was not optimized under the resulting mask.
blocks.zh: 推论占据了固定内容和完全适应内容的路由之间的中间点. 它剖析了密集的注意图来指定每个头部一个A-形状,垂直-斜线,或块-平面图案家族,然后在推断时间[70]从当前Q/K值中即时分出列,对角线,或块. 家庭通过离线分析得到固定,而选定的职位则保留有限的投入依赖。 这缩短了在线搜索空间,支持结构化内核,但密集的检查点并没有在所形成的口罩下得到优化.

blocks.en: Post-hoc discovery is attractive because it can accelerate an existing model without sparse pretraining. Its central limitation is training–inference mismatch: deleting connections and changing the Softmax normalization domain can alter a computation that was learned as dense. Fixed rules minimize selection overhead but offer little input adaptivity; pattern families recover some adaptivity at the price of runtime statistics and candidate construction. Comparisons should therefore report not only nominal sparsity, but also retained attention mass or support recall, end-to-end latency, and quality across tasks whose relevant evidence has different positional structure.
blocks.zh: 浩克后发现具有吸引力,因为它可以加速现有的模型,而无需进行少量的预训. 它的中心局限是训练-推论不匹配:删除连接并改变Softmax常态域可以改变一个被学成密集的计算. 固定规则将选择间接费用降到最低,但投入适应性不大;模式家庭按运行时间统计和候选结构的价格恢复某些适应性。 因此,比较不仅应报告名义上的抽筋情况,而且还应保持注意质量或支持性召回、端到端的耐久性以及各项任务的质量,这些任务的相关证据具有不同的立场结构。

blocks.en: 4.2 Self-Routing Sparse Attention
blocks.zh: 4.2 自发运动关注

blocks.en: Self-routing constructs support from the main model’s own representations or execution state by scoring candidates in the same query–key representation space used by the main Softmax Readout, either directly or through deterministic pooling of backbone keys. Candidate evidence may additionally use sampled queries, pooled statistics, online-Softmax state, or a draft model’s attention before being passed to the budgeted selector in Eq. ( 8 ). The methods below differ in how they construct this evidence and in how tightly selection is coupled to attention execution. Figure 5 summarizes three representative evidence constructions developed below. Auxiliary-proxy routing, discussed in Section 4.3 , instead forms selection scores from separately parameterized index queries and keys that the main attention does not read.
blocks.zh: 自通路从主要模型本身的表示或执行状态中构建支持,方法是直接或通过确定性地集中主干键,在主Softmax Readout所使用的同一查询-键表示空间中给候选人打分。 候选证据可能另外使用抽样查询、集合统计、在线软件学状态或模型草案的注意,然后转交Eq.(8)的预算选择者。 以下方法在如何构建这种证据和如何紧密地结合执行与注意方面有所不同。 图5总结了以下三项有代表性的证据构建。 第4.3节讨论的辅助-代理路由,转而从单独的参数化索引查询和主要注意力不读取的密钥中形成选择分数.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Representative evidence constructions for self-routing Sparse Attention: dynamic token grouping, block aggregation, and in-sequence summary-token encoding.
blocks.zh: 图5 具有代表性的自通路证据构造 Sparse Content:动态符号组合,块集合,以及序列中摘要键编码.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Dynamic Token Grouping
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 动态托肯分组

blocks.en: Dynamic token grouping constructs a content-dependent sparse pattern without first evaluating the full query–key score matrix. A lightweight partitioner maps every query and key independently to one or more groups according to representation similarity. Tokens with matching group assignments are then gathered, causal masking is applied within each group, and ordinary token-level Softmax is evaluated only on those pairs. The groups may contain positions that are far apart in the original sequence, so this mechanism can connect semantically related tokens without prescribing where those tokens must occur.
blocks.zh: 动态符号分组构建一个依赖内容的稀有模式,而不首先评价完整的查询-键分数矩阵. 一个轻量级分区器将每个查询和密钥按照代表的相似性独立地映射到一个或多个组. 然后收集具有匹配组任务的托肯,在每个组内应用因果掩码,普通的令牌级Softmax只对这些对子进行评价. 这些组合可能包含在原始序列中相去相去甚远的位置,因此这种机制可以连接与星相相相联而无需规定这些星相必须发生在何处.

blocks.en: Reformer realizes this idea with locality-sensitive hashing over shared query–key representations: tokens that collide under a hash attend within the same or adjacent buckets, and multiple hash rounds improve recall [ 77 ] . Routing Transformer is a particularly representative learned variant because it exposes the complete grouping pipeline—learned partition, content-dependent assignment, and within-group readout—while retaining standard dot-product attention after routing [ 139 ] .
blocks.zh: 改革者意识到这个想法,在共享的查询-关键表达方式上进行对地点敏感的散列:在同一或相邻的桶内,散列下相撞的活物,多发散列弹会改善召回[77]。 Routing Transformer是一个特别具有代表性的学习变体,因为它暴露了完整的分组管道——获取分区、内容依赖分配和分组内读取——同时保留路线[139]之后的标准点产品关注。

blocks.en: Routing Transformer maintains G G shared centroids { μ c } c = 1 G \{\mu_{c}\}_{c=1}^{G} and normalizes queries, keys, and centroids onto a common sphere. Conceptually, each query and key is assigned to its most similar centroid: a t Q = arg ​ max c ∈ { 1 , … , G } ⁡ q ~ t ​ μ c ⊤ , a j K = arg ​ max c ∈ { 1 , … , G } ⁡ k ~ j ​ μ c ⊤ , a_{t}^{Q}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{c\in\{1,\ldots,G\}}\widetilde{q}_{t}\mu_{c}^{\top},\qquad a_{j}^{K}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{c\in\{1,\ldots,G\}}\widetilde{k}_{j}\mu_{c}^{\top}, (11) where q ~ t \widetilde{q}_{t} and k ~ j \widetilde{k}_{j} are normalized routing vectors. The centroids are updated online by mini-batch spherical k k -means, allowing the partition to follow the representation geometry learned by the model. For causal self-attention, the routing support of query t t consists of earlier keys assigned to the same centroid: ℐ t route = { j < t | a j K = a t Q } . \mathcal{I}_{t}^{\mathrm{route}}=\left\{j<t\;\middle|\;a_{j}^{K}=a_{t}^{Q}\right\}. (12) The query then performs exact Softmax attention within this support: r t route = softmax ⁡ ( q ~ t ​ ( K ~ ℐ t route ) ⊤ d ) ​ V ℐ t route . r_{t}^{\mathrm{route}}=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{\widetilde{q}_{t}(\widetilde{K}_{\mathcal{I}_{t}^{\mathrm{route}}})^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)V_{\mathcal{I}_{t}^{\mathrm{route}}}. (13) In practice, Routing Transformer assigns each centroid roughly L / G L/G queries and keys with the highest centroid similarity rather than allowing unconstrained cluster sizes; this balances parallel work but can give a token more than one membership. Its models also allocate separate heads to local attention so nearby evidence is preserved when clustering misses it. The resulting cost is O ⁡ ( L ​ G ​ d + L 2 ​ d / G ) O(LGd+L^{2}d/G) under balanced groups, minimized near G = L G=\sqrt{L} to O ⁡ ( L 3 / 2 ​ d ) O(L^{3/2}d) . This content adaptivity comes with assignment, sorting, group-size control, and load-balancing overhead, while non-contiguous members produce irregular gathers that are harder to map to accelerator tiles. These costs motivate later methods to fix the physical candidate unit as a page or contiguous block and focus on constructing an accurate low-cost score for each unit.

(13)在实践中,Routing Transformer为每个百分位机器人分配了大致为L / G L/G的查询和密钥,其百分位相似度最高,而不是允许不受约束的集群大小;这平衡了平行的工作,但可以给出一个以上的象征性成员. 它的模型还给当地人分别分配了头来关注,因此附近的证据在被分组错过时被保存. 由此产生的费用是O-(L G d + L 2 d / G)在平衡组内(LGd+L^{2}d/G),在G=L G=\sqt{L}至O-(L 3 / 2 d) O(L^{3/2}d)之间最小化。 这种内容的可适性会随着任务分配,排序,群大小控制,和负载平衡的起落起落而来,而非相接的成员则会产生不规则的集合,这些集合更难被映射到加速器平板. 这些费用促使以后采取一些方法,将实际候选单位固定为一页或相接区块,并侧重于为每个单位构建准确的低成本分数。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Block Aggregation
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 区块综合

blocks.en: Once candidates are fixed as contiguous blocks, routing reduces to scoring each block and expanding the selected blocks to their constituent KVs. A key distinction is whether those scores are derived from an unchanged dense checkpoint or from representations optimized under sparse support. This is not a strict chronological progression: training-free designs preserve retrofitability, whereas trainable designs trade additional optimization for a smaller dense-to-sparse mismatch.
blocks.zh: 一旦候选人被确定为毗连区块,出行路线会减少每个区块的得分,并将所选区块扩展至其构成的KV. 一个关键区别是,这些分数是来自于一个没有改变的密集检查站,还是来自于在稀少的支持下最优化的表述。 这不是严格的时间顺序进展:无培训设计保持了可改装性,而可培训设计则需要额外的优化,以适应密度小到不匹配的情况。

blocks.en: For an existing dense checkpoint that must be deployed without adaptation, block relevance can be estimated directly from its current query–key geometry. Quest bounds the largest possible query–key product within each page, while XAttention derives block scores from antidiagonal statistics [ 152 , 173 ] . Their appeal is immediate applicability without modifying model parameters; their limitation is that they approximate the attention behavior of a model never optimized for restricted support, so the dense-to-sparse mismatch can become more consequential as the retained budget shrinks.
blocks.zh: 对于一个必须不经调整而部署的现有密集检查站,可以直接从其目前的查询-关键几何学中估算出块的相关性。 XAtenty从反对角统计中得分[152,173]。 他们的吸引力是在不修改模型参数的情况下立即适用;他们的局限性是,他们与模型的注意行为近似于从未被优化为受限支持,因此密集到sparse不匹配会随着所保留预算的收缩而变得更加严重.

blocks.en: When training from scratch or continued adaptation is feasible, the model can instead learn to make block-level evidence reliable under sparse support. MoBA partitions KVs into contiguous blocks and represents each block ℬ u \mathcal{B}_{u} by the mean of its backbone keys: k ¯ u = 1 | ℬ u | ​ ∑ i ∈ ℬ u k i . \bar{k}_{u}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{B}_{u}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{B}_{u}}k_{i}. (14) For query q t q_{t} , it then computes the relevance of block u u by a query-to-mean-key inner product: e t , u MoBA = q t ​ k ¯ u ⊤ . e_{t,u}^{\mathrm{MoBA}}=q_{t}\bar{k}_{u}^{\top}. (15) MoBA selects the Top- k k historical blocks according to e t , u MoBA e_{t,u}^{\mathrm{MoBA}} and always adds the current block u t u_{t} : 𝒮 t MoBA = TopK u < u t ⁡ ( e t , u MoBA ; k ) ∪ { u t } . \mathcal{S}_{t}^{\mathrm{MoBA}}=\operatorname{TopK}_{u<u_{t}}\!\left(e_{t,u}^{\mathrm{MoBA}};k\right)\cup\{u_{t}\}. (16) Let ℐ t MoBA \mathcal{I}_{t}^{\mathrm{MoBA}} contain the causally visible token positions in the selected blocks. The final readout applies exact token-level Softmax to their original KVs: o t MoBA = softmax ⁡ ( q t ​ ( K ℐ t MoBA ) ⊤ d ) ​ V ℐ t MoBA . o_{t}^{\mathrm{MoBA}}=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{q_{t}(K_{\mathcal{I}_{t}^{\mathrm{MoBA}}})^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)V_{\mathcal{I}_{t}^{\mathrm{MoBA}}}. (17) Because scoring reuses the backbone’s Q/K space, sparse training can adapt those representations to make the coarse block score useful [ 92 ] . FlashMoBA preserves this routing rule but makes smaller blocks practical: tiled Top- k k avoids materializing the full query–block score matrix, and a gather-and-densify kernel packs irregularly selected queries into on-chip tiles for FlashAttention-style computation [ 168 ] .

blocks.en: Native Sparse Attention (NSA), introduced by DeepSeek-AI as a hardware-aligned and natively trainable sparse architecture, uses block aggregation within a three-branch design. Let ℓ c \ell_{c} , s c s_{c} , and ℓ s \ell_{s} denote the compression-block length, compression stride, and selection-block length, respectively. NSA first maps each completed compression block to a learned compressed key: K ~ t cmp = { ϕ K ( k i ​ s c + 1 : i ​ s c + ℓ c ) | 0 ≤ i ≤ ⌊ t − ℓ c s c ⌋ } . \widetilde{K}_{t}^{\mathrm{cmp}}=\left\{\phi_{K}\!\left(k_{is_{c}+1:is_{c}+\ell_{c}}\right)\;\middle|\;0\leq i\leq\left\lfloor\frac{t-\ell_{c}}{s_{c}}\right\rfloor\right\}. (18) Here ϕ K \phi_{K} is a learned compression MLP with intra-block positional encoding; compressed values V ~ t cmp \widetilde{V}_{t}^{\mathrm{cmp}} are constructed analogously. The compressed branch computes its query–key attention probabilities as p t cmp = softmax ⁡ ( q t ​ ( K ~ t cmp ) ⊤ d ) . p_{t}^{\mathrm{cmp}}=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{q_{t}(\widetilde{K}_{t}^{\mathrm{cmp}})^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}\right). (19) NSA reuses these probabilities as routing evidence. When compression and selection blocks have different boundaries, the score of selection block u u aggregates the probabilities of the overlapping compression blocks: p t slc ​ [ u ] = ∑ m = 0 ℓ s / s c − 1 ∑ r = 0 ℓ c / s c − 1 p t cmp ​ [ ℓ s s c ​ u − m − r ] , p_{t}^{\mathrm{slc}}[u]=\sum_{m=0}^{\ell_{s}/s_{c}-1}\sum_{r=0}^{\ell_{c}/s_{c}-1}p_{t}^{\mathrm{cmp}}\!\left[\frac{\ell_{s}}{s_{c}}u-m-r\right], (20) where out-of-range terms are taken as zero. For grouped-query attention, the scores of the H g H_{g} query heads sharing one KV head are summed before selection: p ^ t slc ​ [ u ] = ∑ h = 1 H g p t , h slc ​ [ u ] . \widehat{p}_{t}^{\mathrm{slc}}[u]=\sum_{h=1}^{H_{g}}p_{t,h}^{\mathrm{slc}}[u]. (21) The fine-grained branch then retains the Top- n n selection blocks according to the aggregated score: 𝒮 t NSA = TopK ⁡ ( p ^ t slc ; n ) . \mathcal{S}_{t}^{\mathrm{NSA}}=\operatorname{TopK}\!\left(\widehat{p}_{t}^{\mathrm{slc}};n\right). (22) The original-token KVs in 𝒮 t NSA \mathcal{S}_{t}^{\mathrm{NSA}} form the selected branch, while a sliding-window branch preserves recent local context. Input-dependent sigmoid gates weight the compressed, selected, and sliding-window branch outputs, whose weighted sum forms the final NSA readout. Thus, unlike MoBA’s single selected-block path, NSA uses the compressed summaries both as readable memory and as evidence for retrieving full-resolution content [ 182 ] .

blocks.en: Other trainable variants mainly change how block evidence is summarized. InfLLM-V2 combines multi-stage mean/max pooling with GQA-group aggregation and allows dense–sparse switching; DashAttention learns hierarchical pooling with α \alpha -entmax to allocate a variable support; and COBS compresses second-order statistics to estimate block attention mass [ 192 , 66 , 158 ] . Across these designs, adaptation can reduce dense-to-sparse mismatch, but summary maintenance, block-boundary errors, overfetch, and additional Readout paths remain part of the end-to-end cost.
blocks.zh: 其他可训练的变体主要改变块证据的总结方式. InfLLM-V2将多相正/最大集合与GQA-组集合结合,并允许密集的-sparse切换;DashAtenty用α\alpha-entmax学习分级集合,以分配可变支持;而COBS压缩二相统计,以估计块注意力质量[192,66,158]. 在整个这些设计中,适应可以减少密集到分层的不匹配,但简易维护,块边界错误,过度牵引,额外的Readout路径仍然是端到端成本的一部分.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Summary-Token Encoding
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 摘要编码

blocks.en: Summary-token methods insert learned tokens into the sequence and use their backbone representations as address memory. Landmark Attention places a landmark after each context block and uses a grouped Softmax in which a token’s effective probability depends on both its own key and its block landmark; the selected landmarks determine which original blocks are loaded [ 111 ] . Simplified Sparse Attention inserts gist tokens, trains them under a restricted mask to encode their chunks, and then attends over raw KVs from the selected chunks together with the selected gist representations. Its hierarchical extension adds meta-gists to reduce the cost of scanning all chunk summaries [ 93 ] .
blocks.zh: 总结式方法将所学到的符号插入到序列中并用其骨干表示作为地址内存. Landmark Note在每个上下文块后放置一个地标,并使用一个被分组的Softmax,其中一个符号的有效概率既取决于它自己的密钥,也取决于它的块地标;选定的地标决定了哪些原始块被装入 [111]. 简化 Sparse Content 插入 gist 符号,在受限制的口罩下对其进行训练以编码其块,然后在所选块的生 KV 上与所选 gist 表达符一起参加. 其分级扩展增加了元格来降低扫描所有块摘要的成本 [93].

blocks.en: HiLS targets the attention mass of each distant chunk rather than only its mean or maximum token score [ 64 ] . For query q t q_{t} and chunk ℬ u \mathcal{B}_{u} , let s t , j = q t ​ k j ⊤ / d s_{t,j}=q_{t}k_{j}^{\top}/\sqrt{d} ; the exact unnormalized chunk mass is Z t , u = ∑ j ∈ ℬ u exp ⁡ ( s t , j ) . Z_{t,u}=\sum_{j\in\mathcal{B}_{u}}\exp(s_{t,j}). (23) Computing Z t , u Z_{t,u} for every chunk would require all token-level query–key products. HiLS therefore appends a landmark token to each chunk and uses its learned query q u ′ q^{\prime}_{u} to construct a compact summary. The landmark query first induces an intra-chunk distribution, whose weighted key average becomes the summary key: α u , j = exp ⁡ ( q u ′ ​ k j ⊤ / d ) ∑ r ∈ ℬ u exp ⁡ ( q u ′ ​ k r ⊤ / d ) , k u ′ = ∑ j ∈ ℬ u α u , j ​ k j . \alpha_{u,j}=\frac{\exp\!\left(q^{\prime}_{u}k_{j}^{\top}/\sqrt{d}\right)}{\sum_{r\in\mathcal{B}_{u}}\exp\!\left(q^{\prime}_{u}k_{r}^{\top}/\sqrt{d}\right)},\qquad k^{\prime}_{u}=\sum_{j\in\mathcal{B}_{u}}\alpha_{u,j}k_{j}. (25) For the current query, HiLS combines summary relevance and aggregation entropy into a linear surrogate for the chunk’s LogSumExp score: s ^ t , u = q t ​ ( k u ′ ) ⊤ d + b u ′ ≈ log ⁡ Z t , u , Z ^ t , u = exp ⁡ ( s ^ t , u ) ≈ Z t , u . \widehat{s}_{t,u}=\frac{q_{t}(k^{\prime}_{u})^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}+b^{\prime}_{u}\approx\log Z_{t,u},\qquad\widehat{Z}_{t,u}=\exp(\widehat{s}_{t,u})\approx Z_{t,u}. blocks.en: 4.3 Auxiliary-Proxy Sparse Routing
blocks.zh: 4.3 辅助-辅助跑道

blocks.en: Auxiliary-proxy routing also selects support from the current content, but introduces an address representation whose parameters and training objective are distinct from the main attention projections. A lightweight indexer typically forms the proxy query and key through separate projections of backbone hidden states, for example q t I = h t ​ W Q I q_{t}^{I}=h_{t}W_{Q}^{I} and k u I = h u ​ W K I k_{u}^{I}=h_{u}W_{K}^{I} at token granularity; block-level methods may instead pool these proxy keys or construct one compressed proxy entry per block. The index-specific parameters W Q I W_{Q}^{I} and W K I W_{K}^{I} are learned independently of the main attention projections. The resulting proxy scores e t , u I = s I ​ ( q t I , k u I ) e_{t,u}^{I}=s_{I}(q_{t}^{I},k_{u}^{I}) determine which original K/V entries are selected. Depending on the method, these scores may be discarded after Access or may also influence Readout. Figure 6 makes the internal split explicit: the indexer maps query and candidate states into a compact address space, constructs selection evidence, and applies a budgeted selector; only the returned indices address the original K/V memory. For block routing, evidence can be formed by scoring pooled proxy keys or by aggregating token scores, so block-granular Access does not by itself imply a block-granular evidence scan. Decoupling makes the dimensionality, number of heads, update schedule, supervision, and routing granularity independently tunable. It also creates a second memory whose fidelity to the content-memory relevance relation must be learned and maintained.
blocks.zh: 辅助-代理路由也从当前内容中选择支持,但引入了地址表示,其参数和培训目标与主要关注预测不同. 轻量级索引器一般通过对骨干隐藏状态的单独预测来形成代理查询和密钥,例如q t I = h t W Q I q_{t}^{i}=h_{t}t}i}i}i}i}i}ku I = h u W K I k_{u}^{i}=h_{u} W_{K}^{I}I}I} 在符号颗粒性; 块级方法可以代替集合这些代理密钥, 或者每个块构造一个压缩代理条目 。 指数特定参数 W Q I W_{Q}^{I}和 W K I _{K}^{. 与主要注意力预测无关 由此产生的代理分数 e t, u I = s I (q t I, k u I) e_{t, u}^{I}=s_{I} (q_{t}^{I}, k_{u}^{I}) 确定 K/V 哪些条目被选中 。 视方法而定,这些分数可能在访问后被丢弃,或者也可能影响Readout. 图6明确了内部的分割:索引器将查询和候选状态映射成紧凑的地址空间,构建选择证据,并应用已编入预算的选择器;只有返回的索引处理原始的K/V内存. 对于块路由,可以由积分集合的代理密钥来形成证据,也可以通过汇总符号分数来形成证据,因此块-角取用本身并不意味着块-角取出证据扫描. 脱钩使维度、头数、更新时间表、监督和通路颗粒性可以独立捕捞。 它还创造了第二个记忆,必须了解并保持其对内容-记忆相关性关系的忠诚。

blocks.zh: 图6:一层内辅助-代用Sparse Content. 共享隐藏状态为主注意和索引路径; 符号或块级索引选择决定 K/V 条目到达 Sparse 注意 。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Token-Granularity Routing
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 托肯地貌 路线

blocks.en: Token-granularity proxies maintain a separately addressable entry for each historical token. TokenButler projects hidden states and cached keys into a low-dimensional importance space, distills the proxy from dense attention distributions, and amortizes predictions through intervals and neighbor fetching [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: Token-granularity 代理为每个历史标志保留一个单独的可地址条目. TokenButler 预测隐藏状态和缓存键入低维重要性空间,从密集的注意力分布中分馏出代理,并通过间隔和相邻取取取来进行分期还原预测[3].

blocks.en: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) from DeepSeek-V3.2 introduces a lightweight Lightning Indexer for routing [ 32 ] . The indexer has an MQA-style structure in which several index query heads share a single index key per token (left column of Figure 7 ). For query t t and a preceding token u u , its proxy score is e t , u I = ∑ h = 1 H I w t , h I ​ ReLU ⁡ ( q t , h I ​ ( k u I ) ⊤ ) , e_{t,u}^{I}=\sum_{h=1}^{H_{I}}w_{t,h}^{I}\,\operatorname{ReLU}\!\left(q_{t,h}^{I}(k_{u}^{I})^{\top}\right), (29) where H I H_{I} is the number of index heads, q t , h I q_{t,h}^{I} is the query of index head h h , k u I k_{u}^{I} is the index key shared by all heads, and the query-dependent scalar weights w t , h I w_{t,h}^{I} fuse the per-head scores into one token-level score. The Top- k k tokens under e t , : I e_{t,:}^{I} form a single support shared by all attention heads, because the main attention runs MLA in its MQA mode, where each latent KV entry serves every query head; the index scores only determine this support and do not enter Readout. The indexer is supervised by a KL loss toward the main attention scores summed over heads and renormalized over tokens: a short dense warmup trains only the indexer over the full context, after which the loss is restricted to the selected tokens while the whole model adapts to sparse support, and the indexer input is detached so that the indexer and the backbone learn only from the KL and language-modeling losses, respectively.

blocks.en: LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) extends the DSA Lightning Indexer to relieve two of its deployment bottlenecks, the full-length index scan and the discontinuous KV access induced by token-level selection. Streaming-Aware Indexing reserves part of the support budget for a fixed sink and sliding window while using the remainder for dynamic token selection, improving the contiguity of KV access. Hierarchical Indexing first recalls candidate blocks with approximate scores and then performs fine-grained token selection within those blocks, reducing index computation while retaining token-level final support [ 187 ] .
blocks.zh: LongCat Sparse Content (LSA) 扩展了DSA闪电索引器以缓解其部署瓶颈的两个,即全长索引扫描和由符号级选择所引发的不连续KV访问. 将部分支持预算用于固定的汇和滑动窗口,同时将剩余部分用于动态符号选择,提高KV访问的连续性。 分级索引首先会回顾具有相近分数的候选人块,然后在这些块内进行精细的符号选择,减少索引的计算,同时保留符号级的最终支持[187].

blocks.en: SAS learns a continuous context-ranking gate and incorporates the gate score into attention logits, allowing the language-model objective to optimize both ranking under a finite budget and the subsequent Readout [ 84 ] . TokenButler, DSA, and SAS thus respectively illustrate plug-in distillation, native mask-oriented indexing, and end-to-end coupling between proxy evidence and readout weights.
blocks.zh: SAS学习了连续的上下文分级门,并将入门分数纳入注意力记录,使语言模型目标在有限的预算下和随后的Readout [84] 下都能够优化排名. 因此,TokenButler,DSA,和SAS分别说明了插入蒸馏,以本土口罩为导向的索引,以及代理证据和读取权重之间的端到端相接.

blocks.en: Binary proxies reduce the storage and comparison cost of each address entry. HashAttention learns mappings from queries and key–value pairs to a Hamming space and retrieves pivotal tokens by binary similarity before applying attention to the selected original KVs [ 36 ] . HATA trains query and key codes to preserve the relative ordering required for Top- k k selection and co-designs binary scoring with a sparse-attention kernel [ 52 ] . Binary coding lowers per-entry cost, but it does not change the O ⁡ ( L ) O(L) number of token-level index entries. The router must still scan or retrieve candidates and then gather KVs from potentially scattered positions.
blocks.zh: 二进制代理降低每个地址条目的存储和比较成本. HashAttenty从查询和密钥-值对到汉明空间学习映射,并在对所选原始 KV 应用注意前通过二进制相似取出枢轴符 [36]. HATA列车查询和密钥代码,以保留Top-k 选择和并发设计二进制评分需要的相对顺序,并带有稀疏的心核 [52]. 二进制编码会降低每进制成本,但不会改变O QQ(L) O(L) 级指数条目数. 路由器仍必须扫描或取回候选人,然后从可能分散的位置收集KV.

blocks.en: Token routing minimizes block overfetch and can recover isolated evidence. Its limiting resource at very long context may nevertheless be index bandwidth rather than arithmetic. A low-dimensional or binary proxy is useful only if its reduced comparison cost exceeds the cost of reading the full proxy sequence, performing Top- k k , and gathering irregular content memory.
blocks.zh: 托肯通路可以将块的牵引力最小化并可以回收孤立的证据. 然而,它在非常长的语境中有限的资源可能是指数带宽,而不是算术。 低维或二进制代理只有在其降低的比较成本超过读取全代理序列,执行Top-k k,并收集不规则内容内存的成本时才有用.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Block-Granularity and Compressed-Entry Routing
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 区块宽度和压缩入围

blocks.en: Block-granularity routing uses a contiguous unit for final selection and content access. SeerAttention learns a lightweight predictor over pooled Q/K representations and distills block importance from dense attention; the resulting AttnGate chooses original-token KV blocks [ 44 ] . SeerAttention-R extends the mechanism to decoding, shares selection within GQA groups, and maintains a compressed key index [ 42 ] . SpotAttention learns a calibrated block distribution and uses dual Top- p p rules to allocate different budgets across queries and layers [ 1 ] . These methods improve access regularity while retaining the full-resolution KVs inside selected blocks, but all three train the router as a plug-in on a frozen pretrained model, so the backbone itself never adapts to block-sparse support.
blocks.zh: 区块-地块通路使用相接单元进行最终选择和内容访问. SeerAtty从密集的注意力中学习出一个轻量级预测器来比集合的Q/K表示和分馏块重要性;由此而来的AttnGate选择了原始的KV块 [44]. SeerAttenty-R将机制扩展为解码,在GQA组内共享选择,并保持压缩密钥索引 [42]. SpotAttenty学习了校正块分布,并使用Top-p双向规则在查询和分层之间分配不同的预算[1]. 这些方法提高了访问的规律性,同时保留了所选区块内的全分辨率KV,但所有3个列车都将路由器作为被冻结的预训模型上的插件,因此骨干本身从不适应区块-sparse支持.

blocks.en: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) instead trains the backbone under its block-sparse support. MSA is a block-sparse extension of GQA used in MiniMax-M3, a natively multimodal MoE model with about 428B total and 23B activated parameters that applies MSA in 57 of its 60 layers [ 79 , 105 ] . Its Index Branch shares the MQA-style structure of the DSA Lightning Indexer (middle column of Figure 7 ) but differs in the role of the index heads: instead of fusing them into one support shared by all attention heads, MSA assigns one index head to each GQA group, so each index head selects support independently for its own group. Index scores are computed at token level, between the index query and every visible index key, whereas selection operates at block level: for index head h h , each contiguous KV block u u is scored by the maximum of its token scores, e t , u , h I = max i ∈ ℬ u , i ≤ t ⁡ q t , h I ​ ( k i I ) ⊤ d I , e_{t,u,h}^{I}=\max_{i\in\mathcal{B}_{u},\;i\leq t}\frac{q_{t,h}^{I}(k_{i}^{I})^{\top}}{\sqrt{d_{I}}}, (30) where ℬ u \mathcal{B}_{u} is the set of token positions in block u u and d I d_{I} is the index dimension. The Top- k k blocks under e t , : , h I e_{t,:,h}^{I} are kept together with the block containing the query, over which the query heads of the corresponding GQA group compute exact Softmax attention. Supervision follows the DSA recipe—a KL loss toward the Main Branch attention on the selected tokens, preceded by a full-attention warmup and confined to the index projections by stop-gradients—except that the teacher is averaged over the query heads of each group.
blocks.zh: MiniMax Sparse Content (MSA) 转而在其块-sparse支持下训练主干. MSA是MiniMax-M3中使用的GQA的块状扩展,是一种本土多式MOE模型,总参数约为428B,活性参数为23B,其60层中的57个应用了MSA[79,105]. 其索引分会共享DSA闪电索引器的MQA风格结构(图7的中行列),但在索引头的作用上却有所不同:MSA不是将它们接入所有关注头共享的一个支持,而是为每个GQA组分配一个索引头,因此每个索引头独立选择给自己的组的支持. 指数分数按符号级别计算,介于索引查询和每个可见索引密钥之间,而选择则按块级别进行: 对于指数头 h h ,每个相接的 KV 块 u u 以其符号分数的最大分数 e t, u, h I = 最大 (原始内容存档于2018-10-21) (中文(中国大陆) ). . . . t}\frac{q_{t,h}^{I} (k_{i}^{I})^{\top}}{\sqrt{d_{I}}}(30),其中B mathcal{B}_{u}是u u 和 d I d_{I} 中符号位置的一组是索引维度. Top- k k k blocks under e t, : h I e_{t, :, h}^{I} 与包含查询的块一起保存, 对应的 GQA 组的查询头计算出准确的 Softmax 注意. 监督遵循DSA的配方,即KL对主要部门所选择的标志的注意力减少,先是全心全意地取暖,然后是按停学率进行指数预测,但教师平均在每一组的询问头上。

blocks.en: MSA thus uses block-granular Access but a token-granular evidence scan, trading the token-level localization of DSA for regular per-group KV reads. Because the index scan still touches every visible token, its cost continues to grow with context length and ultimately bounds the attainable speedup; regular KV reads do not by themselves reduce the computation and bandwidth consumed by the proxy.
blocks.zh: 因此,管理事务协议使用块状角 访问但指向符号-正方形证据扫描,将DSA的符号级本地化交换为每个组的普通KV读取. 由于索引扫描仍然触及到每个可见的标志,其成本随上下文长度而继续增长,并最终将可实现的速度限制在外;常规KV读取本身并不会减少被代理所消耗的计算和带宽.

blocks.en:
Compressed-entry routing changes the address representation more aggressively. Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA) compresses the index key sequence into micro-block representations before scoring, thereby shrinking the index scan itself rather than only the final selection [ 128 , 135 ] . In Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Table 18 ), QSA replaces the full-attention layers during continued pretraining, with one QSA layer following every three Gated DeltaNet layers. Its indexer shares the MQA-style structure of MSA, but where MSA pools token scores, QSA pools the index keys themselves: the shared key sequence is average-pooled over non-overlapping micro-blocks before positional encoding, so each micro-block receives one content summary and one block position. -\infty,&\text{otherwise},\end{cases} (31) so per-head scores are summed without the query-dependent weights of Eq. ( 29 ), and only fully observed micro-blocks are scored. Even though the core attention uses GQA, QSA does not select per group as MSA does: the fused score e t , u I e_{t,u}^{I} yields a single selection that all GQA groups share. The Top- k k micro-blocks under e t , : I e_{t,:}^{I} are expanded to their original token positions and joined with the tokens of the current incomplete micro-block, over which core attention reads original-token KVs. Training follows the two stages of DSA—indexer-only dense distillation, then sparse training of the whole model with the KL restricted to the selected blocks—except that the token-level teacher distribution is max-pooled within each micro-block and renormalized to match the block-level scores. Because the index scan shrinks by the micro-block size while content stays at token resolution, QSA compresses addresses without compressing content. In short, DSA and MSA both score every visible token and differ in whether index heads are fused into token scores or token scores are max-pooled into per-group block scores, whereas QSA pools the keys before scoring and is the only one of the three that shortens the index scan.

blocks.en: Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) goes further and compresses content as well [ 33 ] . Introduced in DeepSeek-V4, where it alternates with Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) layers that compress more aggressively and attend densely, CSA merges the KV entries of every m m tokens into one entry by learned, overlapping weighted pooling, applies the same compression to the index keys, and scores the compressed blocks with the DSA indexer: c ¯ u = ∑ i ∈ ℬ u − 1 ∪ ℬ u π u , i ⊙ c u , i , e t , u I = ∑ h = 1 H I w t , h I ​ ReLU ⁡ ( q t , h I ​ ( k ¯ u I ) ⊤ ) , \bar{c}_{u}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{B}_{u-1}\cup\mathcal{B}_{u}}\pi_{u,i}\odot c_{u,i},\qquad e_{t,u}^{I}=\sum_{h=1}^{H_{I}}w_{t,h}^{I}\,\operatorname{ReLU}\!\left(q_{t,h}^{I}(\bar{k}_{u}^{I})^{\top}\right), (32) where c u , i c_{u,i} is a per-token projection serving as both key and value, π u , i \pi_{u,i} are channel-wise softmax weights over the current and preceding blocks, and k ¯ u I \bar{k}_{u}^{I} is the compressed index key. The Top- k k compressed entries, together with an uncompressed sliding window that covers the query’s incomplete block, form the eligible content view used by Readout. Because this view holds compressed entries rather than token KVs, CSA reduces index length, attention work, and resident content memory at the cost of item-level fidelity. QSA and CSA together show why Memory Representation must distinguish address compression from content compression.

blocks.en: Block selection offers fewer routing units and more regular gathers, but it reads irrelevant tokens whenever importance is concentrated inside a block. If evidence is still computed at token resolution, the proxy scan remains linear in the number of tokens. If both the index and content are compressed by a factor m m , the scanned sequence can shrink from L L to approximately L / m L/m , but the reduction is purchased with coarser routing resolution and, for compressed content, reduced recoverability of individual details.
blocks.zh: 区块选择提供了较少的路由单元和更规律的集合,但只要重要集中在区块内,它就会读取无关紧要的符号. 如果证据仍然按符号分辨率计算,则代理扫描在符号数量上仍然是线性. 如果索引和内容均被一个系数mm所压缩,扫描序列可以从L收缩到大约L / m L/m,但减少是用同位素路由分辨率购买的,为压缩内容,个人细节的可回收性会降低.

blocks.en: 4.4 Temporal and Cross-Layer Reuse
blocks.zh: 4.4 时间和跨时间重复使用

blocks.en: Once content-adaptive Access can produce a useful support, a complementary optimization is to avoid recomputing similar decisions at every decoding step and layer. Two distinct objects can be reused. Temporal support reuse uses a history of prior query–support relations to propose candidates for a new decoding query, after which a method may rerank or refresh them. Cross-layer reuse lets a non-anchor layer inherit selected positions from an anchor layer; more aggressive designs also let it read K/V content produced by a source layer. These mechanisms change when Access decisions and content states are refreshed rather than defining a new evidence representation. They can therefore be layered onto structure-, self-, or proxy-routed candidate generation and are treated here as cross-cutting lifecycle attributes rather than a mutually exclusive family.
blocks.zh: 一经内容适应 访问可以产生有用的支持,互补的优化是避免在每一个解码步骤和分层重编类似的决定. 有两个不同的物体可以被再利用. Timoral 支持再使用使用前置查询 - 支持关系的历史为新的解码查询推荐候选人,之后一种方法可能会重新排序或刷新. 跨层再利用让一个非锚地层从锚地层中继承所选位置;更积极的设计也让其读取由源地层产生的K/V内容. 这些机制在Access决定和内容被更新而不是界定新的证据表述时发生变化。 因此,它们可以被分解到结构、自我或代用模式的候选一代中,并在此被视为交叉生命周期属性,而不是相互排斥的家庭。

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Temporal Support Reuse
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 临时支助

blocks.en: Temporal support reuse exploits the observation that nearby or semantically similar decoding queries often retrieve many of the same historical tokens. Rather than accepting an earlier support as the current answer, these methods use past selections only to construct a smaller candidate set. The current query then recomputes exact QK scores over those candidates, selects its own support, and applies ordinary sparse Softmax to the original KVs. Temporal reuse therefore reduces the cost of discovering candidates without reusing stale attention weights or discarding the full KV cache.
blocks.zh: Temperal支持再用利用了一种观察,即附近或相近的解码查询常常取回许多相同的历史符号. 这些方法不是接受先前的支持作为目前的答案,而是使用过去的选择来构建一个较小的候选人集. 当前的查询然后比这些考生重新计算准确的QK分数,选择自己的支持,并将普通的稀有软max应用于原始的KV. 因此,临时再利用可以降低发现候选物的成本,而无需重新使用沉积的注意力重量或丢弃完整的KV缓存.

blocks.en: The main failure mode is support drift: similar queries need not require identical evidence, and errors can accumulate when supports produced by reuse are inserted back into the cache. ReTopK therefore falls back to full-history exact Top- K K when the maximum cached-query similarity is below a threshold and periodically performs an exact refresh. Its efficiency depends on the cache capacity, number R R of recalled supports, recent-window width, fallback rate, and refresh interval. If these quantities remain bounded, reranking touches at most the union of R R supports and the recent window rather than the full history; if fallback is frequent or the union becomes large, the advantage correspondingly shrinks.
blocks.zh: 主要故障模式是支持漂移:类似的查询不需要相同的证据,当再利用产生的支持被插入回缓存时,错误可以累积. ReTopK因此在最大缓存-平滑相似度低于阈值并定期进行精确的刷新时倒回了全史准确的Top-K. 其效率取决于缓存容量,被召回支持的R号,最近的窗口宽度,回落率,以及刷新间隔. 如果这些数量仍然有限制,则最多会重新排序地触及R的联盟和最近的窗口,而不是整个历史;如果经常出现倒转或联盟变大,则优势相应收缩。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Cross-Layer Reuse
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 跨层再使用

blocks.en: The simplest cross-layer strategy shares selected positions. TidalDecode observes persistence in selected positions across adjacent layers: a small set of selection layers performs full attention and generates indices, while intervening layers reuse them [ 176 ] . Kascade similarly computes exact Top- k k only at calibrated anchor layers and uses dynamic programming to choose where those anchors should be placed [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 最简单的跨层战略共享所选位置. 潮下带观测到在相邻地层的选定位置上的持久性:一小组选择地层进行充分的注意并生成指数,而中间地层则重复使用它们[176]. Kascade类似地计算出精确的Top-k k只在被校正锚地层,并使用动态编程来选择这些锚地应放在哪里[37].

blocks.en:
IndexCache applies this principle directly to the learned indexers of DSA. It assigns every layer one of two roles: an F (Full) layer runs its indexer over the full history and caches fresh Top- k k indices, whereas an S (Shared) layer omits its indexer and inherits the indices from the nearest preceding F layer. If c ℓ ∈ { F , S } c_{\ell}\in\{\mathrm{F},\mathrm{S}\} denotes the role of layer ℓ \ell , the support is ℐ t ( ℓ ) = { TopK ( e t , : I , ( ℓ ) ; k ) , c ℓ = F , ℐ t ( f ⁡ ( ℓ ) ) , c ℓ = S , f ( ℓ ) = max { j < ℓ : c j = F } . \mathcal{I}_{t}^{(\ell)}=\begin{cases}\operatorname{TopK}\!\left(e_{t,:}^{I,(\ell)};k\right),&c_{\ell}=\mathrm{F},\\
\mathcal{I}_{t}^{(f(\ell))},&c_{\ell}=\mathrm{S},\end{cases}\qquad f(\ell)=\max\{j<\ell:c_{j}=\mathrm{F}\}. (36) The first layer is always Full, and each later Full layer overwrites the temporary index cache, so reuse adds no persistent index buffer beyond the one already required by DSA. The training-free variant greedily chooses which indexers to retain by measuring language-modeling loss on a calibration set, because uniformly spaced Full layers can remove unusually important indexers. The training-aware variant instead distills each retained indexer from the attention distributions of all layers that will share its output, encouraging one support to serve the whole layer group rather than only its anchor layer [ 10 ] . GLM-5.2 deploys this mechanism under the name IndexShare, with one indexer shared by every four sparse-attention layers; GLM-5.3 retains the same base architecture and therefore the same cross-layer indexing design [ 183 , 185 ] .

blocks.en: More extensive reuse shares content memory as well as discrete indices. YOIO/CLSA starts from a self-decoder/cross-decoder architecture: the self-decoder writes one cross-layer KV memory, a single-head query-aware indexer computes token-level Top- k k routing once over that memory, and every cross-decoder layer reads its own query-dependent values from the same selected support. A multi-layer distillation target averaged over decoder layers and attention heads trains the shared indexer to preserve tokens that are jointly useful across the stack [ 150 ] .
blocks.zh: 更广泛的再利用共享内容存储以及离散指数。 YOIO/CLSA从一个自解码器/跨解码器架构开始:自解码器写出一个跨层的KV内存,一个单头的查询-意识索引器计算出该内存上一次的符号级别Top-k的路由,每个跨解码器层都会从同一个所选支持读取自己的依赖查询的值. 一个多层蒸馏目标平均在解码层上,注意头会训练共享索引器,以保存跨堆[150]共同有用的符号.

blocks.en: Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) was introduced by DeepSeek-AI in the technical report DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression as the successor to the CSA mechanism used in DeepSeek-V4 [ 34 ] . It targets two remaining long-context costs jointly: storing separate global KVs at every layer and repeatedly scanning the full index at every layer. CSA2 therefore shares main KVs and indexer keys across depth while allowing the schedule for refreshing sparse indices to be controlled separately.
blocks.zh: DeepSeek-AI在"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash:推开KV Cache压缩的极限"技术报告中引入了压缩Sparse Content 2 (CSA2),作为DeepSeek-V4 [34]中使用的CSA机制的后继. 它的目标是两个剩余的长文本成本:将单独的全球KV存储在每一层,并反复扫描每一层的全部索引。 因此,CSA2分享了主要的KV和索引器密钥,同时允许对刷新稀有指数的时间表进行单独控制。

blocks.en:
Every CSA2 layer is statically assigned one of three modes. A Full layer computes fresh main KVs and indexer keys, scans all causally visible positions, and produces fresh Top- k k indices. In the decoder, the first Full layer also builds a larger candidate pool 𝒫 t CSA2 \mathcal{P}_{t}^{\mathrm{CSA2}} that is reused by later indexing layers. A Reindex layer reuses the main KVs and indexer keys from the most recent Full layer, but forms its own index query and refreshes the Top- k k support within that shared candidate pool. A Reuse layer skips index scoring and inherits the latest support produced by either a Full or Reindex layer. If m ℓ ∈ { F , R , U } m_{\ell}\in\{\mathrm{F},\mathrm{R},\mathrm{U}\} is the mode of layer ℓ \ell and r ⁡ ( ℓ ) r(\ell) is its nearest preceding index-producing layer, the reuse schedule is ℐ t ( ℓ ) = { TopK i ≤ t ⁡ ( e t , i I , ( ℓ ) ; k ) , m ℓ = F , TopK i ∈ 𝒫 t CSA2 ⁡ ( e t , i I , ( ℓ ) ; k ) , m ℓ = R , ℐ t ( r ⁡ ( ℓ ) ) , m ℓ = U . \mathcal{I}_{t}^{(\ell)}=\begin{cases}\operatorname{TopK}_{i\leq t}\!\left(e_{t,i}^{I,(\ell)};k\right),&m_{\ell}=\mathrm{F},\\
\operatorname{TopK}_{i\in\mathcal{P}_{t}^{\mathrm{CSA2}}}\!\left(e_{t,i}^{I,(\ell)};k\right),&m_{\ell}=\mathrm{R},\\
\mathcal{I}_{t}^{(r(\ell))},&m_{\ell}=\mathrm{U}.\end{cases} (37) All three modes still compute their own main query and local sliding-window KVs. Full layers refresh shared content, address entries, and support; Reindex layers refresh only the support against reused address entries; and Reuse layers refresh none of them. YOIO/CLSA therefore provides the simpler shared-memory baseline before CSA2 introduces selective reindexing and hierarchical candidate narrowing; this conceptual progression also matches their publication order.

blocks.en: HySparse alternates occasional full-attention layers with groups of sparse layers. It extracts block-level maximum attention scores from a full layer, reuses them as selection evidence for later sparse layers, shares the full layer’s KVs, and preserves local information through a separate sliding-window branch [ 43 ] . HySparse2 refines the sparse-attention path in three ways: it replaces block-level retrieval with token-level selection to avoid block overfetch, reuses both the full layer’s KVs and selected indices across the following sparse layers, and forces a recent window into the selected token set. Local and retrieved tokens therefore use one unified sparse-attention operation over a shared KV cache rather than separate global and sliding-window branches [ 165 ] . This design retains fine-grained retrieval while amortizing index computation and KV storage across each group of layers.
blocks.zh: HySparse的替补层偶尔会与稀有地层的组齐全. 它从一整层提取出块级最大注意分数,再用来作为后期稀有地层的选取证据,共享全层的KV,并通过单独的滑窗分支保存本地信息 [43]. HySparse2以三种方式完善了稀疏的注意路径:它用符号级选择来取代块级检索,以避免块级的过度牵引;在下面稀疏的地层重复使用全层的KV和所选索引;并迫使最近的一个窗口进入所选的符号集. 因此,当地和检索到的代币使用一个共享的KV缓存上的统一稀有代理操作,而不是单独的全局和滑动窗口分支[165]. 这种设计保留了精细的取用,同时将指数计算和KV存储分出到每组地层.

blocks.en: Reuse amortizes selection and can also reduce duplicated memory when index and content states are shared. The corresponding loss is specificity. Temporal reuse can lag behind changes in the current query; cross-layer reuse can suppress differences in what shallow and deep layers need to retrieve. Selection or reindex frequency, reuse span, representation compatibility, and correction policy must therefore be reported alongside accuracy and throughput. A claimed speedup should also separate savings in router computation from savings in index traffic, KV traffic, and resident memory.
blocks.zh: 重新使用分期摊还选择,也可以减少索引和内容状态共享时的重复内存. 相应的损失是特异性. 时间再利用可以落后于当前查询的变化;跨层再利用可以抑制浅层和深层需要检索的差异. 因此,必须报告选择或重新索引频率、再利用周期、表示兼容性以及校正政策,同时报告准确性和吞吐量。 所主张的速度还应将路由器计算方面的节余同指数流量、KV流量和居民记忆方面的节余分开。

blocks.en: 4.5 Summary
blocks.zh: 4.5 总结

blocks.en: Across these families, the design trajectory reflects a shift in who decides where to attend . The earliest designs fixed the support structurally—local, strided, or dilated patterns set before training [ 25 , 14 , 186 , 38 ] —and later sink-plus-window rules or profiled pattern families applied structural constraints to trained dense checkpoints [ 170 , 70 ] . Self-routing restored content adaptivity by letting the backbone score candidates from its own representations, progressing from hashing or clustering [ 77 , 139 ] and training-free block estimation on a dense checkpoint [ 152 , 173 ] to training the model under its own sparsity, where learned block summaries drive selection [ 182 , 92 ] . Auxiliary-proxy routing then moved address computation into a separate, distilled index, tunable in dimensionality and granularity and coarsened from tokens to blocks and compressed entries to shrink the index itself [ 44 , 32 ] . As context windows reach one million tokens and beyond, this per-layer index scan becomes the bottleneck, pushing the frontier from constructing a support to managing its lifecycle—sharing address and content memory and reusing selections across steps and layers [ 33 , 34 , 150 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些家庭的设计轨迹反映了由谁决定到哪里去的转变。 最早的设计确定了培训前设定的支助结构——地方性、有条理或分化模式[25、14、186、38]——以及后来的沉积+窗口规则或概况模式家庭对训练有素的密集检查站适用结构限制[170、70]。 自通路恢复了内容的适应性,让骨干候选人从自己的代表得到分数,从散列或集群[77,139],从密集检查站的无培训区块估计[152,173],到培训模式的自通地块,其中学习区块摘要驱动选择[182,92]. 辅助-代用路由然后将地址计算移入一个单独的蒸馏指数,在维度和颗粒度上可捕取,并被从符号到块和被压缩的条目相接以缩小指数本身[44,32]. 随着上下文窗口达到一百万个信使和超过100万个信使,这种每层指数扫描就成为瓶颈,推动前沿从构建支持到管理其生命周期——共享地址和内容内存以及跨步骤和分层重用选择[33、34、150]。

blocks.en: This trajectory has steadily narrowed the gap to dense attention. Training-free sparsity is ultimately an approximation and inherits a training–inference mismatch, so its quality degrades once the retained budget drops below the evidence a task needs. Methods trained under their own sparse support behave differently: because the parameters adapt to a finite candidate set, natively trained selective attention and distilled-then-continued indexers now report quality on par with dense attention—and, at long context, occasionally above it—while cutting both prefill and per-step decoding cost [ 182 , 92 , 32 ] . This parity is conditional rather than universal: it holds when the router is trained end-to-end, the budget matches the task’s evidence density, and the reported speedup accounts for evidence construction, index traffic, and gathering rather than only the final sparse matrix multiplication. Within those conditions, trained sparse attention is a credible option for long-context deployment rather than merely a lossy fallback, although its margin over dense attention remains task-, budget-, and implementation-dependent.
blocks.zh: 这一轨迹稳步缩小了差距,使其受到高度关注。 无培训的麻痹最终是一种近似现象,继承了一种培训-推论不匹配,因此一旦保留预算低于任务需要的证据,其质量会下降。 在自己稀少支助下培训的方法表现不同:因为参数适应了有限的一组候选人,本土培训的选择性关注和提炼的、当时持续的索引编制者现在报告的质量与密集的注意相当——在很长的上下文中有时高于——同时削减预填和分步解码费用[182、92、32]。 这种对等性是有条件的,而不是普遍的:当路由器经过培训后,预算会与任务的证据密度相匹配,报告的速度会说明证据构建、指数流量和收集,而不仅仅是最后的稀有矩阵乘法。 在这些条件下,训练有素的很少注意是长期部署的可靠选择,而不只是回落,尽管它相对于密集关注的幅度仍然取决于任务、预算和执行。

blocks.en: Accordingly, sparse attention has moved from research prototypes into production LLMs, where deployed designs use auxiliary-proxy routing at token (DSA), block (MSA), or compressed-entry (QSA and CSA) granularity, and a subset of recent releases adds cross-layer reuse. DeepSeek-V3.2 pairs each latent token with a low-dimensional index key scored by a Lightning Indexer, aligned to dense attention by distillation and then trained under sparse support [ 32 ] ; DeepSeek-V4 aggregates index keys and KV entries into a compressed global memory combined with a sliding window [ 33 ] ; and DeepSeek-V4.1-flash organizes layers into Full, Reindex, and Reuse modes that share indexer keys and KVs along depth [ 34 ] . Qwen3.8-flash-next compresses token routing keys into micro-block indices that expand to original-token KVs [ 135 ] , MiniMax scores token-level index keys and max-pools them into block selections [ 79 ] , and later GLM designs incorporate cross-layer index sharing [ 183 ] . LongCat-2.0 and LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse deploy LSA, combining streaming-aware support, hierarchical index scoring, and cross-layer index reuse [ 187 , 96 ] . The emerging recipe—a learned, compact index, optionally compressed across positions, aligned through native training or distillation and continued training, and increasingly reused across depth—shows that the mechanism-level developments surveyed here now underpin mainstream long-context architectures.
blocks.zh: 因此,人们的注意力从研究原型转移到生产LLMS, 所部署的设计在符号(DSA),块(MSA),或压缩入地(QSA和CSA)颗粒上使用辅助-代用路由,最近释放的子集增加了跨层再利用. DeepSeek-V3.2每副潜入的指使,由闪电索引器打出低维指数键,通过蒸馏来配合密集的注意,然后在稀有支持下被训练[32]; DeepSeek-V4汇总索引键和KV条目并结合滑动窗口[33]; DeepSeek-V4.1-flash将分层组织成Full,Reindex,再用模式沿深度共享索引键和KVs[34]. Quen3.8-flash-next将符号路由键压缩为微块指数,扩展为正本 KVs [135],MiniMax 得分为符号级索引键并最大集合为块选择 [79],后期GLM设计包含跨层指数共享 [183]. LongCat-2.0和LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse部署LSA,结合了流传-意识支持,分级指数分数,并跨层指数再用[187,96]. 新兴的食谱——一种精通的、紧凑的指数,通过本土培训或蒸馏和继续培训可选择地压缩各种位置,并越来越多地在深度范围内重复使用——表明,这里所调查的机制层面的发展目前是主流长文结构的基础。

blocks.en: 5 Linear Attention
blocks.zh: 5 线性注意

blocks.en: Softmax Attention preserves contextual history as an enumerable collection of token- or chunk-level key–value representations, whereas Sparse Attention primarily restricts which of these explicit memory units are eligible for a query. Linear Attention changes the memory substrate itself: by exploiting factorizable query–key interactions, it accumulates historical key–value associations into one or more recurrently maintained associative states without retaining the complete token-wise KV history. The canonical formulation maintains a context-length-independent state, while later variants enlarge or partition the associative space, preserve multiple states over different temporal ranges, or construct block-level associative summaries. Linear Attention therefore trades item-wise historical addressability for recurrent compression, shifting the central design problem from selecting among stored tokens to determining how compressed associative memory is represented, updated, accessed, and read.
blocks.zh: Softmax 注意保存了背景历史,作为可假设的符号或块级密钥值表达式的集合,而Sparse 注意主要限制这些明确的内存单元中哪一个有资格进行查询。 Linear 注意会改变内存基底本身:通过利用可分解的查询 - key 交互,它将历史的 key - 值关联累积为一个或多个经常维护的关联状态,而不保留完整的按键 KV 历史. 犬形配体保持上下文长度独立的状态,而后期的变体会扩大或分割同形空间,在不同的时间范围内保留多相状态,或构造同形分相的分相摘要. 因此,Linear Content通过按项目处理历史可处理性来进行经常性压缩,将中央设计问题从选择所储存的符号转向确定压缩关联内存的表示、更新、访问和阅读方式。

blocks.en: Because the term Linear Attention covers several related formulations, we focus here on causal mechanisms that represent contextual history through one or more recurrently maintained associative states. Starting from the kernel-factorized formulation of Linear Transformer, we examine how this memory is accumulated, retained, corrected, expanded, accessed, and read. This perspective also includes gated Linear RNNs whose principal operation is associative state editing. Methods developed primarily from structured state-space dynamics are discussed in Section 6 , while architectures that combine Linear Attention with explicit attention or other heterogeneous sequence mixers are examined in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: 由于"线性关注"(Linear Content)一词包括了几种相關的提法,我们在此集中探讨通过一个或多个反复维护的关联状态代表上下文历史的因果机制. 从内核因子化的Linear Transformer的配方开始,我们研究这种内存如何被积累,保留,纠正,扩充,访问,读取. 这一视角还包括主要操作为关联状态编辑的有门的Linear RNNs. 第6节讨论了主要从结构化的状态-空间动态发展出的方法,第7节则审查了将线性注意与明确注意或其他不同序列混合器相结合的结构。

blocks.en: Within the framework introduced in Section 2 , the development of Linear Attention begins with a fundamental change in Memory Representation and Memory Update. Its canonical formulation replaces an enumerable token-wise history with an associative matrix state and recurrently incorporates new key–value associations into this compressed representation. Later methods refine the state transition through retention, correction, erasure, and controlled writing, while enlarging or reorganizing the maintained memory through dense dimensional expansion, sparse address spaces, multiple temporal states, and block-level associative summaries. These developments also reshape the other stages of memory processing. A differentiated state organization requires Access to determine which maintained units are exposed to the current query, Readout to decode and aggregate the eligible state information, and Integration to coordinate completed readouts when multiple heads, states, or memory paths contribute to the module output. The five-dimensional view therefore reveals a coupled design trajectory: changes in how associative memory is represented and updated progressively alter what can be accessed, how it can be read, and how the resulting contextual information is incorporated into the network.
blocks.zh: 在第二节引入的框架内,线性关注的发展始于记忆表现和记忆更新的根本改变. 其分类式配方用关联矩阵状态取代了可想象的象征性历史,并经常将新的关键价值关联纳入这种压缩的表述。 后期方法通过保留,校正,去除,和受控的写法来完善状态过渡,同时通过密集的维扩展,地址空间稀疏,多时态,和块级关联摘要来扩大或重组所维护的内存. 这些发展也重塑了记忆处理的其他阶段. 一个有区别的状态组织要求Access确定哪些被维护的单位暴露于当前查询,Readout解码并汇总符合条件的状态信息,当多个头,状态,或内存路径为模块输出贡献时,Institute协调完成的读出. 因此,五维视图揭示了一种结合式设计轨迹:如何反映和更新关联记忆的变化逐步改变可以访问的内容,如何阅读,以及由此产生的背景信息如何纳入网络。

blocks.en: Following this trajectory, we first examine Memory Update within a single associative state, from additive accumulation to increasingly controlled forms of retention, correction, erasure, and writing. We then turn to Memory Representation and study how associative memory is enlarged or reorganized through dense dimensional expansion, sparse address spaces, temporal state collections, and block-level summaries. On this basis, we analyze how differentiated memory units introduce new Access and Readout choices, including routing among maintained states, normalized state decoding, and aggregation across multiple summaries. We finally consider how completed readouts are integrated within a layer and how memory-derived signals may be coordinated across network depth. Throughout the section, the functional analysis is paired with the corresponding computational implications, including persistent state growth, routing and merging overhead, parallel training form, and the maturity of the available empirical evidence.
blocks.zh: 在此轨迹之后,我们首先在单一的关联状态下审查记忆更新,从添加剂积累到越来越受控制的留存、修正、去除和写作形式。 然后,我们转向记忆代表,研究如何通过密集的维扩展、地址空间稀少、时间状态收集以及块级摘要来扩大或重组关联记忆。 在此基础上,我们分析不同的内存单元是如何引入新的访问和读取选择的,包括在维持状态之间的路由、正常状态解码,以及跨越多个摘要的汇总。 最后,我们考虑完成的读取如何融入一层,以及如何在网络深度之间协调内存产生的信号。 在整个部分,功能分析与相应的计算影响,包括持续状态增长,路由和合并间接费用,平行培训形式,以及现有经验证据的成熟度相配合.

blocks.en: 5.1 Memory Update: From Accumulation to Controlled State Editing
blocks.zh: 5.1 内存更新:从累积到控制状态编辑

blocks.en: For comparison across single-state methods, we use an analytical decomposition into retain/decay, erase/correct, and write/commit. To simplify notation, the head index is omitted below and S t ∈ ℝ d k × d v S_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{k}\times d_{v}} denotes a single-head state. Its update is summarized as S ¯ t − 1 = α t ⊙ S t − 1 , S t = S ¯ t − 1 − E t + W t , \bar{S}_{t-1}=\alpha_{t}\odot S_{t-1},\qquad S_{t}=\bar{S}_{t-1}-E_{t}+W_{t}, (40) where S ¯ t − 1 \bar{S}_{t-1} is the retained old state, E t E_{t} is the association erased or corrected from that state, and W t W_{t} is the current write.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Retain / Decay
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 保留/衰减

blocks.en: Retain / Decay controls how much of the old state remains before new information is written. Existing methods differ in both the source and the granularity of α t \alpha_{t} . The coefficient can be a fixed parameter after training or can be generated dynamically from the current input through f α ​ ( x t ) f_{\alpha}(x_{t}) . Its granularity can be a head-wise scalar α t h ∈ ℝ \alpha_{t}^{h}\in\mathbb{R} or a channel-wise vector α t h ∈ ℝ d k \alpha_{t}^{h}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{k}} acting on the d k d_{k} state rows. The development begins with complete retention without decay, then introduces fixed decay with predefined time scales, and finally moves to input-dependent, fine-grained retention. Table 4 summarizes this progression.
blocks.zh: 保留 / 衰变 控制旧状态在写出新信息前还剩多少 。 现有方法在α t-α_{t}的来源和颗粒性上都不同. 系数可以是训练后的一个固定参数,也可以通过 f α (x t) f α (x_{t}) 从当前输入中动态生成. 它的颗粒性可以是头向分级的 α t h → R\ alpha_{t}^{h}\in\ mathbb{R} 也可以是信道向量的 α t h → R d\ alpha_{t}^{h}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{d_{k} 在状态行上表演。 开发先从不衰变的完全保留入手,再以预先设定的时间尺度引入固定衰变,再最后转向依赖输入,精细的保存. 表4总结了这一进展。

blocks.en: Linear Transformer, DeltaNet, and DeltaProduct set α t h = 1 \alpha_{t}^{h}=1 , so historical state does not decay actively with time [ 74 , 140 , 179 , 145 ] . This preserves the accumulated history, but early information continues to occupy the finite state space, and the model cannot vary the retention strength of different historical components according to time or input content.
blocks.zh: 线性变形器、德尔塔网络和德尔塔 产品集α t h = 1\ alpha_{t}^{h}= 1,因此历史状态不会随时间而积极衰变 [74, 140, 179, 145]. 这保留了所积累的历史,但早期信息继续占据了有限的状态空间,而模型无法根据时间或输入内容来改变不同历史组成部分的保留强度.

blocks.en: Fixed decay introduces stable time scales through predefined retention coefficients. RetNet and the fixed-decay Lightning Attention-2 formulation use head-wise scalar decay, so different heads cover histories of different lengths; RWKV-5 uses channel-wise time decay, allowing different state channels within the same head to retain information at different rates [ 148 , 103 , 124 ] . 3 3 3 RWKV-4 also uses fixed channel-wise time decay, but it maintains normalized vector-valued accumulators rather than the matrix-valued associative state assumed in this subsection; it is therefore omitted from the comparison tables [ 123 ] . Compared with undecayed accumulation, fixed decay continually reduces the weight of earlier history and forms multiscale memory, but its forgetting rate does not change with input content at inference time.
blocks.zh: 固定衰变通过预先确定的留存系数引入了稳定的时间尺度. RetNet和固定的decay Lightning Note-2配方使用头相向的分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级分级 与未消减的积累相比,固定衰变会不断降低早期历史的分量并形成多尺度的内存,但其被遗忘的速率不会随着推断时间的输入内容而改变.

blocks.en: Input-dependent decay makes the retention coefficient a function of the current input. GLA uses a channel-wise vector gate, whereas GDN uses an input-dependent head-wise scalar, allowing different tokens to regulate historical retention globally or by channel [ 178 , 177 ] . HGRN2 also uses an input-dependent channel-wise forget gate and assigns a retention lower bound that increases with layer depth. This constraint allows lower layers to update local information more rapidly while higher layers retain longer historical time scales [ 127 ] . RWKV-6/7, KDA, GDN2, and EDA also generate input-dependent channel-wise decay α t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) d k \alpha_{t}\in(0,1)^{d_{k}} to control retention in individual state rows [ 124 , 125 , 157 , 62 , 81 ] . Retention thus develops from a fixed temporal prior into token-dependent and channel-aware control, with cross-layer constraints further organizing different time scales.

blocks.en: Table 8 reveals two broad stages in the development of single-state updates. Early additive methods maximize the correlation between the state prediction and the current value. Their differences arise from the regularization applied to the old state: Linear Transformer has no forgetting penalty, RetNet introduces isotropic fixed decay, GLA replaces it with an input-dependent channel-wise penalty, and HGRN2 further couples the write address to the complementary forget gate. These objectives produce direct writes whose magnitude does not depend on the value already predicted at the current address.
blocks.zh: 表8显示了单态更新发展的两个大阶段. 早期添加剂方法使状态预测和当前值之间的关联最大化. 它们的差异来自对旧国家的规范化: Linear Transformer没有忘记罚单,RetNet引入了异构固定衰变,GLA将其取而代之的是依赖输入的频道-顺道罚单,而HGRN2则进一步将写出地址与互补的忘却门相配. 这些目标产生直接的写作,其规模并不取决于当前地址已经预测的数值.

blocks.en: Delta-style methods replace correlation maximization with reconstruction-error minimization, making the write explicitly residual dependent. DeltaNet performs one correction on the previous state. GDN and KDA move the same correction to a decayed optimization state, with GDN using a head-wise scalar and KDA using channel-wise decay. DeltaProduct increases optimization depth by fitting multiple key–value targets sequentially within one token. EDA instead expands the objective sequence: it first fits a zero target at an independently selected erase address and then fits the current value at the write address. The progression therefore changes not only the form of the loss, but also the state at which it is optimized, the number of optimization steps, and whether erase and write share the same address and target.
blocks.zh: 三角洲式的方法用重建-error最小化取代了关联最大化,使得写作明显地依赖于剩余. 德尔塔 Net对前一状态执行一次更正. GDN和KDA将相同的校正移到衰变优化状态,由GDN使用头向分级,而KDA使用道向分级分级. Delta Product公司通过将多个关键值目标相继安装在一个符号内来提高优化深度. EDA转而扩展目标序列:首先在独立选择的去除地址上符合零目标,再在写出地址上符合当前值. 因此,进步不仅会改变丢失的形式,而且还会改变其优化状态,优化步骤的数量,以及是否去除并写入同一地址和目标.

blocks.en: 5.2 Capacity Expansion
blocks.zh: 5.2 扩大能力

blocks.en: By 2025, decay and delta-style editing enabled a single state to use bounded memory more effectively, but the complete history was still compressed into one d k × d v d_{k}\times d_{v} matrix. Better update rules reduce conflicts but cannot provide an unlimited number of independent storage locations; directly enlarging a dense state also increases every token’s read and write cost. Capacity Expansion therefore relaxes the assumption that each head maintains only one dense state and enlarges available memory through sparse selection.
blocks.zh: 到2025年,衰变和三角洲风格的编辑使得单个状态能够更有效地使用被捆绑的内存,但完整的历史仍然被压缩成一个dk × d v d_{k}\times d_{v}矩阵. 更好的更新规则可以减少冲突,但不能提供数量无限的独立存储位置;直接扩大密集状态也会增加每个信使的读写成本. 因此,扩展能力放宽了每个头只维持一个密集状态的假设,并通过稀少的选择来扩大可用的内存.

blocks.en: Standard Linear Attention maintains one matrix state S t ∈ ℝ d k × d v S_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{k}\times d_{v}} per head. Capacity Expansion generalizes it to M M states, 𝒮 t = { S t ( m ) ∈ ℝ d k × d v } m = 1 M , 𝒮 t ∈ ℝ M × d k × d v . \mathcal{S}_{t}=\left\{S_{t}^{(m)}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{k}\times d_{v}}\right\}_{m=1}^{M},\qquad\mathcal{S}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d_{k}\times d_{v}}. (52) Flattening the state and key dimensions gives an equivalent row matrix of shape ( M ​ d k ) × d v (Md_{k})\times d_{v} . SSE and SDM both increase capacity by adding available state rows, but SSE retains a group structure whereas SDM uses a larger flat memory table. Under this unified row-memory view, routing determines which groups or rows are eligible for the current query and therefore belongs to Access, while weighting and aggregating the selected rows into one contextual representation belong to Readout. If a grouped formulation instead produces separate group- or state-specific readouts before combining them, that subsequent combination belongs to Integration. The distinction therefore depends on the analytical granularity: groups may be treated as internal partitions of one expanded state or as distinct readout paths; for SSE and SDM in this subsection, we use the former interpretation unless separate completed readouts are made explicit.

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Sparse State Expansion (SSE)
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 国家扩展

blocks.en: Sparse State Expansion (SSE) enlarges the associative memory by maintaining multiple groups of state rows [ 121 ] . Each group provides a separate region of the expanded state space, while a learned router activates only a small number of groups for the current token. Within the active groups, separate coefficients determine how strongly individual rows participate in writing and reading. The resulting organization is hierarchical: routing first identifies relevant groups and then distributes the update or readout within those groups.
blocks.zh: Sparse State扩展(SSE)通过保持多组状态行来扩展关联记忆 [121]. 每个组为扩展的状态空间提供一个单独的区域,而学习到的路由器只激活少数组,用于当前符号. 在活动组内,单独的系数决定了单个行参与写作和阅读的程度. 由此产生的组织是分级的:路线首先确定相关组别,再在这些组别内分发更新或读出.

blocks.en: This hierarchy gives SSE a strong structural prior. Group-level selection reduces the number of state regions considered by each token and provides a comparatively regular execution pattern. Because read and write operate within the same group organization, the structure can also help preserve a relationship between where information is stored and where later queries search for it. At the same time, predefined group boundaries restrict direct competition across the full memory space. Rows in an inactive group cannot participate in the current operation, even when their contents might be relevant, and the fixed partition may limit how memory units reorganize as their roles evolve during training.
blocks.zh: 这种等级赋予了SSE一个强大的结构前. 组级选择会减少每个符所考虑的州区数量,并提供一个相对规律的执行模式. 因为读取和书写是在同一组组织内运行的,所以该结构还可以帮助保持信息存储地点与后期查询查找地点之间的关系. 同时,被预先定义的集团边界限制了整个内存空间的直接竞争. 一个不活动组中的行无法参与当前操作,即使其内容可能相关,而固定分区可能限制内存单位在训练过程中随角色演变而重组的方式.

blocks.en: SSE therefore expands capacity through a balance between specialization and regularity. Increasing the number of groups enlarges the persistent memory without requiring every token to interact with every row, but the effective benefit depends on whether the router distributes information across groups, avoids repeatedly overloading a small subset, and selects groups that remain useful for later retrieval.
blocks.zh: 因此,SSE通过专业与规律之间的平衡来扩大能力. 增加组数可以扩大持久的内存,而不需要每个令牌与每行交互,但有效的好处取决于路由器是否在组间分布信息,避免反复地使一个小子集超载,并选择仍然对后期检索有用的组.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Sparse Delta Memory (SDM)
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 Sparse Delta内存

blocks.en: Sparse Delta Memory (SDM) removes the predefined group boundaries and organizes the expanded state as a flat collection of recurrent memory rows [ 18 ] . Product-Key Memory routers retrieve a limited number of rows for writing and reading. Rows selected for writing receive delta-style updates, while unselected rows preserve their previous contents. A separate read router identifies the rows that contribute to the current output.
blocks.zh: Sparse Delta Memory (SDM)去除预先定义的组分边界,并将所扩展的状态组织为平分的经常性内存行集合[18]. Product-Key Memory路由器取回了数量有限的行来进行写作和阅读. 被选中写入的行接收了delta风格的更新,而未选中的行保留了之前的内容. 一个单独的读取路由器可以识别有助于当前输出的行.

blocks.en: The flat organization gives SDM greater addressing freedom than a fixed grouped structure. Any row can, in principle, compete for the current write or read operation, and the write and read supports can be generated independently. This separation allows the system to distinguish where incoming information should be stored from where a later query should search. It also makes the enlarged memory less dependent on a manually imposed partition of the row space.
blocks.zh: 与固定的分组结构相比,统一组织给予数据和元数据交换自由。 任何行原则上都可以竞争当前写入或读取操作,而写入和读取支持可以独立生成. 这种分离使系统能够区分所收到信息的存储地点和以后查询的搜索地点。 这也使得扩展后内存较少依赖手动强制的行空间分区.

blocks.en: The same flexibility introduces a more demanding coordination problem. A row may be written frequently but rarely retrieved, while another may be retrieved before receiving sufficiently relevant updates. Independently learned routers can also develop incompatible address conventions, weakening the connection between storage and later recall. Moreover, the practical efficiency of a large flat state depends on fast retrieval, balanced row utilization, and memory access patterns that do not offset the savings obtained from sparse activation.
blocks.zh: 同样的灵活性带来了更严格的协调问题。 一行可能经常被写作,但很少被取回,而另一行则会在收到足够相关的更新之前被取回. 独立学习的路由器还可以开发不相容的地址常规,削弱存储和后回召之间的联系. 此外,一个大平地状态的实际效率取决于快速检索,平衡行用量,以及内存访问模式,不能抵消从稀有活化中获得的节省.

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Comparison and Open Design Space
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 比较和开放设计空间

blocks.en: Table 9 compares SSE and SDM. Both expand a dense matrix into row memory and use sparse read/write operations to control per-token cost; SSE uses fixed groups for hierarchical routing, whereas SDM performs independent retrieval directly in a flat row space.
blocks.zh: 表9比较了SSE和SDM。 既将密集的矩阵扩展为行内存,又使用稀疏的读取/写取操作来控制每盘成本;SSE使用固定组进行分级路由,而SDM则直接在平行空间进行独立检索.

blocks.en: Table 9: Comparison of SSE and SDM under a unified row-memory view.
blocks.zh: 表9:统一行目视图下的SSE和SDM比较.

blocks.en: Fixed groups reduce the search range and regularize routing, but a predefined partition can restrict dynamic reorganization among memory units. Flat routing provides greater addressing freedom, but must sustain low-cost, high-recall retrieval over a much larger row space. A hierarchical combination of grouped and flat routing could provide both coarse partitioning and fine-grained global selection.
blocks.zh: 固定组缩小了搜索范围并规范了路由,但预先定义的分区可以限制内存单元之间的动态重组. 平坦的路由提供了更大的解决自由,但必须在更大的行地空间上保持低成本高召回. 分组式和平面式路线的分级结合既可以提供粗糙的分化,也可以提供精细的全球选择。

blocks.en: Coordination between Read and Write also remains unresolved. Shared or related supports keep written content aligned with later retrieval but may prevent a query from recalling other memory regions. Fully independent routers are more flexible, yet can produce uneven write utilization, rows that are rarely read, or memory units retrieved before they are adequately trained. Explicit read–write consistency objectives, load balancing, and state-utilization regularization may improve this trade-off.
blocks.zh: 读写之间的协调也仍未解决。 共享或相干支持保持与后期检索一致的书面内容,但可能会使查询无法回顾其他内存区域. 完全独立的路由器更加灵活,然而却可以产生不均匀的书写利用率,很少被读取的行,或者在充分训练之前检索出内存单元. 明确解读-写入一致性目标、负载平衡和国家使用规范化可改善这种取舍。

blocks.en: As row count increases, routing cost, cross-layer memory organization, and state lifetime become increasingly important. Potential directions include reusing routing decisions across neighboring layers, allocating or reclaiming rows according to usage frequency, and allowing different layers to access shared collections of state memory. Capacity Expansion therefore requires the joint design of Memory Representation, sparse Access, Readout, and update dynamics rather than merely increasing state size.
blocks.zh: 随着行数的增加,路由成本,跨层记忆组织,以及状态寿命变得越来越重要. 可能的方向包括重新使用跨相邻地层的路由决定,根据使用频率分配或还原行,并允许不同的地层访问共享的状态内存集合. 因此,扩大能力需要共同设计记忆代表、稀缺的存取、读取和更新动态,而不仅仅是扩大国家规模。

blocks.en: 5.3 Temporal Expansion
blocks.zh: 5.3 时间扩展

blocks.en: Capacity Expansion increases rows within the associative space, but history may still be compressed into one temporally uniform memory. When recent details and distant information remain mixed in the same state, different temporal ranges share the same representation resolution and cannot be independently emphasized during readout. Temporal Expansion instead preserves multiple states along the token dimension.
