blocks.en: The central questions are how tokens are partitioned into segments, whether old states are retained or merged as the context grows, and how the current query combines information from different temporal intervals. Log-Linear Attention [ 60 ] uses a deterministic multiscale hierarchy, Dynamic Linear Attention [ 163 ] uses content-dependent segmentation and merging, whereas Multi-Head Linear Attention [ 189 ] preserves a flat collection of fixed-granularity token-block summaries. These mechanisms all expand memory along the token dimension, but differ in temporal organization, state-count control, and cross-state Integration.
blocks.zh: 中心问题在于道具如何被分割成片段,旧状态是保留还是随着上下文的增长而合并,以及当前查询如何将不同时间间隔的信息结合起来. Log-Linear Content [60] 使用定型多尺度分级,动态线性注意 [163] 使用内容依赖分块并合并,而多头线性注意 [189] 保留了固定-正方形符号-块摘要的平面集合. 这些机制都沿着象征维度来扩展记忆,但在时间组织,州计控制,和跨州整合方面却有所不同.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Comparison of temporal grouping strategies in Log-Linear Attention, DLA, and MHLA. Log-Linear Attention deterministically organizes history into multiscale intervals, DLA forms irregular content-adaptive segments under a bounded state budget, and MHLA preserves a flat collection of fixed-granularity token blocks with query-block-conditioned mixing.
blocks.zh: 图8: Log-Linear Content、DLA和MHLA中的时间分组战略比较。 Log-Linear Content确定性地将历史组织成多尺度的间隔,DLA在有界限的国家预算下形成不规则的内容适应区段,而MHLA则保留了固定的有查询-块-有条件地混合的平面地格符号区块.

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Log-Linear Attention
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 注意日志

blocks.en: Log-Linear Attention uses a deterministic multiscale organization to avoid compressing the entire history into one state [ 60 ] . A Fenwick-tree or power-of-two schedule maintains O ⁡ ( log ⁡ t ) O(\!\log t) states. As new tokens arrive, shorter segments are merged according to a binary-carry rule, producing contiguous historical groups such as 8 + 4 + 2 + 1 8+4+2+1 . Recent information is preserved in short segments at high resolution, while distant history is compressed into longer segments, and the number of states grows only logarithmically with sequence length. Its limitation is that segmentation depends entirely on position, so a fixed merge can cross an important semantic boundary.
blocks.zh: Log-Linear Content使用决定式多尺度组织来避免将整个历史压缩为一个状态[60]. 一个芬威克树 或两个时刻表的力量 O (对数 ) (对数 ) O(\!\log t) 表示 。 随着新道具的到来,更短的道段按照二进制承接规则被合并,产生相接相接的历史群,如8+4+2+1 8+4+2+1. 最近的信息以高分辨率保存在短段中,而遥远的历史被压缩为更长的段,而状态的数量仅以序列长度的对数增长. 它的局限性在于分化完全取决于位置,因此固定合并可以跨越重要的语义边界.

blocks.en: 5.3.2 Dynamic Linear Attention (DLA)
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 动态线性注意(DLA)

blocks.en: DLA replaces fixed temporal partitioning with content-dependent segmentation [ 163 ] . It uses a State Information Score to determine whether the current token should continue to accumulate into an existing state or create a new segment state when the information changes substantially. When the number of states reaches an upper bound K K , DLA merges adjacent states with the lowest information density. Relative to Log-Linear Attention, it allocates more of the limited state budget to regions with dense semantic change while keeping memory bounded by M t ≤ K M_{t}\leq K . The cost is that boundaries and merges depend on dynamic scores, and history that has already been merged generally cannot recover its original temporal resolution.
blocks.zh: DLA用依赖内容的分解来取代固定时间分解[163]. 它使用国家信息分数来确定当信息发生实质性变化时,当前符号是否应该继续累积到现有的状态中,或者创建一个新的段态. 当州数达到上界 K K. 时, DLA 将相邻的州合并为信息密度最低的州. 相对于 Log-Linear 注意,它将更多有限的国家预算分配给语义变化密集的地区,同时保留由 Mt Q-K M_{t}\leq 所限定的内存. 凯. 成本是边界和合并取决于动态分数,已经合并的历史一般无法恢复其最初的时间分辨率.

blocks.en: 5.3.3 Multi-Head Linear Attention
blocks.zh: 5.3.3 多头线性注意

blocks.en: Multi-Head Linear Attention (MHLA) partitions the token sequence into fixed blocks and preserves a separate key–value summary for each block [ 189 ] . Its token-level “heads” therefore differ from conventional feature heads, which partition the channel dimension. Rather than merging all block contributions into one global state, MHLA allows each query block to form a learned mixture of the retained summaries, followed by the usual query–key interaction within each block. From the temporal-memory perspective, MHLA is a flat expansion with approximately uniform chunk resolution: it preserves greater distinction among historical intervals than a single recurrent state, but unlike Log-Linear Attention and DLA, it does not intrinsically merge older summaries or bound their number. Its efficiency therefore depends on controlling both the number of retained blocks and the cost of inter-block mixing.
blocks.zh: 多头线性注意(MHLA)将符号序列分割为固定块并保存每个块的单独密钥-值摘要[189]. 因此,其象征级的“头”与传统地物头不同,传统地物头将频道层面分割开来。 MHLA 并没有将所有块贡献合并为一个全球状态,而是允许每个查询块形成保留摘要的已学到的混合物,然后在每个块内进行通常的查询 - 键交互。 从时间-记忆的角度来看,MHLA是一种平坦的扩张,大约具有统一的块分辨率:它保持了历史间隔比单一的重复状态更大的区别,但与Log-Linear Content和DLA不同,它并没有内在地将更古老的摘要合并起来或绑定它们的数目. 因此,其效率取决于控制保留区块的数量和区块间混合的成本。

blocks.en: 5.3.4 Comparison and Development Trends
blocks.zh: 5.3.4 比较和发展趋势

blocks.en: Log-Linear Attention, DLA, and MHLA all preserve multiple associative summaries over different token intervals, but organize temporal resolution differently. Log-Linear Attention uses a deterministic multiscale hierarchy, DLA creates and merges segments according to content, and MHLA retains a flat collection of fixed-granularity blocks. Table 10 compares their segmentation criteria, state-management rules, and readout mechanisms.
blocks.zh: Log-Linear Content, DLA,和MHLA都在不同符号间隔上保留了多个关联摘要,但组织时间分辨率不同. Log-Linear Content使用一个定型多尺度分级,DLA根据内容创建并合并了片段,而MHLA保留了固定角块的平分集. 表10比较了它们的分类标准、国家管理规则和读取机制。

blocks.en: Table 10: Comparison of representative Temporal Expansion mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 表10:有代表性的时间扩展机制的比较。

blocks.en: The three methods illustrate complementary approaches to temporal memory organization. Log-Linear Attention varies representation resolution according to temporal distance, DLA allocates resolution according to content change, and MHLA preserves a uniform flat partition while differentiating historical blocks during readout. These choices expose a broader trade-off among temporal resolution, bounded memory growth, segmentation adaptivity, and query-dependent retrieval. They are also potentially composable: fixed block summaries could be hierarchically merged or dynamically consolidated, while richer query-conditioned routing could be applied over the resulting bounded collection of temporal states.
blocks.zh: 这三种方法说明了时间记忆组织的补充方法。 Log-Linear Content根据时间距离而不同表示分辨率,DLA根据内容变化而分配分辨率,MHLA保留了统一的平分,同时在读取时区分历史块. 这些选择揭示了时间分辨率、有限度的内存增长、分化适应性和依赖查询的检索之间更广泛的取舍。 它们也可能是可相容的:固定块摘要可以分级合并或动态地合并,而比较丰富的查询条件路由则可以适用于由此产生的有限度的时间状态集合。

blocks.en: 5.4 Auxiliary Coordination and Routing Enhancements
blocks.zh: 5.4 辅助协调和例行加强

blocks.en: The preceding subsections concern the construction and organization of associative memory itself. Memory Update methods change how information is retained, corrected, erased, or written within a recurrent state. Capacity Expansion increases the number of available state units, while Temporal Expansion preserves multiple states that summarize different historical intervals. A separate set of recent methods instead focuses on how Linear Attention computations are coordinated across broader structural axes such as feature heads and network layers. These methods do not form a single mechanism family: they are grouped here because their principal contribution lies in coordinating an identifiable Linear Attention computation rather than introducing another general state-update or state-organization rule.
blocks.zh: 前几分节涉及关联记忆本身的构建和组织. 内存更新方法改变信息如何保留,更正,去除,或者在经常状态下被写入. 容量扩展增加了可用的状态单位数量,而Temperal扩展则保留了总结不同历史间隔的多个状态. 一套单独的近代方法则侧重于线性注意计算如何在诸如地物头和网络层等更广泛的结构轴上相协调. 这些方法并不构成一个单一的机制家族:它们在这里被归类,因为它们的主要贡献在于协调可识别的线性注意计算,而不是引入另一种一般的状态更新或国家组织规则.

blocks.en: Softmax Linear Attention (SLA) introduces token-dependent competition across the feature heads of a Linear Attention layer [ 172 ] . A key-side gate controls the relative strength with which the current token is written into different head states, while a query-side gate controls the relative contribution of those heads to the current output. Unlike the mechanisms in Section 5.1 , SLA does not primarily redesign the recurrence within each state; instead, it allocates write strength across a bank of existing states and controls how their completed outputs are integrated. Its direct effects therefore lie in Memory Update and Integration. Because the gates are continuous and need not exclude a head from computation, they should not automatically be interpreted as sparse Access decisions.
blocks.zh: Softmax Linear Note(SLA)在线性注意层的地物头上引入了依赖符号的竞争[172]. 一个按键侧门控制将当前符号写入不同头部状态的相对强度,而一个查询侧门控制这些头对当前输出的相对贡献. 与第5.1节的机制不同,苏丹解放军并不主要重新设计各州内部的再现情况;相反,它分配了现有各州的书写力量,并控制它们完成的产出如何整合。 因此,它的直接影响在于记忆更新和整合。 由于闸门是连续的,不需要将一个头排除在计算之外,所以它们不应该自动被解释为稀缺的Access决定.

blocks.en: Cross-Layer Value Routing (CLVR) operates along network depth [ 19 ] . Rather than changing the number of recurrent states or the retain–correct–write rule within a layer, it exposes an internal value associated with the current write operation to subsequent layers through the residual stream. Later layers can therefore use a memory-derived signal that would otherwise remain internal to the layer that produced it.
blocks.zh: Cross-Layer value Routing(CLVR)沿网络深度运行 [19]. 与其在一层内改变重复状态的数量或保留-更正-写入规则,不如通过剩余流将当前写入操作相关的一个内部值暴露给后续的层. 因此后层可以使用内存生成的信号,否则它会留在生成它的地层内部.

blocks.en: CLVR differs from Capacity and Temporal Expansion because it does not primarily create additional persistent memory units. It also differs from the Hybrid Architectures examined in Section 7 , because it preserves the host Linear Attention recurrence rather than combining heterogeneous sequence mixers or independent memory paths. Within the five-dimensional framework, CLVR is best understood as cross-layer coordination around the memory operator. It affects how memory-derived information enters later computation, but the routed value is not necessarily a completed readout in the strict sense used to define Integration in Section 2 . CLVR should therefore be distinguished from both ordinary residual propagation and explicit fusion of completed memory-path outputs.
blocks.zh: CLVR不同于"容量"和"时间扩展",因为它主要不会产生额外的持续记忆单元. 它也不同于第7节所审查的"混合结构",因为它保留了主机线性注意力重现,而不是结合了多相异的序列搅拌器或独立的内存路径. 在五维框架内,CLVR最好被理解为围绕内存操作器的跨层协调. 它会影响内存衍生出的信息如何进入后期计算,但路由值不一定是严格意义上的完成读出,用于定义第2节"融合". 因此,应区分CLVR与普通的剩余传播和对已完成的内存-路径输出的明确融合。

blocks.en: Taken together, SLA and CLVR expose two distinct coordination axes. SLA redistributes writing and output contribution across feature heads, whereas CLVR propagates a memory-derived signal across network depth. Their relationship to the preceding categories is complementary rather than hierarchical. State-update methods determine how an individual associative state changes; Capacity and Temporal Expansion determine which memory units are maintained; and the mechanisms discussed here determine how state computations or internal memory signals are coordinated across feature partitions and network layers. This distinction also explains why these methods may affect several analytical dimensions without constituting new top-level memory substrates.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,苏丹解放军和解放党暴露出两个不同的协调轴心。 SLA将文字和输出贡献重新分配到功能头,而CLVR则将内存产生的信号传播到网络深度. 它们与上述类别的关系是互补的,而不是等级的。 状态更新方法决定个人关联状态的变化方式; 容量和时间扩展决定了哪些内存单位得到维护; 这里讨论的机制决定了状态计算或内部内存信号如何在特征分区和网络层之间协调. 这种区分也解释了为什么这些方法可能会影响几个分析维度而不构成新的顶层内存基底.

blocks.en: 5.5 Summary
blocks.zh: 5.5 总结

blocks.en: Linear Attention replaces an enumerable token-wise KV history with recurrently maintained associative memory. Its development begins with changes to Memory Representation and Memory Update, and subsequently extends to the organization, access, readout, and coordination of multiple memory units.
blocks.zh: 线性注意用经常维护的关联内存来取代一个可假设的按符号的 KV 历史. 它的开发开始于对"记忆代表"和"记忆更新"的修改,并随后延伸至多个内存单元的组织,访问,读取和协调.

blocks.en: The evolution of state updating seeks to compress historical information more effectively within a finite associative state. The canonical additive update continually superposes new key–value associations, which can lead to interference as the state accumulates information. Retention mechanisms regulate how strongly previous content persists, delta-style correction revises the association stored at a particular address, and more differentiated erase–write mechanisms provide finer control over what is removed and committed. These developments primarily refine Memory Update while determining which historical distinctions remain preserved in Memory Representation.
blocks.zh: 国家更新的演变力求在一个有限的关联国内更有效地压缩历史信息。 犬科添加剂的更新不断叠加出新的钥匙-价值关联,随着国家积累信息,这可能导致干扰. 保留机制对以往内容的持续存在程度做出了规定,三角洲式的更正修改了存储在某个特定地址的关联,更有区别地去除-写作机制对去除和所承诺的内容提供了更细微的控制。 这些发展主要是完善记忆更新,同时确定记忆代表性中保留了哪些历史区别。

blocks.en: As sequence length increases, state expansion relaxes the reliance on a single uniformly compressed memory. Capacity Expansion enlarges the associative space through additional dimensions, groups, or memory rows, whereas Temporal Expansion maintains multiple states that summarize different historical intervals. These changes directly enrich Memory Representation, but also introduce corresponding Access, Readout, and Integration questions: the model must determine which maintained units are eligible for the current query, how each eligible state is decoded, and how the resulting state-specific readouts are combined. The effective benefit of expansion therefore depends not only on nominal state size, but also on routing accuracy, read–write coordination, temporal resolution, and the recoverability of stored information.
blocks.zh: 随着序列长度的增大,状态扩展可以放松对单一统一压缩内存的依赖. 能力扩展通过额外的维度,组或内存行来扩大关联空间,而Temperal扩展则保持了多个状态来总结不同的历史间隔. 这些修改直接丰富了内存代表,但也引入了相应的Access,Readout,和Institution问题:模型必须确定哪些被维护的单位有资格进行当前查询,每个符合条件的状态是如何解码的,以及由此产生的状态特定读取是如何合并的. 因此,扩张的有效好处不仅取决于名义上的状态大小,还取决于路径的准确性、读取-写出协调、时间分辨率以及存储信息的可回收性。

blocks.en: Other emerging directions coordinate Linear Attention computations across broader structural axes. SLA allocates writing across feature heads and integrates their outputs, whereas CLVR propagates memory-derived signals across network depth. Both complement state updating and expansion without defining new memory substrates. Together with the capacity- and temporal-expansion mechanisms discussed above, they show that Linear Attention is developing from a compact associative operator toward a more organized memory system whose practical value depends on jointly balancing compression, capacity, temporal resolution, access cost, readout quality, and implementation efficiency.
blocks.zh: 其他新兴方向协调跨更广阔结构轴的线性注意计算. SLA在功能头之间分配写入并整合其输出,而CLVR则将内存产生的信号传播到网络深度. 两者都补充了状态更新和扩展,而未定义新的内存基底. 它们与上文讨论的能力和时间扩展机制一起表明, " 线性关注 " 正在从一个紧凑的关联操作员发展成为一个更有条理的内存系统,其实际价值取决于联合平衡压缩、能力、时间分辨率、访问费用、读取质量和执行效率。

blocks.en: 6 State Space Models
blocks.zh: 6 州空间模型

blocks.en: State Space Models (SSMs) process a sequence by evolving a hidden state as each input arrives and reading that state to produce a contextual representation. Their central design problem is to preserve useful features of the input history through dynamics that can be learned and computed efficiently. Structured transitions and input-dependent control address the state-dynamics problem [ 56 , 55 , 28 ] , while later variants enrich the read–write interfaces to the retained state [ 78 , 82 ] .
blocks.zh: 州空间模型(SSMs)通过在每次输入到达时演化出隐藏状态并读取该状态以产生上下文的表示来处理一个序列. 其中心设计问题在于通过能够有效学习和计算的动态来保存输入历史的有用特征. 结构化的过渡和依赖输入的控制解决了状态-动力学问题[56,55,28],而后期的变体丰富了读-写界面到所保留的状态[78,82].

blocks.en: In the memory-centric framework of Section 2 , these designs primarily shape Memory Representation and Memory Update, while later variants also make Readout more explicit. Figure 9 illustrates the basic update at one sequence position: the previous state and current input determine a new state, from which the layer reads a contextual representation. We begin with structured time-invariant dynamics and selective control, including their sequence-processing algorithms, and then examine how input–output interfaces, head organization, and update geometry extend the basic state-space layer.
blocks.zh: 在以内存为中心的第2节框架中,这些设计主要塑造内存表现和内存更新,而后期的变体也使Readout更加清晰. 图9以一个序列位置说明了基本更新:上一个状态和当前输入决定了一个新的状态,从这个状态中,层会读取上下文的表示. 我们首先从结构化的时间变化动态和选择性控制,包括其序列处理算法,然后审视输入-输出接口、头组织、更新几何学如何扩展基本的状态-空间层。

blocks.en: Figure 9: A state-space update at one sequence position. The new state supplies both the current readout and the memory carried to the next position.
blocks.zh: 图9:一个序列位置的状态空间更新. 新的状态既提供当前读取,也提供携带到下个位置的内存.

blocks.en: 6.1 State Dynamics and Selective Control
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家动态和选择性控制

blocks.en: An SSM state is a set of activations carried between sequence positions. Model weights encode what is learned across training examples, whereas this state records information about the sequence currently being processed. The transition determines which state components persist and how they interact; the input and readout maps connect that state to the surrounding network. Time-invariant and input-conditioned SSMs differ in whether these operators are shared across positions or generated in response to the current input.
blocks.zh: SSM状态是一组在序列位置之间携带的活化物. 模型权重编码了从训练实例中学到的知识,而这种状态记录了目前处理的序列信息. 过渡决定了哪些状态组件持续存在,以及它们如何互动;输入和读出地图将该状态与周围网络连接. 时间变化和输入条件化的SSM在这些操作器是在不同位置共享还是针对当前输入生成上有所不同.

blocks.en: 6.1.1 Structured Time-Invariant Dynamics
blocks.zh: 6.1.1 有结构的时间变化动态

The transition A ¯ \bar{A} retains and mixes existing state components, B ¯ \bar{B} writes the new input, and C C extracts information for the current computation. The bars denote discrete-time parameters, obtained, for example, by discretizing a continuous-time system. Equation ( 55 ) isolates the state-space kernel; a complete layer can also include a direct input–output branch, nonlinearities, gates and output projections.

blocks.en: HiPPO provides an analytic foundation for constructing history-preserving dynamics [ 54 ] . It represents an input history through coefficients of a polynomial approximation under a chosen measure over the past. Intuitively, the state tracks a set of features of the historical signal, with the measure determining how different parts of the past contribute and how the coefficients evolve over time. Different measures yield dynamics with different time dependencies; here the construction provides operators and initializations for the structured SSMs that follow. The approximation viewpoint makes the role of state dimension concrete: it controls the number of coefficients available to represent the history.
blocks.zh: HiPPO为构建历史保存动力提供了分析基础[54]. 它代表了过去在选定计量下通过多诺相近系数的输入历史。 直觉上,状态跟踪了历史信号的一组特征,其尺度决定了过去不同部分如何贡献,以及系数如何随时间演变. 不同的度量法产生具有不同时间依赖性的动态;这里的构造为随后的结构化的SSM提供了操作器和初始化. 近似观点使得国家维度的作用具体化:它控制了可用于代表历史的系数数量.

blocks.en: LSSL introduced trainable state-space layers [ 58 ] . S4 made long-sequence computation practical through a structured transition parameterization, commonly initialized from HiPPO, while learning dynamics and input–output projections from task data [ 56 ] . In a suitable basis, S4 represents the transition using diagonal and low-rank components, providing structure for efficient kernel computation. In Equation ( 56 ), the transition participates in every lag coefficient. Its structure therefore affects both which temporal features the layer can express and how efficiently the convolution kernel can be constructed and applied. These developments turned a prescribed historical approximation into a trainable sequence-processing component: training adapts the operators, and inference applies them while updating the state for each new sequence.
blocks.zh: LSSL引入可列车的状态-空间层 [58]. S4通过结构化的过渡参数化,使长序计算实用,通常从HiPPO初始化,同时从任务数据学习动态和输入-输出预测[56]. 在适当的基础上,S4代表使用对角和低等元件进行过渡,为高效内核计算提供结构. 在公式(56)中,过渡参与每个滞后系数。 因此,其结构既会影响该地层能够表达哪些时间特征,又会影响如何有效地构建和应用演化内核。 这些发展将一个规定的历史近似化为可训练的序列处理组件:培训使操作员适应,推论在更新每个新序列状态的同时应用.

blocks.en: S4D simplified the transition parameterization to diagonal structure [ 57 ] . In a diagonal system, each state coordinate propagates through its own transition coefficient, while the input and readout maps combine these coordinates with the network channels. S5 instead organized the layer as one multi-input multi-output system and used parallel scans [ 146 ] . These choices illustrate how temporal dynamics and the organization of the recurrent unit jointly shape an SSM layer.
blocks.zh: S4D将过渡参数化简化为对角结构[57]. 在对角系统中,每个状态的坐标通过自己的过渡系数来传播,而输入和读出地图将这些坐标与网络通道结合起来. S5相反将地层组织为一个多输入多输出系统,并使用平行扫描 [146]. 这些选择说明了时间动态和经常单位的组织如何共同形成一个SSM层.

blocks.en: A scan exploits associative composition of successive state transformations. Two updates can be composed into a transformation over their combined interval, and these interval transformations can be combined hierarchically. This permits parallel evaluation of the sequence state updates. Transition structure determines the cost of representing and composing those transformations; it is central to making the scan practical. Convolution and scan thus offer distinct sequence-processing routes, while recurrent decoding carries the current state forward one position at a time.
blocks.zh: 扫描利用相继状态变迁的关联组成. 两个更新可以组成一个在它们合并间隔上的转换,这些间隔转换可以分级地合并. 这样可以同时评价序列状态更新. 过渡结构决定了这些转变的体现和构成成本;它是使扫描实用的核心。 因此,转录和扫描提供了不同的序列处理路线,而经常性的解码则一次将当前状态带入一个位置.

blocks.en: 6.1.2 Input-Conditioned State Dynamics
blocks.zh: 6.1.2 有输入条件的国家动态

blocks.en: A time-invariant kernel applies the same temporal mixing rule to every input sequence. Language modeling often calls for content-dependent retention: an association may need to survive intervening distractors, an irrelevant token may require little writing, and a context change may call for faster replacement of old information. Selective dynamics let the input regulate these operations.
blocks.zh: 一个时间变化内核对每一个输入序列都适用相同的时间混合规则. 语言模型往往要求依赖内容的保留:一个社团可能需要在干预分心者中幸存下来,一个无关的符号可能不需要多少书写,而上下文的变化可能要求更快地替换旧信息. 选择性动态让输入调节这些操作.

blocks.en: Mamba makes the step size Δ t \Delta_{t} , input parameter B t B_{t} , and readout parameter C t C_{t} functions of the current input [ 55 ] . Its underlying state matrix A A is learned during training; the effective discrete transition A ¯ t = exp ⁡ ( Δ t ​ A ) \bar{A}_{t}=\exp(\Delta_{t}A) varies with the generated step size. The step size controls how far the dynamics advance, the input map controls writing, and the readout map modulates the contribution of state directions to the current representation. During inference, the state and generated controls vary across positions, while the weights of the networks producing those controls remain fixed. Figure 10 contrasts the resulting control paths with shared operators.

blocks.en: Input conditioning also changes the available computation. The contribution of an earlier token now depends on controls generated along the intervening sequence, so a single lag-based convolution is insufficient for the general selective kernel. Mamba instead uses a structured selective scan [ 55 ] . Mamba-2 develops block-oriented computation through Structured State Space Duality (SSD), connecting a constrained state-space kernel to an attention-like matrix formulation [ 28 ] . This connection makes the recurrence’s structure available to efficient matrix-based sequence computation.
blocks.zh: 输入条件也会改变可用的计算. 现在,一个更早期的符号的贡献取决于在介入序列中产生的控制,所以一个单一的后向演化对于一般的选择性内核来说是不够的. 曼巴转而采用结构化选择性扫描[55]. Mamba-2通过结构化的状态空间质量(SSD)来开发以块为方向的计算,将受限的状态-空间内核与类似注意力的矩阵配方相接 [28]. 这种连接使重现时的结构可用于高效的矩阵序列计算.

Multiplying this coefficient by u 2 u_{2} gives that input’s contribution to the readout; the intervening states also contain contributions from other inputs. Whole-sequence algorithms exploit the matrix structure in blocks, while incremental decoding evaluates the same kernel using only its current recurrent state.

blocks.en: Table 11 compares the dynamics and computational interfaces of these representative kernels.
blocks.zh: 表11比较了这些代表性内核的动态和计算接口.

blocks.en: Table 11: Representative SSM dynamics and computational interfaces. The Mamba-2 SSD kernel is a selective parameterization with a head-wise scalar transition.
blocks.zh: 表11:代表性SSM动态和计算界面. Mamba-2 SSD内核是选择性的参数化,有头向分级过渡.

blocks.en: For a fixed number of heads and fixed state dimensions N N and P P , the Mamba-2 kernel maintains context-length-independent state and per-step decoding work, while total sequence work grows linearly with the number of positions [ 28 ] . The N × P N\times P head state determines the retained storage, while the sequence algorithm determines how updates are scheduled and mapped to hardware. Increasing the state dimensions raises the storage and per-step arithmetic costs. The practical design therefore couples a useful state parameterization with an efficient implementation of its updates and readouts.
blocks.zh: 对于固定数量的头和固定的状态维度N和P,Mamba-2内核保持上下文长度独立的状态并按步骤进行解码工作,而总的序列工作随着位置数的增多而呈线性增长 [28]. N × P N 时间 P头状态决定了所保留的存储,而序列算法则决定了更新的时间安排和映射到硬件的方式. 增加状态维度提高了存储成本和每步算术成本. 因此,实用设计与高效实施其更新和读取的实用状态参数配对。

blocks.en: 6.2 State Organization and Read–Write Refinements
blocks.zh: 6.2 国家组织和读写改进

blocks.en: State dynamics specify how information evolves; the surrounding interface determines what can be written and extracted at each position. H3 used associative-recall and induction-head tasks to study shortcomings of early SSMs and introduced multiplicative interactions to strengthen the relevant computation [ 41 ] . Zoology further showed that aggregate language-modeling quality can conceal substantial differences in associative recall [ 5 ] . These results motivate closer examination of the operations connecting inputs, states and queries.
blocks.zh: 状态动态指定信息如何演化;周围的界面确定每个位置可以写出什么并提取出什么. H3使用了关联-召回和上岗-头任务来研究早期SSM的缺点,并引入了多相相互作用,以加强相关的计算 [41]. 动物学进一步表明,综合语言模型的质量可以掩盖关联召回的巨大差异[5]. 这些结果促使人们更密切地审查连接投入、状态和询问的业务。

blocks.en: 6.2.1 Read–Write Interfaces
blocks.zh: 6.2.1 读写接口

blocks.en: The input and output ports of the specified recurrent unit give one useful description of this interface. In Equation ( 55 ), scalar ports m = p = 1 m=p=1 define a single-input single-output (SISO) system with an n n -dimensional internal state. A multi-input multi-output (MIMO) system has vector-valued ports. State size determines the internal representation, while port dimensions determine the number of input and output components connected to that representation.
blocks.zh: 指定的经常单元的输入和输出端口给出了这一接口的一个有用的描述. 在"方程式"(55 )中,scalar ports m = p = 1 m = p = 1 p = 1 定义具有n-维内态的单输入单输出(SISO)系统. 多输入多输出(MIMO)系统有矢量值端口. 国家规模决定了内部代表,而港口规模则决定了与这种代表相关的投入和产出组成部分的数量。

blocks.en: S5 uses a joint MIMO system in the time-invariant setting [ 146 ] . By comparison, the P P columns in the Mamba-2 kernel of Equation ( 57 ) can be read as P P scalar-port recurrences sharing coefficients. Each column receives one scalar component of u t u_{t} , maintains N N state values, and produces one component of r t r_{t} . The head has N ​ P NP state values in total. Stating the recurrent unit at this level separates the value-channel width from both its internal memory dimension and the extra read–write directions considered next.
blocks.zh: S5在时间变化性设定中使用了MIMO联合系统[146]. 相较之下,曼巴-2方程内核(57)中的P列可被读取为P scalar-port重现共享系数. 每个列都得到u t u_{t} 的一个 scalar 组件, 保持 N N 状态值, 并生成 r t r_{t} 的一个组件 . 头部共有NP NP状态值. 在此级别上标出经常单元, 将值道宽度与其内部内存维度和接下来考虑的额外读写方向区分开来 。

blocks.en: The MIMO variant of Mamba-3 expands the read–write channels available to the principal state [ 78 ] . Whereas Equation ( 57 ) uses one read vector c t c_{t} , a matrix C t multi ∈ ℝ N × R C_{t}^{\mathrm{multi}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times R} supplies R R directions, Y t multi = H t ⊤ ​ C t multi ∈ ℝ P × R , Y_{t}^{\mathrm{multi}}=H_{t}^{\top}C_{t}^{\mathrm{multi}}\in\mathbb{R}^{P\times R}, (59) and these channels are combined into the layer output. Writing is similarly extended by combining multiple outer-product contributions. The construction increases the work performed with a principal state: each read direction projects the same retained information differently, and the resulting channels provide a richer interface to the network. For the read projection shown above, direct multiplication requires work proportional to N ​ P ​ R NPR , exposing how the number of directions changes the arithmetic. When state movement dominates decoding time, this additional arithmetic can improve hardware utilization; realized latency depends on the implementation, device and batch size.

blocks.en: MIMOMamba develops a different multichannel construction by generalizing scalar SSD to matrix-valued attention [ 82 ] . Within a head, transition and input–output matrices are parameterized through a polynomial algebra generated from shared base matrices. Their commuting structure supports the associated matrix-valued factorization. Affine state-update composition supplies the associativity used by parallel scans, while the polynomial construction supplies the additional algebraic structure for this particular dual formulation. Mamba-3 MIMO and MIMOMamba thus enrich state interfaces through different choices of parameter sharing and operator structure.
blocks.zh: MIMOMamba通过将scalar SSD概括到矩阵值的注意力来开发出不同的多通道构造[82]. 在一个头中,过渡和输入-输出矩阵通过共享基矩阵生成的多名代数参数化。 它们的通勤结构支持了相关的矩阵-价值的指数化. Affine状态更新组分供给了平行扫描所使用的关联性,而多诺建构则为这种特定的双重配体提供额外的代数结构. 因此,Mamba-3 MIMO和MIMOMamba通过对参数共享和操作结构的不同选择而丰富了状态界面。

blocks.en: Figure 12 (a,b) contrasts increasing the state dimensions with adding read–write directions to the same principal state. Together, the interfaces above determine the calculations performed on the retained state and the channels through which its information reaches the layer output. Their value depends on the information preserved by the dynamics: a richer projection exposes additional views of the state, while the transition and writing process determine the historical distinctions encoded there.
blocks.zh: 图12(a,b)将增加状态的维度与增加读写方向与同一主状态形成对比。 上面的接口共同决定了保留状态上的计算及其信息到达层输出的通道. 他们的价值取决于动态所保存的信息:更丰富的投影暴露出对国家的额外观点,而过渡和写作过程则决定了其中所编码的历史区别.

blocks.en: 6.2.2 State Organization and Update Geometry
blocks.zh: 6.2.2 国家组织和更新几何

blocks.en: The layer can further organize temporal processing across heads. HADES interprets Mamba-2’s multi-head recurrences as an adaptive filter bank [ 144 ] . It combines shared filters for global low-pass behavior with expert filters for local high-pass behavior, as sketched in Figure 12 (c). The shared component carries more slowly varying information; expert components emphasize more rapidly changing contributions. This organizes complementary temporal characteristics within the SSM layer, alongside the choice of read–write interfaces.
blocks.zh: 该层可以进一步组织跨头的时间处理. HADES将曼巴-2的多头复发解释为适应性过滤库[144]. 它结合了全球低通行为共享过滤器和本地高通行为专家过滤器,如图12(c)所描绘. 共享部分包含的信息差异较小;专家部分强调更迅速变化的贡献。 这组织了SSM层内的补充时间特征,同时选择了读-写接口.

blocks.en: The geometry of the injected updates provides another way to improve how the state evolves. MuonSSM augments an SSM with a momentum-based pathway and lightweight Newton–Schulz iterations on low-rank input injections [ 114 ] . The momentum pathway carries information across updates, while the orthogonalization procedure conditions their directional structure. Figure 12 (d) illustrates this change in the geometry of input injections. In the state-space recurrence, this intervention targets the contribution written into memory, keeping the learned temporal transition as a separate component. It therefore adds update processing to the choices of retention and input–output mapping already described.
blocks.zh: 被注入的更新的几何学提供了另一种改善状态发展的方法. MuonSSM通过一个以动力为基础的路径和轻量级牛顿-低级输入注入的Schulz迭代来增强SSM[114]. 动力路径包含各种更新信息,而正交化程序则对其方向结构构成条件。 图12(d)说明了输入注射几何的这一变化。 在状态-空间重现中,这种干预针对被写入记忆中的贡献,将学到的时间过渡作为一个单独的组成部分. 因此,它为已经说明的保留和投入-产出绘图的选择增加了更新处理。

blocks.en: These designs operate at different locations in the state computation. Head organization distributes temporal characteristics across interacting components; update conditioning shapes the signal entering the state. This distinction helps explain how an SSM layer can be refined while retaining recurrent execution. The transition’s expressiveness remains important as well: state-tracking analyses identify limitations of particular transition classes under specified architectural and numerical assumptions [ 99 ] . Examining the transition, interface and update together is consequently useful for understanding the behavior of a concrete SSM.
blocks.zh: 这些设计在状态计算的不同地点运行. 主组织将时间特征分布在交互组件之间;更新条件会塑造进入状态的信号. 这种区分有助于解释如何在保留经常性执行的同时完善SSM层. 过渡的表现形式也仍然很重要:国家跟踪分析查明了特定建筑和数字假设下特定过渡类别的局限性[99]。 因此,一并检查过渡、接口和更新对于了解一个具体的SSM的行为是有益的。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Four ways to refine an SSM layer: (a) enlarge the state, (b) add read–write directions, (c) combine shared and expert temporal components as in HADES [ 144 ] , and (d) condition input-injection directions as in MuonSSM [ 114 ] . Panels (c,d) are conceptual sketches of the mechanisms described in the text.
blocks.zh: 图12:改进SSM层的四种方法:(a) 扩大状态,(b) 增加读取-写出方向,(c) 将HADES[144]中的共享时间组件和专家时间组件相结合,(d) MuonSSM[114]中的附加条件输入-注入方向。 小组(c,d)是案文所描述的机制的概念草图。

blocks.en: 6.3 Summary
blocks.zh: 6.3 总结

blocks.en: SSM sequence layers combine a retained state with learnable temporal dynamics. Structured time-invariant models provide tractable ways to represent and propagate historical features. Selective models let input-generated controls modulate state evolution, writing and reading, and SSD connects a constrained selective kernel to matrix-based computation. Subsequent designs enrich the channels connected to the state, organize its temporal processing across heads, and condition the geometry of incoming updates. Table 12 summarizes these SSM-specific choices and their computational roles.
blocks.zh: SSM序列层结合了保留状态和可学习的时间动态. 结构化的时常变化模型提供了可采用的方式来代表和传播历史特征。 选择性模型让输入生成的控件能调节状态演化,写作和读取,而SSD将受限的选择性内核与基于矩阵的计算相接. 随后的设计丰富了与状态相接的通道,组织其跨头的时间处理,并条件了来袭更新的几何. 表12总结了这些特别安全安排的具体选择及其计算作用。

blocks.en: These mechanisms also supply components for hybrid architectures. Attamba uses SSMs to form block-level keys and values [ 4 ] , while DART retains local SSM block-state contributions for query-time key and value generation [ 126 ] . Samba combines Mamba with sliding-window attention [ 138 ] . The following chapter examines how such state-based components are coordinated with other sequence-processing paths.
blocks.zh: 这些机制还为混合结构提供组件. Attamba使用SSM来形成块级密钥和值 [4],而DART则保留了本地SSM区块态贡献,用于查询-时间密钥和值生成 [126]. 桑巴组合 曼巴与滑入窗口的注意力 [138]. 下一章审查这些基于状态的组件如何与其他序列处理路径相协调。

blocks.en: Table 12: SSM design questions, mechanisms and roles. The fixed-size decoding state assumes a fixed head count and fixed state dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表12:SSM设计问题,机制和作用. 固定大小的解码状态假设固定头数和固定状态维度.

blocks.en: 7 Hybrid Architecture: Composing Heterogeneous Memory Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 7 混合结构:形成异质记忆机制

blocks.en: This section takes composition granularity as its organizing principle and examines how heterogeneous attention and state-based memory mechanisms are combined at the layer, head, branch, and token levels. Hybrid Architecture is treated as a compositional design space rather than as a fifth memory operator parallel to Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, and State Space Models. At a coarse granularity, a hybrid may arrange largely self-contained modules across network depth; at finer granularities, it may redesign the internal organization of heads, branches, token routing, memory transitions, and fusion interfaces. Accordingly, this section focuses on where heterogeneous mechanisms are combined and how their interactions change across different structural granularities.
blocks.zh: 本节将组分颗粒性作为其组织原则,并研究如何在地层、地头、地分和地标层面将不同的注意力和基于状态的内存机制结合起来。 Hybrid Architecture被视为一个组成设计空间,而不是与Softmax Records,Sparse Records,Linear Records,和州空间模型并行的第五个内存操作器. 在粗细的颗粒地,混合体可以大致安排自成一体的模块,跨越网络深度;在细细的颗粒地上,可以重新设计头部,分支,符号路由,内存过渡,和聚变接口的内部组织. 因此,本节重点介绍不同机制的结合之处及其相互作用在不同结构颗粒之间的变化。

blocks.en: Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, and State Space Models provide complementary capability–cost profiles. Explicit attention preserves direct token-level addressability, Sparse Attention restricts the candidate set, and Linear Attention and SSMs propagate history through bounded recurrent states. Hybrid designs combine these capabilities so that fine-grained retrieval, local interaction, sparse access, and efficient long-range propagation need not be provided by one sequence mixer.
blocks.zh: Softmax 注意、Sparse 注意、线性注意和州空间模型提供了互补的能力-成本概况。 明确关注保持了直接的符号级可处理性,Sparse Content限制了候选集,线性关注和SSM通过有界限的反复状态来传播历史. 混合设计结合了这些能力,因此不需要由一个序列搅拌器来提供精细的检索、局部互动、有限的访问和高效的远程传播。

blocks.en: We organize Hybrid Architectures by the structural granularity at which heterogeneous mechanisms are combined. Layer-wise Hybrid assigns different mixers across network depth; Head-wise Hybrid partitions mechanisms across heads or channel groups within a layer; Branch-wise Hybrid maintains and coordinates multiple memory paths inside a block; and Token-wise Hybrid assigns tokens or chunks to different memory representations or sequence-mixing operations. These granularities may coexist within one architecture and together extend contextual memory from a single substrate or processing path to a heterogeneous organization of explicit and recurrent memories. Under the five-dimensional view in Section 2 , such composition first broadens Memory Representation and, depending on how tightly the paths are coupled, may further coordinate how information is updated or transferred, which memory interfaces are exposed, how their contents are read, and how the resulting features are integrated. Composition granularity therefore identifies the structural scope of hybridization, while the five dimensions describe its consequences for memory processing.
blocks.zh: 我们通过结构颗粒性来组织混合结构,将各种机制结合起来。 层相混合在网络深度之间分配不同的搅拌器; 层内头或信道组之间的头相混合分接机制; 分支相混合在一个块内维护并协调多个内存路径; 托肯相混合为不同的内存表示或序列相混合操作分配符号或块. 这些颗粒体可能在一个架构内并存,并共同将上下文内存从一个单一的基底或处理路径延伸至一个分明和反复记忆的多层次组织. 在第二节的五维视图下,这种构成首先会拓宽内存代表,并视路径的相接程度而定,可以进一步协调信息更新或传输,哪些内存界面被曝光,其内容如何被读取,以及由此产生的特征是如何被整合的. 因此组成颗粒性识别出杂交的结构范围,而五个维度则描述了其对内存处理的影响.

blocks.en: Figure 13 summarizes where heterogeneous mechanisms are combined and qualitatively relates each composition granularity to its typical intervention scope under the five-dimensional view. The following subsections compare Layer-wise designs by layer-allocation policy, Head-wise designs by head budget, Branch-wise designs by interaction interface, and Token-wise designs by routing signal. Tables 13 – 16 then report the corresponding categories, periods, and representative methods before the text examines their motivations and implementations.
blocks.zh: 图13总结了各种机制合并之处,并在质量上将每个组成颗粒性与五维视角下的典型干预范围联系起来。 以下分节通过分层分配策略比较了图层设计,通过头预算比较了头层设计,通过交互界面比较了分支设计,通过路由信号比较了Token-wise设计. 表13 -- -- 16随后报告相应的类别、时期和代表性方法,然后由案文审查它们的动机和执行。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Four composition granularities of Hybrid Architecture and their typical intervention scopes under the five-dimensional memory-centric view. The schematics show where heterogeneous mechanisms are combined. The five-cell columns correspond to Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration. Dark, medium, and light blocks denote dimensions commonly modified directly by hybrid composition, affected in a method-dependent manner, or primarily inherited from the constituent mechanisms, respectively. The profiles are qualitative summaries rather than quantitative literature counts.
blocks.zh: 图13 混合建筑的四个组成颗粒及其典型的干预范围 在五维内存-中心视图下. 图表显示各种机制的结合情况。 五细胞列对应记忆代表,记忆更新,访问,读取,和融合. 暗地,中地,和光地块分别表示由混合成分直接直接修改的维度,以方法依赖的方式被影响,或主要从组成机制中被继承. 简介是定性摘要,而不是定量文献。

blocks.en: 7.1 Layer-wise Hybrid
blocks.zh: 7.1 分层混合

blocks.en: Layer-wise Hybrid assigns different sequence mixers to different depths of a network, combining mechanisms such as Softmax or Linear Attention, SSMs, local attention, and Sparse Attention within a single backbone. The principal distinction is the source of the layer-allocation decision. Some architectures determine module positions before training through a fixed ratio or periodic schedule. Others begin with a pretrained model and use layer behavior to decide which attention modules should be retained or replaced. In the latter group, the selection signal may come directly from diagnosis of the original layers, from representation differences after a candidate replacement module has been aligned, or from teacher–student discrepancy during iterative distillation. Table 13 therefore distinguishes Predefined Allocation, Direct Diagnosis Selection, Alignment-Based Selection, and Iterative Distillation-Guided Selection.
blocks.zh: 层相混合为网络的不同深度分配了不同的序列相混合器,将Softmax或线性注意,SSM,局部注意,Sparse Content等机制结合在一个主干内. 主要区别在于分层分配决定的来源. 一些架构在培训前通过固定比例或定期时间表确定模块位置. 另一些则从预先训练的模型入手,并使用地层行为来决定哪些关注模块应当被保留或替换. 在后一组中,选择信号可能直接来自对原层的诊断,来自候选人替换模块对齐后的代表性差异,或者来自迭代蒸馏过程中的师生差异. 因此,表13区分了预定义的分配、直接诊断选择、对齐选择和惯性消化指导选择。

blocks.en: Table 13: Layer-wise Hybrid designs grouped by layer-allocation policy.
blocks.zh: 表13:按分层分配政策分类的分层混合设计.

blocks.en: 7.1.1 Predefined Allocation
blocks.zh: 7.1.1 预先界定的分配

blocks.en: Many native Hybrid models use manually specified layer structures. Griffin [ 29 ] configures gated linear recurrent blocks and local-attention blocks at an approximate ratio of 2 : 1 2{:}1 , whereas Jamba [ 85 ] uses Mamba as its dominant path and retains full-attention layers at an approximate ratio of 1 : 7 1{:}7 relative to Mamba layers. Samba likewise adopts a predetermined layer-wise arrangement of Mamba, sliding-window attention, and MLP blocks, using recurrent propagation as the backbone while periodically providing direct local retrieval [ 138 ] . These designs control where different context-processing capabilities appear across depth without fusing their readouts inside one block.
blocks.zh: 许多本土混合模型使用人工指定的地层结构. Griffin [29] 以大约2: 1 2{:}1的比例配置有门的线性常态区块和局部注意区块,而Jamba [85] 则以Mamba为主路径并保留了大约1: 7 1{:}7相对于Mamba地层的全意层. Samba同样采用预先确定的分层安排,即Mamba、滑入窗口注意力和MLP块,以经常性传播为主干线,同时定期直接提供本地检索[138]。 这些设计控制方式是,不同上下文处理能力在纵深处出现,而不在一块内安装读取器。

blocks.en: Zamba and Zamba2 periodically invoke attention modules that are shared across depth within a Mamba backbone. Zamba repeatedly uses one shared attention block. Zamba2 retains parameter sharing but alternates between two shared attention blocks and adds LoRA projection modules to provide lightweight depth-specific adaptation at different invocation sites [ 51 , 50 ] . HySparse similarly organizes the model with a fixed full/sparse layer ratio. Within its sparse layers, however, it computes global sparse attention and local sliding-window attention in parallel, while reusing the KV representations and selection indices of a preceding full-attention layer [ 43 ] . HySparse2 keeps this predefined organization but partitions the backbone into a self-decoder that interleaves full attention with sliding-window attention and a cross-decoder that interleaves full attention with token-level sparse attention, connecting the two through full-attention KV bridging so that each cross-decoder full-attention layer projects its keys and values from self-decoder hidden states [ 165 ] . Its detailed selection and cross-layer reuse mechanism is treated in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: Zamba和Zamba2定期调用在Mamba主干范围内广泛共享的注意力模块。 Zamba多次使用一个共享关注区块. Zamba2保留了参数共享,但在两个共享关注区块之间的替代,并增加了LORA投影模块,在不同引用地提供轻量级深度特异性适应[51,50]. HySparse同样以固定的全相/相相相层比来组织模型. 然而,在其稀少的地层中,它同时计算出全球注意力稀少和当地的滑入窗口注意力,同时重用先前全注层的KV表示和选择指数[43]. HySparse2保持了这个预先定义的组织,但将骨干分割成自解码器,将全注意力与滑动窗口的注意力相接,将全注意力与符号级的稀有注意力相接,通过全注意力KV接通将两者连接起来,使每个交叉解码器全注意力层从自解码器隐藏状态中显示其键和值[165]. 第4.4节处理其详细的选择和跨层再利用机制。

blocks.en: 7.1.2 Direct Diagnosis Selection
blocks.zh: 7.1.2 直接诊断选择

blocks.en: Direct diagnosis methods estimate the replaceability of attention layers in a pretrained model without performing complete replacement-module alignment and repeated distillation before every selection decision. LightTransfer identifies “lazy” layers that depend less on global attention and prioritizes their conversion to streaming or local attention [ 191 ] . Priming uses a block-importance score to select Transformer layers that should be retained and applies spectral initialization when converting the remaining attention blocks into SSM modules [ 20 ] . Both derive their selection signal directly from properties of the original model, but use different migration procedures: lightweight adaptation in LightTransfer and training-free conversion in Priming.
blocks.zh: 直接诊断方法估计了在预先训练的模型中注意层的可替换性,而不在每次选择决定前进行完全的替换-模块对接并重复分馏. Light Transfer确定较少依赖全球关注的"懒"地层,并优先将其转化为流出或局部关注[191]. Priming使用块-切入分数来选择应该被保留的变形器层并应用光谱初始化,将剩下的注意块转换为SSM模块[20]. 两者都直接从原始模型的属性得到其选择信号,但使用不同的迁移程序:轻量级的适应在Light Transfer中和无训练的转换在Priming中.

blocks.en: 7.1.3 Alignment-Based Selection
blocks.zh: 7.1.3 基于对齐的选择

blocks.en: Alignment-based methods first reduce the representation gap between Softmax Attention and a candidate efficient module, and then evaluate the effect of replacement at different depths. Jet-Nemotron performs hidden-state alignment before PostNAS jointly searches full-attention placement, the efficient attention operator, and hardware-aware hyperparameters; the resulting Hybrid model is subsequently fine-tuned [ 59 ] . HypeNet/HALO performs attention-weight transfer and hidden-state alignment before selecting the full-attention layers to retain, followed by distillation and fine-tuning to recover the converted model’s capability [ 23 ] . Both follow an alignment–selection–adaptation sequence, differing mainly in the search space and subsequent optimization procedure.
blocks.zh: 基于对齐的方法首先会缩小Softmax Record和候选高效模块之间的代表差距,再在不同深度评价替换的效果. Jet-Nemotron在PostNAS联合搜索全心全意布置,高效的注意力操作员,以及硬件意识超参数之前,执行隐藏状态对接;由此而来的综合模型随后被微调 [59]. HypeNet/HALO在选择保留的全部注意层之前,先进行注意力重移和隐藏状态对接,再进行蒸馏和微调以恢复被转换的模型的能力[23]. 两者都遵循了对齐-选择-适应序列,主要在搜索空间和随后的优化程序中有所不同.

blocks.en: 7.1.4 Iterative Distillation-Guided Selection
blocks.zh: 7.1.4 惯性蒸馏指导选择

blocks.en: KL-Guided Layer Selection alternates student adaptation with layer selection. It first performs attention-weight transfer and hidden-state alignment, and distills an initial Linear Attention student. Softmax Attention is then restored one layer at a time, with the resulting reduction in teacher–student KL divergence used to estimate that layer’s importance; distillation continues after each selection round [ 83 ] . The selection signal therefore reflects the behavior of an already adapted student rather than statistics of the original model or a one-time alignment result.
blocks.zh: KL- Guided Lails 选择带有分层选择的候补学生 。 它首先进行注意力重量转移和隐藏状态对齐,并提炼出一个初始的线性注意力学生. Softmax 注意被一次还原出一层,结果教师-学生 KL 的相差减少,用来估计层的重要性;每轮选择后蒸馏仍在继续[83] 。 因此,选择信号反映了一个已经适应的学生的行为,而不是对原始模型的统计或一次性的对齐结果.

blocks.en: This progression moves Layer-wise Hybrid design from uniform periodic schedules specified during architecture construction toward layer-specific allocation informed by pretrained-model behavior. In parallel, model construction expands beyond training from scratch to adaptation, distillation, fine-tuning, and training-free conversion. These training strategies support the allocation decision, but remain distinct from the architectural question of which mechanism is deployed at each depth and from the memory-level Access rule used inside that mechanism.
blocks.zh: 这种进步将图层-依图层混合设计从建筑构造时指定的统一的周期性时间表转移到以预修模型行为为参考的分层分配. 同时,模型建设也扩展出从零到改造的培训,分馏,微调,以及无培训的转换. 这些培训战略支持分配决定,但与在每一深度部署何种机制的建筑问题和该机制内使用的内存级访问规则不同。

blocks.en: 7.2 Head-wise Hybrid
blocks.zh: 7.2 (中文(简体) ). 头向混合

blocks.en: Head-wise Hybrid assigns different heads or channel groups within the same layer to distinct sequence mixers, allowing full-context retrieval, streaming or sparse token interaction, and state-based propagation to coexist at every depth. Its central question is how the head budget is apportioned among these mechanisms and whether the assignment is predefined, selected from head function, adapted to the current input, or varied across network depth. Table 14 groups existing methods into Fixed Head Allocation, Function-Aware Head Selection, Input-Adaptive Head Routing, and Depth-Adaptive Head Allocation.
blocks.zh: High-Wise-Hybrid在同一层内为不同的序列混合器分配了不同的头或频道组,允许完全的文本检索,流出或稀有的符号交互,以及基于状态的传播在每一个深度共存. 其中心问题是,在这些机制之间如何分配头预算,以及任务是预先确定的,是从头部职能中选择的,适应当前投入的,还是跨网络深度的不同. 表14将现有方法分为固定头分配、功能-智能头选择、输入-辅助头径和深度-辅助头分配。

blocks.en: Table 14: Head-wise Hybrid designs grouped by the policy used to determine the head allocation.
blocks.zh: 表14:按用于确定人头分配的政策分类的双头混合设计。

blocks.en: 7.2.1 Fixed Head Allocation
blocks.zh: 7.2.1 固定头部分配

blocks.en: Fixed-allocation methods specify the ratio of the two head types during architecture design and keep it identical or approximately identical across the Hybrid layers of a given configuration. Hymba places attention and SSM heads in parallel within a symmetrically formulated fusion module, while its final configurations use an SSM-dominant allocation in which attention heads occupy no more than approximately one fifth of the Mamba heads [ 39 ] . Falcon-H1 uses a more SSM-heavy asymmetric allocation; in its 7B configuration, the attention-to-SSM head budget is approximately 1 : 2 1{:}2 [ 194 ] . Both are native Head-wise Hybrid architectures rather than methods that choose particular positions from a pretrained set of full-attention heads.
blocks.zh: 固定分配方法在架构设计期间指定了两种头型的比例,并在整个组合的混合层保持相同或大致相同. Hymba将注意力和SSM头放在对称配制的聚变模块中平行地放入,而其最终配置则使用SSM主导分配,其中注意力头占据了曼巴头的大约五分之一[39]. Falcon-H1采用了更SSM重的不对称分配;在其7B配置中,注意力到SSM头部预算约为: 1:2 1{:}2 [194]. 两者都是原生的"头智"混合结构,而不是从预先训练的一组全心全意"头"中选择特定位置的方法.

blocks.en: 7.2.2 Function-Aware Head Selection
blocks.zh: 7.2.2 函数智能头选择

blocks.en: DuoAttention separates pretrained attention heads according to their long-context functions. It learns a scalar gate for each head by minimizing the output deviation between full attention and a gated mixture of full and streaming attention, and then binarizes the gates for deployment. Retrieval heads retain full attention and a complete KV cache, whereas streaming heads retain only attention sinks and recent tokens [ 169 ] . DuoAttention therefore combines full-context and structurally sparse Softmax Attention within each layer, using an optimization-based estimate of which heads require global retrieval.
blocks.zh: DuoAttenty根据其长文功能将预先训练的注意力头分开. 它通过将全注意力与全注意力和流注意力相混合的入门相差最小化,为每个头学习一个分级门,然后将门进行二进制来进行部署. 取取头保留了充分的注意力和完整的KV缓存,而流头则只保留注意力下沉和最近的符号 [169]. 因此,DuoAttention将全文本和结构上稀疏的Softmax Reference结合到每一层内,使用一个基于优化的估计数,其中头需要全局检索.

blocks.en: HydraHead extends function-aware selection across different sequence-mixing families. It analyzes the roles of attention heads in retrieval and long-range information processing, preserves the head positions whose functions depend more strongly on full attention, and converts the remaining heads to GDN paths [ 151 ] . The resulting architecture can retain a small aggregate full-attention budget—for example, approximately one full-attention head for every seven GDN heads—but this ratio describes overall resource allocation. Both DuoAttention and HydraHead produce a fixed head assignment after the identification or conversion stage; they differ in whether the efficient heads use streaming attention or a recurrent GDN mechanism.
blocks.zh: Hydrahead 将函数意识选择扩展至不同序列混合家族. 它分析注意头在检索和远程信息处理中的作用,保留其功能更依赖于充分注意的头部位置,将剩下的头部转换为GDN路径 [151]. 由此产生的结构可以保留少量的全额拨款预算——例如,每7个GDN头大约有一个全额拨款头——但这一比率说明了总的资源分配情况。 DuoAttention和Hydrahead在识别或转换阶段后都会产生固定的头部任务;它们在高效的头部是使用流式注意力还是经常性的GDN机制上有所不同.

blocks.en: 7.2.3 Input-Adaptive Head Routing
blocks.zh: 7.2.3 输入式头径

blocks.en: Elastic Attention combines full attention and streaming sparse attention within the same layer, but does not fix one head assignment for every input. A lightweight attention router uses the current sequence representation to assign individual heads to full-attention or sparse-attention computation modes at test time, allowing the model-level sparsity ratio to adapt to the input’s sensitivity to sparse retrieval [ 153 ] . This distinguishes Elastic Attention from offline function-aware selection: DuoAttention and HydraHead identify a deployment topology before inference, whereas Elastic Attention changes the active full/sparse head allocation across inputs.
blocks.zh: 弹性注意力结合了全注意力,并在同一层内流出稀疏的注意力,但并没有为每个输入固定一个头分配. 轻量级关注路由器使用当前序列表示器在测试时将单个头分配到全心或稀有的计算模式上,使模型级的相片相片率能适应输入对稀有检索的敏感度[153]. 这区分了“弹性注意”和“离线函数意识选择”: DuoAttention and Hydrahead在推论前先确定一个部署地貌,而Elastic Reference则会改变各投入的活性全/平面头部分配.

blocks.en: 7.2.4 Depth-Adaptive Head Allocation
blocks.zh: 7.2.4 深度调整型头部分配

blocks.en: Head-wise Hybridization further allows the full-attention/GDN budget to vary with depth. For layer ℓ \ell , H ℓ FA + H ℓ Eff = H , H ℓ Eff : H ℓ FA = k ℓ : 1 , H_{\ell}^{\mathrm{FA}}+H_{\ell}^{\mathrm{Eff}}=H,\qquad H_{\ell}^{\mathrm{Eff}}:H_{\ell}^{\mathrm{FA}}=k_{\ell}:1, (60) where k ℓ k_{\ell} changes across the network so that each depth receives a different amount of exact token-retrieval capacity according to its functional requirements [ 143 ] . Function-aware selection asks which head positions should preserve full attention, input-adaptive routing asks which computation mode each head should use for the current input, and depth-adaptive allocation asks how much full-attention capacity should be assigned at each depth.
blocks.zh: 头向混合进一步使全注/GDN预算随着深度而变化. 对于图层 l\ell, Hl FA + Hl Eff = H, Hl Eff = H, Hl FA = kl: 1, H_{\ell → mathrm{ FA}}+H_{\ → + mathrm{ Eff}}=H,\qquad H_{\ell}^{\mathrm{Eff}}:H_{\ell}^{\mathrm{FA}}=k_{\ell}:1,(60),其中kl kk_{\ell}在整个网络中变化,使每个深度都根据其功能要求得到不同数量的精确的代号检索能力[143]. 函数感知选择询问哪个头位置应当保持充分关注,输入适应的路由询问每个头应该使用哪种计算模式来进行当前输入,深度适应分配则询问每个深度应分配多少全注意能力.

blocks.en: 7.3 Branch-wise Hybrid
blocks.zh: 7.3 分支组合

blocks.en: Branch-wise Hybrid maintains multiple comparatively complete information streams with distinct Memory Representations, Updates, or Readout rules inside the same block. Head-wise Hybrid instead partitions heads or channel groups within a common multi-head structure and typically concatenates their readouts before a shared output projection. We distinguish Branch-wise designs by whether the paths are combined after producing contextual readouts r t ( p ) r_{t}^{(p)} or after independently forming path outputs o t ( p ) o_{t}^{(p)} . The fusion operator alone does not determine the category; the defining property is that the architecture preserves identifiable memory paths rather than partitioning head or channel capacity within one shared module. Table 15 summarizes the two interfaces.
blocks.zh: 分行-hybrid在同一块内维持多个相对完整的信息流,并有不同的内存表示,更新,或Readout规则. 头相混合在共同多头结构内分割头部或信道组,通常在共享输出投影之前进行读取。 我们区分分支设计, 区分路径是在产生上下文读出 r (p) r (p) 后或独立形成路径输出 o (p) o (p) 后合并的 。 聚变操作员本身并不决定类别;定义属性是架构保存可识别的内存路径,而不是在一个共享模块内分割头部或通道容量. 表15概述了这两个接口。

blocks.en: Table 15: Branch-wise Hybrid designs grouped by the interface at which heterogeneous memory paths are combined.
blocks.zh: 表15:按不同内存路径合并的界面分类的分行混合设计.

blocks.en: 7.3.1 Readout-Level Branch Fusion
blocks.zh: 7.3.1 读取处合并

(61) The methods in this category differ in the memories read by each path, the degree of cross-path dependence, and the fusion rule applied to their readouts.

(61)这一类的方法在每种路径所读取的记忆,交叉路径依赖程度,以及聚变规则适用于它们的读取度上都有所不同.

blocks.en: Block-Recurrent Transformer maintains a token stream and a fixed set of recurrent state vectors. In the token direction, token self-attention and token-to-state cross-attention produce parallel readouts that are concatenated before a shared projection. The state direction mirrors this structure: state self-attention and state-to-token cross-attention are combined before gated recurrent updating. It therefore performs readout-level fusion in both directions while jointly producing the current token representations and the recurrent state for the next block [ 67 ] . Unlike the associative matrix used by standard Linear Attention, its recurrent memory consists of multiple explicit state vectors that are read through ordinary attention.
blocks.zh: Block-Recurrent Transformer维持着一个符号流和一套固定的常态向量. 在符号方向上,符号自取和符号对状态的交叉取出产生平行读取,在共享投影之前被调取. 状态取向反射出这种结构:状态自觉和状态相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相相通相相通相通相通相相相相通相通相 因此,它在两个方向上进行读出级聚变,同时联合生成当前符号表示和下个区块的重现状态[67]. 与标准线性注意所使用的关联矩阵不同,它的经常性内存由多个通过普通注意读取的显式状态向量组成.

blocks.en: Memorizing Transformer provides a boundary case for the same interface. It separately reads the local KV context and a top- k k external kNN memory, then combines the two per-head attention results through a learned gate before the usual multi-head output transformation [ 166 ] . Although the external datastore lies outside the model-internal memory emphasized by the core taxonomy, its gated readout interface is directly comparable to internal branch fusion.
blocks.zh: 记忆变形器为同一接口提供了一个边界大小写. 它分别读取了本地的KV上下文和一个上-k k外克克NN内存,然后在通常多头输出转换[166]前通过一个有学识的门将两个每头注意力结果结合. 虽然外部数据库位于核心分类学所强调模型-内部内存之外,但其门接读出接口直接可与内部分支聚变相媲美.

blocks.en: Infini-attention implements the same ordering with model-internal memories. For each head, it first produces a local causal attention context A dot A_{\mathrm{dot}} and a compressive-memory readout A mem A_{\mathrm{mem}} , and then computes A = σ ⁡ ( β ) ⊙ A mem + ( 1 − σ ⁡ ( β ) ) ⊙ A dot . A=\sigma(\beta)\odot A_{\mathrm{mem}}+\left(1-\sigma(\beta)\right)\odot A_{\mathrm{dot}}. (62) The fused head contexts are subsequently concatenated and projected by the shared multi-head output matrix, making this a clear readout-level fusion [ 113 ] .
blocks.zh: Infini-attention 执行同样的订单 与模型-内部记忆。 对每个头,它首先产生一个局部的因果注意上下文 A't A_{\mathrm{dot}} and a compress-memory readout A mem A_{\mathrm{memm}},再计算出 A = σ (β) + ( 1- σ (β) ) A'sigma (\beta)\odot A_{\mathrm{ mem}}+\left (1-\sigma (\beta)\right)\odot A_{\mathrm{dot}}. (62)引信头部上下文随后被共享多头输出矩阵所调和并预测出,使这成为清晰的读出级聚变 [113].

blocks.en: DART couples its paths more tightly because the State-Memory Attention (SMA) branch retrieves from chunk-state memories produced by the Mamba-2 scan and shares the native SSM read vector. Its final combination nevertheless remains at the readout interface: the SMA readout R t R_{t} is added as a scalar-gated residual correction to the SSM readout C t ​ H t C_{t}H_{t} , r t DART = C t ​ H t + G t ​ R t , G t = SiLU ⁡ ( U t ​ W G ) . r_{t}^{\mathrm{DART}}=C_{t}H_{t}+G_{t}R_{t},\qquad G_{t}=\operatorname{SiLU}(U_{t}W_{G}). (63) The resulting representation then continues through the remaining block transformations [ 126 ] . Thus, Block-Recurrent Transformer, Memorizing Transformer, Infini-attention, and DART use different memory substrates and fusion operators, but all combine path readouts before the enclosing module completes its output transformation.

(63) 由此产生的代表性通过剩余的块变换继续. [126]. 因此,Block-Recultural Transformer,memorizing Transformer,Infini-attention,和DART使用不同的内存底部和聚变运算符,但都结合了路径读出,然后才被附加模块完成输出转换.

blocks.en: 7.3.2 Output-Level Branch Fusion
blocks.zh: 7.3.2 产出级部门合并

blocks.en: When each branch first forms its own output, Hybrid-level Integration instead acts on { o t ( p ) } \{o_{t}^{(p)}\} : o t hyb = Fuse o ⁡ ( { o t ( p ) } p ∈ 𝒫 t ; x t ) . o_{t}^{\mathrm{hyb}}=\operatorname{Fuse}_{o}\left(\{o_{t}^{(p)}\}_{p\in\mathcal{P}_{t}};x_{t}\right). (64) Titans-MAG follows this pattern. Its short-term branch applies sliding-window attention, while its neural long-term memory branch independently produces a memory output from the same input.
