blocks.en: 7.4 Token-wise Hybrid
blocks.zh: 7.4 交替操作

blocks.en: Token-wise Hybrid uses token position, a content score, or a learned policy to decide which memory or sequence-mixing path receives a token. Let z i z_{i} denote this architecture-level routing decision for token i i . Depending on the method, the token may remain in recent KV memory, move to sparse historical KV, be compressed into a recurrent state, or be assigned to a different sequence-mixing operation. The routing decision changes memory-level Access only when it changes which represented memory units or state interface are exposed to the current query; routing that merely selects an operator remains mechanism allocation. Table 16 groups the methods by routing signal into Temporal-Boundary Allocation, Content-Score Allocation, and Learned Operation Allocation.
blocks.zh: Token-wise-Hybrid使用符号位置,内容分数,或学习到的政策来决定哪个内存或序列混合路径收到符号. 表示这个架构级的路由决定, 根据方法的不同,符号可能留在最近的KV内存中,移动到稀有的历史KV上,被压缩成再现状态,或者被分配到不同的序列混合操作上. 路由决定只当代表内存单位或状态接口的改变暴露于当前查询中时,才会改变内存级访问;仅选择一个操作员的路由仍为机制分配. 表16按时间-边界分配、内容-分数分配和总结行动分配的信号的路径划分方法。

blocks.en: Table 16: Token-wise Hybrid designs grouped by the signal used to determine token allocation.
blocks.zh: 表16:按用于确定符号分配的信号分组的托肯-睿智混合设计.

blocks.en: 7.4.1 Temporal-Boundary Allocation
blocks.zh: 7.4.1 时间-边界分配

blocks.en: Temporal-boundary methods make a deterministic allocation according to token age, position, or a local-window boundary. LoLCATs applies exact Softmax Attention to the most recent w w tokens and accumulates tokens that leave the window into a Linear Attention state; local tokens and the long-term state are then read through a jointly normalized expression [ 190 ] . Native Hybrid Attention similarly preserves exact KV representations for recent tokens, updates older history into a fixed number of long-term slots, and applies one Softmax readout over the local KV and the slots [ 40 ] . Both use a temporal boundary to determine memory lifecycle, but represent remote history with an associative matrix state and gated slots, respectively.
blocks.zh: 临时边界方法根据象征年龄、位置或地方-窗口边界作出确定性分配。 LoLCATs将精确的Softmax 注意到最近的 w w 令牌,并积累使窗口被放入 Linear 注意状态的令牌;本地令牌和长期状态随后通过共同的正态表达来读取 [190]. 土著混合关注同样保留了最近符号的精确KV表示,将更古老的历史更新为固定数量的长期插槽,并在本地KV和插槽上应用一个Softmax读出[40]. 两者都使用一个时间边界来确定内存的生命周期,但分别以关联矩阵状态和有门槽来代表远程历史.

blocks.en: 7.4.2 Content-Score Allocation
blocks.zh: 7.4.2 内容分数分配

blocks.en: Content-score methods further distinguish which tokens leaving the local window should remain explicitly addressable. Their allocation can be summarized as z i ∈ { KV recent , KV salient , S compressed } . z_{i}\in\left\{\mathrm{KV}_{\mathrm{recent}},\mathrm{KV}_{\mathrm{salient}},S_{\mathrm{compressed}}\right\}. (66) All recent tokens first remain in local KV memory. When a token leaves the window, LoLA uses self-recall error to determine whether it should enter sparse historical KV or be compressed into a Linear Attention state [ 94 ] . STILL performs a similar division using self-saliency: high-saliency history remains accessible through Sparse Attention, while the remaining information is written into a linear state [ 98 ] . These designs extend a fixed temporal lifecycle into content-dependent allocation of memory fidelity.
blocks.zh: 内容分数方法进一步区分了离开当地窗口的哪些符号仍应明确可被处理。 它们的分配可以归纳为z i { KV 最近的, KV 的突出, S 压缩 }. z i}\in\ left {mathrm{ KV}_{\ mathrm{ recent}},\ mathrm{ KV}_{\ mathrm{salient}, S_{\ mathrm{compressed {右>. (66) 所有最近的标志首先留在当地KV记忆中. 当一个令牌离开窗口时,LOLA使用自召错误来确定它是否应该输入稀有的历史 KV 或被压缩为线性注意状态 [94]. 仍使用自成一体进行类似划分:高自成一体的历史仍然可以通过Sparse Record(英语:Sparse Record)访问,而所剩信息则被写入线性状态 [98]. 这些设计将固定的时间寿命周期延伸至内容依赖的记忆忠诚分配.

blocks.en: 7.4.3 Learned Operation Allocation
blocks.zh: 7.4.3 总结经验的行动分配

blocks.en: NAtS-L does not only decide how a token should be stored after it leaves a local window. It searches, at token or chunk granularity, whether the unit should use a Softmax Attention or GDN operation: z i = arg ⁡ max o ∈ 𝒪 ​ p θ ​ ( o ∣ x i , ℋ i ) , 𝒪 = { Softmax , GDN } . z_{i}=\arg\max_{o\in\mathcal{O}}p_{\theta}(o\mid x_{i},\mathcal{H}_{i}),\qquad\mathcal{O}=\{\mathrm{Softmax},\mathrm{GDN}\}. (67) Tokens assigned to the Softmax operation retain explicit KV representations, whereas those assigned to GDN propagate through a recurrent state [ 35 ] . Routing thus progresses from a predetermined time boundary and hand-designed content score to learned or search-derived assignment of sequence-mixing operations.
blocks.zh: NatS-L不仅在某个符号离开本地窗口后决定如何存储. 它按符号或块颗粒度搜索单元是否应该使用Softmax 注意或GDN操作:z i = arg max o o o o o p θ (o ∣ x i,H i),O = {Softmax,GDN}. z i arg\max\o\in mathcal{O}}p_{\theta}(o\mid) x_{i},\ mathcal{H}_{i},\quad\mathcal{O}=\{\-mathrm{Softmax},\mathrm{GDN{} (67) 分配给Softmax操作的托肯保留了明确的KV表示,而分配给GDN的表示则通过经常状态传播[35]. 因此,从预先确定的时间界限和手工设计的内容分数,到学习或搜索后分配序列混合操作,都取得了进展。

blocks.en: 7.5 Summary
blocks.zh: 7.5 总结

blocks.en: The preceding comparison shifts the question of efficient sequence modeling from whether one mechanism can fully replace Softmax Attention to how heterogeneous mechanisms can divide and coordinate contextual processing. Hybrid Architecture is therefore not an additional sequence mixer, but a compositional design paradigm in which explicit token retrieval, sparse access, local interaction, and recurrent propagation can be assigned to different structural units within the same model.
blocks.zh: 前面的比较将高效的序列建模问题从一种机制是否能够完全取代Softmax 注意到各种机制如何能够分割和协调背景处理。 因此,"混合架构"并不是额外的序列搅拌器,而是组成式的设计范式,在这个范式中,可以将明确的代号检索,稀有访问,局部交互,并经常被分配到同一模型内不同的结构单元.

blocks.en: Hybrid designs distribute complementary capabilities across progressively finer and more tightly coordinated granularities. Layer-wise methods arrange largely self-contained mixers across network depth. Head-wise methods place heterogeneous retrieval and state-propagation capabilities within a shared layer, Branch-wise methods coordinate comparatively complete memory paths at the readout or output interface, and Token-wise methods determine how individual tokens or chunks are represented or processed. These granularities are composable rather than mutually exclusive, allowing one architecture to coordinate complementary mechanisms across several structural axes.
blocks.zh: 混合设计将互补能力分布在更精细、更紧密协调的颗粒体之间。 分层方法主要安排自成一体的搅拌器,跨越网络深度. 头取法将不同的检索和状态传播能力放在一个共享的层中,分取法在读出或输出界面上协调相对完整的内存路径,而Token-wise法则决定个人的指使或块是如何表示或处理的. 这些颗粒是可相容的,而不是相互排斥的,使得一个架构能够协调跨越几个结构轴的互补机制.

blocks.en: The central technical development is a shift from module coexistence toward deeper coordination of heterogeneous memory paths. Coarse Layer-wise composition primarily controls where each mechanism is used, whereas finer-grained designs can additionally couple memory representations, lifecycle decisions, readout rules, and output formation. Head-wise allocation divides representational and retrieval capacity inside a layer; Branch-wise fusion combines multiple contextual readouts or independently formed path outputs; and Token-wise allocation determines whether particular information remains explicitly addressable or is incorporated into a compressed recurrent state. The scope of complementarity therefore expands from arranging separate modules to jointly organizing how heterogeneous memories are formed, accessed, and combined.
blocks.zh: 中心技术发展是从模块共存转向更深入地协调各种记忆路径。 粗细的地层成份主要控制每个机制的使用地点,而精细的地层设计则可以将内存表达、生命周期决定、读出规则和输出形成等附加在一起。 头向分配将代表能力和检索能力划分在一个层内; 分局聚合结合了多个上下文读出或独立形成的路径输出; 脚向分配决定特定信息是否仍可明确处理,或者是否被纳入压缩的经常性状态. 因此,互补性的范围从安排单独的单元扩大到联合组织如何形成、取用和合并各种不同的记忆。

blocks.en: 8 Attention Designs in Publicly Documented LLM Architectures: Evolution, Coordination, and Frontier Adoption
blocks.zh: 8 公开记录LLM中的注意设计 结构:演变、协调和边疆收养

blocks.en: The preceding sections examine attention and related sequence-mixing mechanisms at the method level. This section turns to their use in publicly documented autoregressive language-model backbones and asks three architecture-level questions: whether attention design is converging toward one dominant form, how heterogeneous mechanisms are combined within individual models, and which attention structures are represented among high-performing open-weight models.
blocks.zh: 以上各节审查了方法层面的关注和相关序列混合机制. 本节介绍它们用于公开记录的自相递减语言模式主干线的情况,并提出了三个架构层面的问题:注意力设计是否正在趋同于一种主导形式,不同机制是如何在单个模式内结合的,以及哪些注意力结构体现在高性能的开放量模型中。

blocks.en: Our first evidence set is a longitudinal inventory of 59 release-level architecture records spanning 14 major model lineages from 2022 through September 22, 2026. Models released together are grouped when they share the same language-model attention backbone, whereas separately released versions remain separate records; a documented change in the attention backbone also defines a separate record. The inventory is based primarily on official papers, technical reports, model cards, and released configurations. Although several included releases are natively multimodal, the unit of analysis remains the autoregressive language-model backbone. We include such models only when their causal language backbone is publicly documented and relevant to the evolution of attention design, and exclude vision or audio encoders, modality projectors, cross-modal interfaces, and other modality-specific components from the classification. The chapter therefore remains an analysis of LLM attention architectures rather than a survey of multimodal architectures. The complete inventory and source mapping are provided in Supplementary Table S1 .
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个证据集是59个发布级建筑记录的纵向盘点,涵盖从2022年到2026年9月22日的14个主要模型行. 一起发布的模型在共享同一种语言-模型关注主干时被分组,而单独发布的版本仍然是单独的记录;关注主干中记录的变化也定义了单独的记录. 清册主要以公文,技术报告,模版卡,发布配置为主. 虽然其中的一些版本是本土的多式的,但分析单位仍然是自动递减的语言模式骨干。 只有当这些模型的因果语言主干部分被公开记录并与注意力设计的演变相关时,我们才将它们列入其中,并将视觉或音频编码器、模式投影器、跨模式界面和其他模式特定组成部分排除在分类之外。 因此,本章仍然是对LLM关注架构的分析,而不是对多式联运架构的调查。 补充表S1提供了完整的清单和源图。

blocks.en: Our second evidence set is a frozen comparison of high-performing open-weight models from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, captured on September 22, 2026 [ 6 , 8 , 7 ] . It provides a cross-sectional view of attention designs near the open-weight performance frontier, while the longitudinal inventory characterizes architectural development over time. Both analyses are descriptive: the inventory is purposively curated rather than exhaustive or market-share weighted, and leaderboard scores depend on model scale, training, post-training, reasoning budget, and systems implementation in addition to attention design. We therefore use these evidence sets to characterize adoption and coexistence, not to infer that a particular attention mechanism causes higher model quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二套证据是2026年9月22日捕获的人工分析智能指数v4.3.2的高性能开放量模型的冷冻比较[6,8,7]. 它为开放量级的性能前沿附近的注意力设计提供了跨部门的视角,而纵向盘点则呈现出随着时间推移的建筑发展特征. 这两种分析都是描述性的:清单是有目的的,而不是详尽无遗的或市场份额加权的,领导板的分数取决于模型规模、培训、培训后、推理预算以及系统实施以及注意力设计。 因此,我们利用这些证据集来描述收养和共存的特点,而不是推断某种特殊关注机制会提高模型的质量。

blocks.en: Figure 14 visualizes the 58 classifiable records in the longitudinal inventory; Kimi k1.5 is omitted because its attention architecture is not separately disclosed. Family-level records with distinct scale-specific variants may appear as multiple nodes, so the figure is not a one-to-one count of release records. Node fills encode attention composition, outlines summarize context-length tiers, and labels are limited to representative releases to preserve readability.
blocks.zh: 图14可视化了纵向盘点中的58个可分类记录;Kimi k1.5省略了,因为它的注意力架构没有单独披露. 具有不同比例特有变体的家族级记录可能作为多节点出现,因此该数字并不是一对一的释放记录. 节点填充了编码的注意成分,提纲总结了上下文长度的分级,而标签仅限于代表性放出来保存可读性.

blocks.en: Figure 14: Attention designs across the classifiable architecture inventory. For natively multimodal systems, only the autoregressive language-model backbone is classified. Fill colors encode attention composition, split fills denote heterogeneous designs, and outlines indicate broad context-length tiers. The increasing concentration of split-fill nodes in recent years indicates the growing use of Hybrid architectures; the figure is descriptive and does not imply performance rankings or causal relationships.
blocks.zh: 图 14,可分类建筑目录的注意设计. 对于本土多模式系统,只有自旋式语言模式骨干被分类. 填入颜色编码注意分层构成,分层填入表示不同的设计,并出图表示宽上下文长的分层. 近年来分填节点的日益集中表明混合结构的使用越来越多;该数字是描述性的,并不意味着性能排名或因果关系.

blocks.en: 8.1 Diversification Rather Than Convergence in Attention Design
blocks.zh: 8.1 多样化而不是注意设计方面的趋同

blocks.en: The longitudinal inventory shows diversification rather than convergence on one attention type. Dense MHA evolved toward MQA and GQA to reduce KV-head redundancy while preserving full token-level retrieval, and GQA remains a widely used backbone in recent Llama [ 53 ] , Qwen [ 175 ] , Mistral [ 109 ] , MiniMax [ 21 ] , MiniCPM [ 120 ] , and K2-Horizon releases [ 69 ] . In parallel, MLA [ 30 , 95 , 88 ] compresses per-token KV representations, local and sparse attention [ 32 , 187 ] restrict explicit access, and recurrent mechanisms such as Gated DeltaNet [ 130 ] , Lightning Attention [ 104 ] , KDA [ 76 ] , and Mamba [ 116 ] replace part of repeated token retrieval with fixed-size state. These approaches reduce different costs and retain different memory interfaces, so they continue to coexist rather than forming a single replacement sequence.
blocks.zh: 纵向清单显示多样化,而不是一种关注类型的趋同。 Dense MHA逐渐向MQA和GQA发展,以减少KV-头部冗余,同时保留了完整的令牌级检索,GQA在近期的Llama [53],Quen [175],Mistral [109],MiniMax [21],MiniCPM [120],K2-Horizon发布[69]中仍然是被广泛使用的骨干. 同时,MLA [30, 95, 88] 压缩每盘KV的表示,局部和稀疏的注意[32, 187] 限制明确的取用,并限制Gated DeltaNet [130],闪电注意 [104],KDA [76],和Mamba [116] 等经常性机制,以固定大小的状态取代了部分重复的令牌取用. 这些方法降低了不同的成本并保留了不同的内存接口,因此它们继续并存,而不是形成单一的替换序列.

blocks.en: Model lineages also change direction rather than following a monotonic progression. DeepSeek develops from MLA to MLA-based sparse retrieval and then to CSA/HCA and CSA2 [ 30 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] ; Qwen moves from MHA and GQA to recurrent-state architectures combined with full attention in Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5, and Qwen3.6, and with sparse attention in Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ 9 , 174 , 130 , 131 , 133 , 132 , 128 ] ; MiniMax moves from Lightning/Softmax hybrids to full GQA and then to dense/sparse attention [ 104 , 21 , 105 ] ; and LongCat moves from MLA in LongCat-Flash and LongCat-Flash-Lite to LSA in LongCat-2.0 and LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse [ 95 , 88 , 187 , 96 ] . The resulting landscape is therefore best understood as several persistent design routes—shared-KV dense attention, latent KV compression, restricted explicit access, and recurrent-state propagation—that are increasingly recombined in different models.
blocks.zh: 型号线条也改变方向,而不是遵循单音节进取. DeepSeek从MLA发展到以MLA为基础的稀有检索,再发展到CSA/HCA和CSA2[30,32,33,34];从MHA和GQA移动到常态建筑,并在Qune3-Next,Qune3.5,和Qune3.6中得到充分关注,在Qune3.8-Flash-Next[9,174,130,131,133,132,128];从闪电/Softmax混合体移动到全GQA,再到密集/sparse关注 [104,21,105];从MLongCat-Flash和LongCat-Flash-Lite到LSA的LongCat-2.0和LongCat-Flash-Lite-Lipers[95,88,187,96]. 因此,由此形成的地貌最好被理解为几条持久的设计路线——共享-KV密集关注、潜在的KV压缩、限制明确的访问和经常状态的传播——这些路线在不同的模型中日益重新组合。

blocks.en: 8.2 Increasing Hybridization and Emerging Cross-Layer Reuse
blocks.zh: 8.2 增加混合和新兴的跨层再使用

blocks.en: Hybrid composition becomes more common in the recent inventory, primarily through predetermined layer-wise schedules. Of the 59 release-level records, 58 disclose enough information for classification: 32 retain one principal attention or memory family, while 26 are classified as Hybrid. These are release-level records rather than 26 distinct architectural patterns. Table 17 shows that Hybrid records increase from none in 2022–2023 to 9 of 25 in 2024–2025 and 17 of 27 in 2026. The dominant forms are local/global explicit-attention schedules and recurrent-state/explicit-attention schedules, in which complementary capabilities are assigned to different layers and coordinated through the hidden-state stream.
blocks.zh: 混合构成在最近的库存中变得更加普遍,主要是通过预先确定的分层时间表。 在59个发布级记录中,有58个披露了足够的信息进行分类:32个保留了1个主要关注或记忆家族,而26个被归类为Hybrid. 这些是发行层记录,而不是26个不同的建筑图案. 表17显示,混合记录从2022-2023年的零增长到2024-2025年的25个中的9个和2026年的27个中的17个。 主要形式是地方/全球明确注意时间表和经常状态/明确注意时间表,其中互补能力分配到不同的层次,并通过隐藏状态流加以协调。

blocks.en: Table 17: Temporal distribution of Single-family, Hybrid, and cross-layer-coordinated architectures in the publicly documented model inventory. Single-family and Hybrid are mutually exclusive labels; cross-layer coordination is an overlapping attribute.
blocks.zh: 表17:公开记录的示范清单中单一家庭、混合体和跨层次协调结构的临时分布。 单家庭与"混合"是相互排斥的标签;跨层次的协调是重叠的属性.

blocks.en: Cross-layer reuse introduces a distinct form of coordination by extending the depth-wise lifetime of memory and routing artifacts. Across the documented cases, GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3 reuse retrieval indices or top- k k candidate decisions through IndexShare/IndexCache [ 183 , 185 , 10 ] ; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash additionally reuses selected global KV representations and indexer keys through the Full, Reindex, and Reuse modes of CSA2 [ 34 ] ; and LongCat-2.0 and LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse use LSA’s Cross-Layer Indexing to reuse one layer’s selected token set across subsequent layers [ 187 , 96 ] . Hybrid composition describes where complementary mechanisms are placed; cross-layer reuse describes whether artifacts produced at one depth remain available to later layers. The latter is currently documented in five records, but it extends coordination from module placement to the depth-wise persistence of memory and routing artifacts.
blocks.zh: 跨层再利用通过延长记忆和路由文物的深度寿命,引入了独特的协调形式. 在有记录的案件中,GLM-5.2和GLM-5.3再利用指数或通过IndexShare/IndexCache[183、185、10]的上-克候选决定;DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash通过CSA2的Full、Reindex和再使用模式额外再利用选定的全球KV表示和索引键[34];以及LongCat-2.0和LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse使用LSA的Cros-Layer 索引以重复使用一个层的选定符号集,跨越随后的层 [187,96]. 混合成分说明将互补机制放置在哪里;跨层再利用说明在一个深度所出产的文物是否仍然可供后层取用. 后者目前被记录在5个记录中,但它将协调范围从模块放置延伸到了内存和路由文物的深度持久性.

blocks.en: 8.3 Attention Designs among High-Performing Open-Weight Models
blocks.zh: 8.3 高效开放-重量模型的注意设计

blocks.en: The frozen Artificial Analysis comparison provides a cross-sectional view of the attention structures represented near the open-weight performance frontier. Table 18 reports the eleven high-performing open-weight endpoints retained in the September 22, 2026 snapshot. Reasoning settings such as “max” and “xhigh” are treated as endpoint configurations rather than separate architectures. The endpoint selection follows the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 snapshot, while release dates, parameter scales, and attention structures are based on the corresponding public model documentation and the source mapping in Supplementary Table S1 [ 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 冷冻的人工分析比较提供了对开放量性能前沿附近所表现的注意力结构的交叉剖面. 表18报告了2026年9月22日快照中保留的11个高性能开放量端点. “最大”和“x高”等理性设置被视为终点配置,而不是单独的架构。 端点选择遵循人工分析智能指数v4.3.2快照,而发布日期,参数尺度,关注结构则基于相应的公共模型文档和补充表S1 [6,7]中的源地映射.

blocks.en: Table 18: Attention structures of the eleven selected high-performing open-weight model endpoints in the Artificial Analysis snapshot captured on September 22, 2026. Rows are ordered by release date in reverse chronological order. Model size reports total parameters; disclosed active parameters are shown in parentheses [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 表18:2026年9月22日拍摄的"人工分析快照"中11个选取的高性能开量模型端点的注意结构. 行按出行日期顺序为倒序顺序. 模型大小报告总参数;所披露活性参数以括号显示 [7].

blocks.en: The frontier comparison remains architecturally heterogeneous. The selected models include full GQA, latent-compressed sparse attention, block-sparse attention, local/global or compressed dense/sparse hybrids, and recurrent-state layers combined with full, latent, or sparse explicit retrieval. Hybrid structures are prominent but not universal: K2-Horizon retains full GQA and GLM-5.3 uses a single DSA family, while the other endpoints combine distinct access or state-propagation routes. At the same time, every selected architecture retains an explicit token-retrieval path, indicating that recurrent state and sparsity currently complement rather than uniformly replace token-addressable attention. The table demonstrates coexistence at the performance frontier; its chronological ordering does not rank attention mechanisms or imply that any particular mechanism causes higher model quality.
blocks.zh: 边界比较在结构上仍然是多种多样的。 选定的模型包括完整的GQA、潜在压缩的稀疏注意力、块散注意力、局部/全球或压缩的稠密/散射杂交体,以及经常状态层与完全、潜在或稀疏的显式检索相结合。 混合结构突出而并非通用:K2-Horizon保留了完整的GQA,而GLM-5.3则使用单一的DSA家族,而其他端点则结合了不同的接入或状态传播路线. 同时,所选的每个架构都保留了一条明确的代号检索路径,表明反复出现的状态和相片目前是补充而不是统一取代代号处理的注意力. 该表表明在性能前沿共存;其时间顺序并不将注意机制排序,也不意味着任何特定机制都会导致更高的模型质量。

blocks.en: 8.4 Summary
blocks.zh: 8.4 总结

blocks.en: The longitudinal inventory and the frozen frontier comparison support the same conclusion: current LLM attention design is diversifying rather than converging. Hybrid records have become more common and are still organized mainly through fixed layer-wise composition, while cross-layer reuse remains a limited but conceptually distinct extension that increases the depth-wise persistence of selected memory and routing artifacts. High-performing open-weight models preserve this diversity and continue to combine efficient state propagation or sparse access with explicit token retrieval.
blocks.zh: 纵向清单和被冻结的边界比较也支持同样的结论:目前的LLM关注设计是多样化的,而不是趋同的。 混合记录已变得更加普遍,仍然主要通过固定的分层组成来组织,而跨层再利用仍然是有限但概念上截然不同的延伸,可以提高所选内存和路由文物的深度持久性. 高性能的开放量级模型保持了这种多样性,并继续将高效的状态传播或稀少的获取与明确的代号检索结合起来。

blocks.en: 9 Synthesis Across Mechanisms, Architectures, and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 9 跨机制、架构和未来方向的综合

blocks.en: The preceding chapters reveal that the evolution of attention-centered sequence architectures can be understood, at least in part, as an expanding redesign of contextual memory rather than simply as a succession of attempts to replace one operator. Explicit token memories, recurrent associative states, structured state-space models, and hybrid architectures begin from different technical formulations, yet repeatedly confront a related set of design questions: which memory units are maintained, how new information updates them, which represented information is made available to a query, how that information is read, and how multiple readouts are coordinated. Across the literature reviewed in this survey, the design focus consequently expands from optimizing an isolated interaction rule toward organizing the representation, lifecycle, and use of contextual memory as a whole.
blocks.zh: 前几章揭示出,以注意力为中心的序列架构的演变至少可以部分理解为对上下文内存的不断重新设计,而不只是一系列试图替换一个操作员的尝试. 明确的象征记忆,经常性的关联状态,结构化的状态-空间模型,以及混合结构从不同的技术配方开始,然而反复面对一系列相关的设计问题:哪些内存单位被维护,新信息如何更新,代表信息提供给查询,信息如何被读取,如何协调多个读取. 因此,在本次调查审查的文献中,设计重点从优化孤立的互动规则扩大到组织整个背景记忆的代表性、生命周期和使用。

blocks.en:
Building on this perspective, this section develops a three-level synthesis that traces the evolution of memory control from mechanism design to architectural coordination and future memory systems. At the mechanism level , explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods begin from different memory representations and computational forms, yet both gradually
extend the scope of control from their respective core concerns to a broader set of functions spanning Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration. The ranges of memory functions explicitly controlled by the two routes consequently show a growing degree of overlap. At the architecture level , an important direction is to integrate memory mechanisms with complementary capabilities within a single model. This complementarity is currently realized primarily through predetermined layer-wise composition, while recent systems begin to extend coordination beyond module placement to the cross-layer sharing, reuse, and refresh of selected memory and routing artifacts. At the forward-looking level , we further synthesize these mechanism- and architecture-level developments into a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis spanning temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation resolution.
blocks.zh:
以这个观点为基础,本节发展出一个三级综合,来追溯内存控制从机制设计到建筑协调和未来内存系统的演变. 在机制层面,明确记忆和重复状态方法从不同的内存表示和计算形式开始,但两者都是逐步的。
将控制范围从各自的核心关切扩大到涵盖内存代表、内存更新、访问、读取和整合等更广泛的一系列职能。 因此,两种途径明确控制的内存功能范围显示,重叠程度正在增加。 在结构层面,一个重要的方向是将具有互补能力的记忆机制纳入单一模式。 目前,这种互补性主要是通过预先确定的分层构成实现的,而最近的系统开始将协调范围从模块放置扩大到跨层共享、再利用和刷新选定的内存和路由文物。 在前瞻性层面,我们将这些机制和架构层面的发展进一步综合成一个跨越时间范围、网络深度、底部类型和代表性分辨率的具有状态的多维记忆路径假设。

blocks.en: 9.1 Mechanism Level: Distinct Starting Points and Expanding Control Scopes
blocks.zh: 9.1 机制级别:区分起点和扩大控制范围

blocks.en:
At the mechanism level, the surveyed literature suggests two broad routes for organizing contextual memory. The explicit-memory route retains an enumerable memory interface while reducing the cost of representing or accessing its units. The state-based route compresses history into
recurrently maintained states while improving their capacity, update control, and recoverability. These routes represent different predominant memory forms and design pressures rather than mutually exclusive model classes.
blocks.zh:
在机制一级,调查文献提出了组织背景记忆的两大途径。 明确记忆路由保留了可假设的内存界面,同时降低了代表或访问其单位的成本. 州道压缩历史
经常维持状态,同时提高其能力、更新控制以及恢复能力。 这些路线代表了不同的主要内存形式和设计压力,而不是相互排斥的模型类.

blocks.en: Explicit-memory route. As reviewed in Sections 3 and 4 , this route represents contextual memory through token KVs, shared or latent token representations, bounded slots, blocks, or lower-resolution summaries. Its primary emphasis lies in Memory Representation and Access: methods reduce redundancy across heads, channels, or layers, alter the resolution of stored history, restrict the candidate set exposed to a query, or reuse representations and retrieval decisions. Its control scope also extends to Memory Update when bounded or multiresolution memories merge, replace, or consolidate historical information; to Readout when routing scores, summary estimates, or modified attention maps affect the aggregation of eligible memory; and to Integration through head coordination, output gating, or the combination of multiple readout components. The route therefore retains an enumerable memory interface while extending control from representation and access efficiency to the broader lifecycle and use of the represented memory.
blocks.zh: 分明相通之道. 如第3和4节所审查的那样,这一路线通过符号KV、共享或潜在符号表示、限定槽、块或低分辨率摘要来表示背景内存。 其主要重点是内存表示和访问:方法减少头、道或分层的冗余,改变存储历史的解析,限制被查询的候选人集,或重复表示和检索决定。 其控制范围还延伸到了内存更新,当被捆绑或多分辨率的内存合并,替换,或合并历史信息时;当路由分数,汇总估计,或修改后的关注地图影响合格内存的集合时,可读取;再到通过头协调,输出取出,或多读取组件的组合而来. 因此,该路由保留了可假设的内存接口,同时将控制范围从表现和访问效率延伸到更广泛的生命周期和所代表内存的使用.

blocks.en: State-based route. As reviewed in Sections 5 and 6 , this route replaces a growing list of token-wise memories with one or more recurrently maintained distributed states. Its primary emphasis lies in Memory Representation and Memory Update: methods determine how historical information is compressed, accumulated, retained, corrected, overwritten, or selectively propagated. Its control scope expands through additional rows, slots, partitions, temporal summaries, and state groups that differentiate memory capacity and temporal resolution; selection among these units makes Access more explicit; conditioned, multi-channel, or multi-state projections enrich Readout; and gating or coordination among completed state readouts makes Integration a direct design consideration. The route therefore extends from constructing and updating a compressed state toward organizing how multiple state units are represented, maintained, exposed, read, and coordinated.
blocks.zh: 国道. 正如第5和6节所审查的那样,这条路线用一个或更多经常维持的分布状态代替越来越多的象征性记忆清单。 它的主要重点是"记忆代表"和"记忆更新":方法决定了历史信息是如何被压缩,被积累,被保留,被更正,被覆盖,或者被有选择地被传播. 它的控制范围通过额外的行,槽,分区,时间摘要,以及区分内存容量和时间分辨率的状态组来扩大;在这些单元中的选择使得Access更加明确;有条件的,多通道的,或多状态的预测丰富了Readout;在已完成的状态读取之间进行配位或协调使得Institution成为直接的设计考虑. 因此,这条路线从构建和更新压缩状态延伸到组织如何代表、维护、暴露、阅读和协调多个州单位。

blocks.en: Figure 15 summarizes the distinct starting points and expanding control scopes of the two routes. Darker cells indicate each route’s primary emphasis, whereas lighter cells mark functions that become more explicit in subsequent designs. The columns are functional dimensions rather than a mandatory execution sequence.
blocks.zh: 图15总结了两条航道的不同起点和不断扩大的控制范围。 更暗的细胞表示每个路由的主要重心,而更轻的细胞标记功能在后期设计中变得更加明确. 柱子是功能维度而非强制执行序列.

blocks.en: Figure 15: Mechanism-level synthesis of the expanding control scopes of explicit-memory and state-based methods. For the five functional dimensions, the upper-right mini-bars represent 2017–2018, 2019–2020, 2021–2022, 2023–2024, and 2025–2026 from left to right; taller and darker bars indicate greater qualitative activity among the representative methods discussed in Sections 3 – 6 . The 2026 coverage extends through September.
blocks.zh: 图15 机制层面对明镜和以州为主的方法不断扩大的控制范围的综述. 对于五个功能维度,上行右小巴代表2017–2018,2019–2020,2021–2022,2023–2024和2025–2026从左到右;更高更深的条表示在第3–6节所讨论代表性方法中具有更大的质量活性. 2026年覆盖期延长至9月.

blocks.en: Synthesis 1: Growing Overlap in the Scope of Memory Control Explicit-memory and state-based methods retain different memory interfaces and computational forms, yet both expand from their respective initial emphases toward a broader and increasingly overlapping set of memory functions. The convergence lies in the scope of explicit design control across Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration, rather than in a shared memory substrate or computational mechanism.
blocks.zh: 综述一:内存控制范围重叠现象日益严重 明镜和基于状态的方法保留了不同的内存界面和计算形式,然而两者都从各自最初的强调向更广泛的和日益重叠的一套内存功能扩展. 趋同之处在于整个内存代表、内存更新、访问、读取和整合的明确设计控制范围,而不是共享内存底板或计算机制。

blocks.en: This growing overlap in control scope provides the mechanism-level basis for the architecture-level development examined next. As Representation, Update, Access, Readout, and Integration become more explicit and coordinated design variables, hybrid architectures can combine complementary memory capabilities across layers, heads, branches, and tokens rather than requiring one mechanism to satisfy every quality–cost trade-off. The next subsection examines how this complementarity is realized in publicly documented LLM architectures and how coordination begins to extend from module placement to the cross-layer lifecycle of selected memory and routing artifacts.
blocks.zh: 控制范围日益重叠,为接下来审查的结构一级发展提供了机制一级的基础。 随着代表性、更新、访问、读取和整合变得更加明确和协调的设计变量,混合结构可以将不同层、头、分支和象征的补充记忆能力结合起来,而不是需要一种机制来满足质量-成本的权衡。 下分节审查在公开记录的LLM架构中如何实现这种互补性,以及如何开始将协调从模块放置扩展到选定内存和路由文物的跨层生命周期.

blocks.en: 9.2 Architecture-Level Synthesis: From Complementary Placement to Memory-Artifact Lifecycles
blocks.zh: 9.2 结构层面综合: 从补充放置到内存-艺术生命周期

blocks.en: The inventory analysis in Section 8.2 , summarized in Table 17 , reveals two ways in which contextual memory is increasingly organized along network depth: the layer-wise composition of heterogeneous memory mechanisms and the cross-layer reuse of selected memory and routing artifacts. Layer-wise composition determines what form of memory processing occurs at each representational stage, whereas cross-layer reuse determines which artifacts produced at one stage remain available to later stages. Together, these developments bring the construction, maintenance, and reuse of contextual memory along network depth into the architecture-level design space.
blocks.zh: 表17概述的第8.2节中的清单分析显示,背景内存越来越多地按照网络深度排列:不同内存机制的分层组成和选定内存和路由文物的跨层再利用。 分层构成决定了每个表达阶段的内存处理形式,而跨层再利用则决定了某一阶段出产的哪些文物仍然可供后期使用. 这些发展共同将网络深度沿线背景内存的构建、维护和再利用带入建筑一级设计空间。

blocks.en: Within the current sample, Hybrid records become more common and are organized mainly through predetermined layer-wise schedules. Explicit attention supports fine-grained query-dependent retrieval, Sparse Attention restricts the candidate budget, and recurrent Linear Attention or SSM layers propagate compressed history with bounded or slowly growing decoding state. Coordinated through the hidden-state stream, these mechanisms apply different memory operations as a representation moves through the network. Layer-wise composition therefore organizes complementary memory capabilities across depth, allowing different representational stages to contribute different forms of retrieval, compression, and state propagation.
blocks.zh: 在当前样本中,混合记录变得更加普遍,主要通过事先确定的分层时间表来编排。 明确注意支持精细的依赖查询的检索,Sparse Content限制候选预算,经常性的Linear Content或SSM层以受约束或缓慢增长的解码状态来传播压缩历史. 通过隐藏状态流来协调,这些机制在通过网络进行表现动作时应用了不同的内存操作. 因此,逐层构成组织跨深度的补充内存能力,允许不同的代表阶段提供不同形式的检索、压缩和状态传播。

blocks.en: Layer-wise composition changes the memory processing performed at each depth; cross-layer reuse changes the lifetime of the resulting artifacts. In the documented cases, selected KV representations, index states, or candidate decisions remain available across depth instead of being independently reconstructed at every layer. This introduces a distinction between capability placement —which memory functions operate at different depths—and artifact-lifecycle coordination —which memory or routing artifacts persist across layers and when they are reused or refreshed. In the current inventory, layer-wise Hybrid composition is already common, whereas explicit cross-layer artifact reuse is confined to five release-level records corresponding to three architectural patterns documented across GLM [ 183 , 185 , 10 ] , DeepSeek [ 34 ] , and LongCat [ 187 , 96 ] systems.
blocks.zh: 分层组成会改变每个深度所完成的内存处理;跨层再利用会改变所生成文物的寿命. 在有文件记载的情况下,选定的KV表述、指数状态或候选人决定仍然可以深入查阅,而不是在每一层进行独立重建。 这就对能力定位——这种记忆功能在不同深度运作——和文物-生命周期协调——进行了区分,这种记忆或路由的文物在多层之间持续存在,并在它们被再利用或被刷新时持续存在。 在目前的清单中,分层混合构成已经很普遍,而明确的跨层文物再利用仅限于5个释放级记录,这些记录与整个GLM[183、185、10]、DeepSeek[34]和LongCat[187、96]系统中记录的三种建筑模式相对应。

blocks.en: Synthesis 2: Network Depth as an Emerging Dimension of Memory Organization Layer-wise composition determines what memory processing occurs at each depth, while cross-layer reuse determines what memory artifacts persist across depth. Together, they make network depth an emerging dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed.
blocks.zh: 合成2:网络深度作为记忆组织的新维度 层相通的构成决定了每个深度发生什么内存处理,而跨层再利用则决定了哪些内存文物在纵深持续. 它们共同使网络深度成为一个新兴维度,据此构建和管理背景记忆。

blocks.en: Viewed together, these developments shift the architecture-level question from which mechanism each layer should use to how memory should be organized across the network as a whole. As representations move through successive layers, memory may be retrieved, compressed, transformed, or propagated by different mechanisms, while selected intermediate artifacts may remain available to later stages. Network depth thus becomes an additional coordinate for organizing where contextual memory is produced, transformed, maintained, reused, and refreshed. This perspective motivates the forward-looking multidimensional memory organization considered next.
blocks.zh: 从整体来看,这些发展将建筑层面的问题从每一层应使用何种机制转向整个网络应如何组织记忆。 随着表示物相继地层的移动,内存可能会被取回,压缩,转化,或被不同的机制所传播,而所选取的中间文物可能仍然可供后期使用. 因此,网络深度成为另一个坐标,用于组织产生、转化、维护、再利用和刷新背景记忆的地方。 这一视角激励了下一步考虑的前瞻性多层面记忆组织。

blocks.en: 9.3 Forward-Looking Hypothesis: Stateful Multidimensional Memory Routing
blocks.zh: 9.3 前瞻性假设:国家多层面 内存运行

blocks.en: The mechanism- and architecture-level syntheses above motivate a broader design space for contextual memory. At the mechanism level, explicit-memory and state-based methods increasingly control overlapping sets of memory functions. At the architecture level, complementary capabilities are commonly distributed across layers, while a small number of recent systems begin to extend the lifecycle of selected memory and routing artifacts across network depth. Taken together, these developments suggest that persistent memory could be organized and controlled jointly across multiple architectural coordinates, rather than being defined only by temporal position or by the mechanism of one layer.
blocks.zh: 上面的机制和架构层面的合成激发了更广泛的背景记忆设计空间. 在机制层面,清晰的记忆和基于状态的方法越来越多地控制了重叠的内存功能集. 在建筑层面,互补能力通常分层分布,而少数近期的系统开始将所选内存和路由文物的寿命周期延伸至网络深度. 这些发展综合起来表明,可以跨越多个建筑坐标,共同组织和控制持续记忆,而不只是根据时间位置或一层机制来界定。

blocks.en: 9.3.1 Multidimensional Memory as an Address Space
blocks.zh: 9.3.1 多层面记忆作为地址空间

blocks.en: We represent the admissible addresses of persistent memory by four coordinates: 𝒜 t = 𝒯 t × ℒ × 𝒮 × 𝒢 , ℳ t = { M t ​ [ a ] | a ∈ 𝒜 t } ∈ 𝔐 ρ , \mathcal{A}_{t}=\mathcal{T}_{t}\times\mathcal{L}\times\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{G},\qquad\mathcal{M}_{t}=\left\{M_{t}[a]\,\middle|\,a\in\mathcal{A}_{t}\right\}\in\mathfrak{M}_{\rho}, (68) where an address a = ( τ , ℓ , s , g ) a=(\tau,\ell,s,g) identifies the temporal scope, network depth, memory substrate, and representation granularity of a memory unit, and M t ​ [ a ] M_{t}[a] denotes the memory unit stored at address a a . The temporal coordinate τ ∈ 𝒯 t \tau\in\mathcal{T}_{t} may refer to a token, segment, or longer historical interval. The depth coordinate ℓ ∈ ℒ \ell\in\mathcal{L} identifies the layer or representational stage at which the unit is produced or maintained. The substrate coordinate s ∈ 𝒮 s\in\mathcal{S} distinguishes forms such as explicit KV, an associative state, or a structured recurrent state. The granularity coordinate g ∈ 𝒢 g\in\mathcal{G} distinguishes fine-resolution representations from coarser summaries of the same or related temporal scope.
blocks.zh: 我们用四个坐标代表持续记忆的可接受地址: At = T = T = T = T = L = S = G , Mt = { M = { m · a · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · 时间坐标\ t\ t\ t\ t\ mathcal{ T\ t} 可以指代一个符号、 段或更长的历史间隔 。 深度坐标 l QQ L\ell\in\ mathcal{L} 确定单元的生成或维护的层或代表阶段 。 底部坐标 s\\ s\in\ mathcal{S} 区分形式, 如显式 KV, 关联状态, 或结构化的重复状态 。 颗粒度坐标 g QQ G\in\ mathcal{G} 区分出精细分辨的表示和相同或相干的时间范围的相近摘要.

blocks.en: These coordinates describe an address space for memory organization rather than requiring one physically materialized Cartesian tensor. A model could instantiate only a selected set of addresses and could associate different Update and Readout rules with different substrates. The same historical interval might, for example, be represented by fine-grained token KVs, a block-level representation, or a compressed recurrent summary. Memories produced at different depths could likewise preserve information associated with different levels of representation and remain available to selected later computations.
blocks.zh: 这些坐标描述一个存储器组织的地址空间,而不是要求一个物理化的笛卡尔式收音机. 一个模型只能即时解析出一组选定的地址,并且可以将不同的更新和读取规则与不同的下层连接起来. 例如,同样的历史间隔可能由细纹符号KV、块级代表或压缩的经常性摘要来表示。 在不同深度制作的记忆同样可以保存与不同代表级别有关的信息,并可供以后选定的计算使用。

blocks.en: Such an organization allows persistent memory units to assume differentiated roles. Fine-resolution explicit representations may support precise query-dependent retrieval, while compressed summaries or recurrent states may provide broader historical coverage at lower storage or access cost. Architecture design would consequently determine not only which memory forms are present, but also where they are produced, how long they persist, and at what granularity they remain available.
blocks.zh: 这种组织允许持久的记忆单位承担不同的作用。 精细清晰的表示可能支持精确的以查询为基础的检索,而压缩摘要或经常性状态可能以较低的存储或访问成本提供更广泛的历史覆盖. 因此,建筑设计不仅将确定存在哪些内存形式,而且还将确定这些内存形式在何处产生,它们持续多久,以及它们仍然具有何种颗粒性。

blocks.en: 9.3.2 Sparse Write and Sparse Read
blocks.zh: 9.3.2 国家 Sparse 写和 Sparse 读取

blocks.en: Uniformly updating and reading every admissible memory unit would diminish the efficiency gained from differentiated memory roles. We therefore distinguish a selected write-address set 𝒲 t \mathcal{W}_{t} from the eligible memory view 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} exposed to the current query. Sparse Write can be expressed as 𝒲 t ⊆ 𝒜 t , ℳ t + = Update ρ ⁡ ( ℳ t − , x t , 𝒲 t ) , \mathcal{W}_{t}\subseteq\mathcal{A}_{t},\qquad\mathcal{M}_{t}^{+}=\operatorname{Update}_{\rho}\left(\mathcal{M}_{t}^{-},x_{t};\mathcal{W}_{t}\right), (69) where ℳ t − \mathcal{M}_{t}^{-} and ℳ t + \mathcal{M}_{t}^{+} denote the memory before and after the current update. The selected addresses may correspond to particular temporal scopes, network depths, substrates, or representation granularities. The Update rule remains specific to each selected substrate: it may append an explicit representation, modify a recurrent state, merge information into a summary, or apply a substrate-specific retention or correction rule. Sparse Write therefore controls where incoming information is maintained without requiring heterogeneous memory units to share one update mechanism.

It may contain selected units from different temporal scopes, depths, substrates, and granularities, together with the local metadata required by their Readout rules. Readout converts this eligible view into contextual information, while Integration transforms or coordinates one or more completed readouts into the module output.

(70) 这里, M^ t\ gladhat\ mathcal{M}}_{t} 表示在机制读取- write Convention 下读取路径可见的内存, Ct\mathcal{C}_{t} 是 Access 生成的符合条件的内存视图 。 它可能包含来自不同时间范围、深度、底物和颗粒地的选定单元,以及其读取规则所要求的本地元数据。 读出会将这个符合条件的视图转换为上下文信息,而集成会将一个或多个完成的读出转换或协调为模块输出.

blocks.en: Sparse Write and Sparse Read are coupled through Memory Representation. Write routing determines which memory addresses receive new information and therefore constrains what can remain available to later queries. Read routing allocates retrieval over the resulting memory organization. Writing to units that are rarely accessed wastes storage and update effort, whereas repeatedly accessing units that receive insufficient or unsuitable updates weakens retrieval quality. Their budgets and routing policies may benefit from joint coordination over the same multidimensional address space.
blocks.zh: Sparse Write和Sparse Read通过记忆代表进行组合. 写出路由决定了哪些内存地址接收了新信息,因此制约了哪些内容可以留作以后的查询. 读取路由分配在所生成的内存组织上的检索. 向很少进入的单位写作废物储存和更新工作,而反复进入接收不足或不适当的更新的单位则会削弱回收质量。 它们的预算和路线政策可能受益于在同一多层面地址空间上的联合协调。

blocks.en: 9.3.3 Stateful Routing of Memory Lifecycles
blocks.zh: 9.3.3 记忆生命周期的国有循环

blocks.en: This organization resembles a multidimensional Memory-MoE in which persistent memory units assume different functional roles and routing determines which units participate in writing and reading. The central distinction from a conventional feed-forward MoE is persistence. Conventional expert routing primarily selects the computation applied to the current representation; memory routing would additionally determine which information is retained, modified, and made available to future queries. A write-routing decision could therefore affect both the current update and the future state of the memory system.
blocks.zh: 这个组织类似于一个多维记忆-MOE,其中持续记忆单元承担不同的功能作用,而路由决定了哪些单位参与写作和阅读. 与传统的饲料推进部的主要区别在于持久性。 常规专家的路由主要选择适用于当前表示的计算;内存路由将额外确定哪些信息被保留,修改并提供给未来的查询. 因此,写出路由的决定既会影响目前的更新,也会影响内存系统的未来状态.

blocks.en: Hypothesis: Stateful Multidimensional Memory Routing A future architecture may organize persistent memory jointly across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity. Separate write and read routing would determine which memory addresses preserve incoming information and which represented units contribute to a query. Because write decisions change the information available to later computation, routing would coordinate not only current resource allocation, but also the future lifecycle of contextual memory.
blocks.zh: 假设:国家多层面 内存运行 未来的架构可能跨越时间范围、网络深度、基底类型和代表性颗粒性,共同组织持续的内存。 单独的书写和读取路由将决定哪些内存地址保存所收到信息,哪些单位为查询作出贡献。 由于写作决定会将可获得的信息更改为后期计算,路由不仅会协调当前的资源分配,还会协调背景内存的未来生命周期.

blocks.en: Such a system would introduce several coupled design questions. Memory units would require compatible interfaces across representational levels, while routing would need to balance memory occupancy, update frequency, retrieval fidelity, interference, and hardware efficiency. Persistent write decisions would also create delayed dependencies between information stored at one step and its value to later queries. Feature alignment, memory ownership, staleness control, recovery from harmful writes, load balancing, and long-horizon credit assignment would consequently become central considerations. The hypothesis would ultimately need to be evaluated by whether multidimensional memory routing improves the practical quality–efficiency frontier under matched memory, computation, and routing budgets.
blocks.zh: 这一制度将提出若干附带的设计问题。 内存单位需要跨代表级别兼容的接口,而路由则需要平衡内存占用,更新频率,检索忠诚,干扰和硬件效率. 持续的写作决定也会在一步存储的信息和它对以后查询的价值之间产生延迟的依赖关系. 因此,特征调整、内存所有权、固态控制、从有害写作中恢复、负载平衡和长期信用分配将成为中心考虑因素。 这一假设最终需要通过多层面记忆路径是否改善实际质量 — — 在匹配的记忆、计算和路径预算下的效率前沿来加以评估。

blocks.en: 9.3.4 Concrete and Testable Research Directions
blocks.zh: 9.3.4 具体和可检验的研究方向

blocks.en: Building on the hypothesis above, we outline four feasible directions that progressively expand the scope of memory control. They begin with choosing suitable representations for heterogeneous context, then separate large-scale memory construction from query-time retrieval, extend memory control to incremental lifecycle management, and finally coordinate memory and computation according to the current task state. Existing systems provide partial evidence for each step, while the proposals below identify concrete extensions that could be implemented and tested without realizing the complete multidimensional architecture at once.
blocks.zh: 基于上述假设,我们概述了逐步扩大内存控制范围的四个可行的方向。 他们首先选择适合不同上下文的表示,然后从查询-时间检索中分出大规模内存构建,将内存控制延伸到增量生命周期管理,最后根据当前任务状态协调内存和计算. 现有系统为每个步骤提供了部分证据,而以下提议确定了可以在不同时实现完整的多维架构的情况下实施和测试的具体扩展。

blocks.en: Different input regions need not share a single memory representation. Long contexts may combine large documents, code repositories, tool specifications, recent interactions, and execution logs, which differ in stability, structural hierarchy, update frequency, and required retrieval precision. Existing systems already expose parts of this design space: Qwen Sparse Attention uses compressed micro-block addresses to select original-token content, HCA and CSA combine coarser global representations with fine-grained local access, and Engram assigns stable patterns to deterministic conditional lookup rather than repeatedly reconstructing them through neural computation [ 128 , 135 , 33 , 24 ] . A concrete next step is a typed memory constructor that maps each input region to one of a small number of representations—exact, compressed, indexed, or recurrent—using observable attributes such as source type, expected stability, hierarchy, and precision requirements. A repository, for example, could retain a coarse repository summary, file- and symbol-level indexes, and exact KVs only for active code regions. Restricting the initial routing space to these representation choices under an explicit capacity budget would make the substrate and granularity coordinates directly testable.
blocks.zh: 不同的投入区域不需要共享单一的内存代表. 较长的上下文可能结合了大型文件,代码寄存器,工具规格,近期的相互作用,以及执行日志,在稳定性,结构分级,更新频率,以及要求检索精度上都有所不同. 现有系统已经暴露了这一设计空间的部分内容: Quen Sparse Content使用压缩的微块地址来选择原始的调取内容,HCA和CSA将粗体全局表示与精细的局部取用相结合,而Engram则指定了稳定的模式来决定有条件的取用,而不是通过神经计算反复地重建它们[128,135,33,24]. 下一个具体步骤是打入内存构造器,将每个输入区映射到少数表述区之一——精确、压缩、索引或经常使用源类型、预期稳定性、等级和精确性要求等可观察属性。 例如,一个存储库可以保留粗糙的存储库摘要,文件和符号级索引,并且只能为活动代码区域保留精确的KV. 将最初的路由空间限制在明确的能力预算下的这些表达选择,将使底座和颗粒坐标可以直接测试。

blocks.en: Large-scale memory construction and query-time retrieval need not use the same computation. Input-heavy workloads may provide extensive background context but require only short or incremental outputs, making uniform processing across prefill and decoding inefficient. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash offers direct evidence for this asymmetry: its Causal Encoder–Decoder activates fewer parameters during prefill than decoding and combines CSA2 cross-layer KV/index reuse with aggressive cache compression; QSA similarly lowers long-input scanning cost by compressing routing keys before selecting original-token KVs [ 34 , 135 ] . A practical extension is a multiresolution construction pipeline in which a lightweight prefill path produces summaries and routing addresses while retaining exact payloads only for precision-sensitive regions. During decoding, each query would first inspect coarse memory and escalate to finer blocks or original tokens only when the coarse readout is insufficient. This coarse-to-fine interface would make prefill cost, persistent-memory size, and retrieval precision separately controllable, extending differentiated Representation into Memory Update, Access, and Readout.
blocks.zh: 大规模内存构建和查询时间检索不需要使用相同的计算. 投入繁重的工作量可能提供广泛的背景背景,但仅需要短期或递增的产出,使整个预填和解码的统一处理效率低下。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为这种不对称提供了直接的证据:它的Causal Encoder-Decoder在预填时比解码时激活的参数要少并结合了CSA2跨层的KV/index再利用和主动的缓存压缩;QSA同样通过在选择出原键KVs之前压缩出路由键来降低长输入扫描成本[34,135]. 一个实际的延伸是多分辨率的建筑管道,其中轻量级预填道产生摘要和路由地址,同时只保留精确敏感区域的确切有效载荷。 在解码过程中,每个查询会首先检查粗细的内存,并升级为更细的块或原始的代币,只有在粗细的读出不足时才会进行. 这种从粗到细的接口将使预填成本、持久性记忆大小和检索精度可以单独控制,从而将差异化的表示扩展为内存更新、访问和读取。

blocks.en: Memory maintenance should scale with the amount of changed context rather than with total context length. A document collection may add one section, a repository may modify one function, and an execution trace may append only a few observations; rebuilding all associated memory would repeat work over unchanged content. Cross-layer systems provide initial evidence that memory artifacts can persist: IndexCache reuses retrieval indices, CSA2 defines Full, Reindex, and Reuse modes for KV and index artifacts, and YOIO/CLSA shares one routing decision across multiple downstream layers [ 10 , 34 , 150 ] . The next step is conditional lifecycle control. At each layer or context update, a lightweight controller could choose reuse , refresh , transform , or invalidate for each representation or routing artifact. Reuse could apply when hidden-state drift and candidate-set change remain small; refresh when query–index agreement falls below a threshold; transformation when an artifact must be adapted to a new representation space; and invalidation after a source-version change. For a code edit, only the modified function, its file summary, and affected index entries would be refreshed, while unrelated repository memory remains reusable. This would turn temporal scope and depth from static address labels into dynamic coordinates of memory maintenance.
blocks.zh: 内存维护应当以上下文所变化的量而不是以上下文总长度来缩放. 文件收藏可能增加一节,寄存器可能修改一功能,执行追踪可能只附加几个观察;重建所有相关的内存会重复内容不变的工作. 跨层系统提供了内存文物可以持续存在的初步证据: IndexCache再利用检索指数,CSA2定义了KV和索引文物的Full,Reindex,再使用模式,而YOIO/CLSA共享一个跨多下游地层的路由决定 [10,34,150]. 下一步是有条件的生命周期控制. 在每一层或上下文更新时,一个轻量级控制器可以选择每个表示或路由文物的再利用、刷新、变换或失效。 当隐藏状态漂移和候选设定的更改仍然很小时,可以重新使用;当查询 - 索引协议低于门槛时,可以刷新;当一件文物必须适应新的表示空间时,可以进行转换;当源版本改变后无效。 对于代码编辑,只有被修改的函数,其文件摘要和受影响的索引条目会被刷新,而无关的寄存器内存仍然可以再用. 这将使时间范围和深度从静态地址标签变为内存维护的动态坐标。

blocks.en: Memory and computation policies should ultimately adapt together to the current task state. Broad planning may favor repository- or document-level summaries, precise editing may require local exact tokens, execution may emphasize recent logs and tool outputs, and verification may require multi-source evidence. Elastic Attention and depth-adaptive Hybrid Architecture proposals already vary the allocation of attention and recurrent paths according to input or depth, while Mixture-of-Depths dynamically allocates computation under a fixed budget [ 153 , 143 , 137 ] . A tractable realization could begin with a finite menu of configurations rather than an unrestricted controller. Each configuration would specify a memory substrate, retrieval granularity, attention mode, computation-depth budget, and write-back action; a compact task-state representation would then select among them. Planning could invoke broad coarse-grained retrieval, editing fine-grained local memory, and verification multi-source Readout and Integration. The policy could first be distilled from task annotations or fixed heuristics and later optimized under memory and computation constraints. By jointly selecting how memory is represented, updated, accessed, read, and integrated, this direction provides a constrained path toward complete stateful multidimensional memory routing.
blocks.zh: 内存和计算政策最终应共同适应当前的任务状态. 广泛的规划可能有利于储存库或文件级摘要,精确编辑可能需要当地准确的符号,执行可能强调最近的日志和工具产出,核查可能需要多来源证据。 弹性注意力和深度适应混合结构提案已经根据投入或深度而改变注意力的分配和重复路径,而深度混合则在固定预算下动态地分配计算[153,143,137]. 可推进的实现可以从有限的配置菜单开始,而不是从不受限制的控制器开始. 每个配置将指定一个内存底片、检索颗粒性、注意模式、计算深度预算和回写行动;然后在其中选择紧凑的任务状态。 规划可以引用粗粗粗细的检索,编辑精细的本地内存,并验证多源读取和整合. 该政策可以先从任务说明中提炼出或固定的休克,后在内存和计算限制下得到优化. 通过共同选择内存的表达,更新,访问,读取和集成方式,这个方向提供了一条通往完整状态多维内存路径的受限路径.

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en: This survey has examined four mechanism-centered research lines—Softmax Attention, Sparse Attention, Linear Attention, and State Space Models—together with Hybrid Architecture that organizes these mechanisms within larger models. Rather than treating these lines only as alternative approaches to reducing computational complexity, we have analyzed how they balance fine-grained addressability, compressed historical coverage, memory capacity, update control, and practical computation.
blocks.zh: 这项调查研究了四条以机制为中心的研究线——Softmax Content, Sparse Content, Linear Content, 以及国家空间模型—— 与混合建筑一起,在更大的模型中组织这些机制。 我们不仅将这些线条作为减少计算复杂性的替代方法,还分析了它们如何平衡精细可处理性、压缩历史覆盖范围、内存能力、更新控制以及实际计算。

blocks.en: To provide a comparable basis for this analysis, we introduced a five-dimensional memory-centric lens: Memory Representation , Memory Update , Access , Readout , and Integration . These dimensions identify what historical information remains represented, how the represented memory changes, what becomes eligible for a query, how eligible memory is read, and how one or more completed readouts are transformed or coordinated into the module output. They are analytical roles rather than a universal computational factorization: one operation may affect several dimensions, and the chapter-level research lines remain historically and technically overlapping. Within this view, Softmax Attention reduces redundancy or historical resolution while retaining a separately addressable explicit-memory interface and normalized query–key Readout; Sparse Attention controls which explicit memory units become eligible for a query; Linear Attention develops recurrent associative states through more precise update, capacity, and temporal organization; SSMs structure compressed history through learned and input-conditioned dynamics; and Hybrid Architectures allocate complementary capabilities across layers, heads, branches, and tokens.
blocks.zh: 为了为这一分析提供可比较的基础,我们推出了一个以记忆为中心的五维镜头:记忆表现、记忆更新、访问、阅读和整合。 这些维度可以识别哪些历史信息仍然代表着什么,代表的内存是如何变化的,哪些内容成为符合查询条件的,符合条件的内存是如何被读取的,以及一个或多个完成的读取是如何被转换或协调成模块输出的. 它们是分析角色,而不是通用的计算因子化:一个操作可能影响几个维度,而分会级的研究线在历史上和技术上仍然重叠. 在此观点中,Softmax Relection减少了冗余或历史解析度,同时保留了单独可地址的显式相接器和正态查询键Readout; Sparse Reception控件,其中显式内存单位有资格进行查询; Linear Recept通过更精确的更新、能力和时间组织来开发经常性的关联状态; SSM结构通过学习和输入条件的动态来压缩历史; 混合架构在多层,头,分支和符号之间分配互补能力.

blocks.en: At the mechanism level, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain different predominant memory interfaces, but the ranges of memory functions they explicitly control increasingly overlap. Explicit-memory methods extend beyond representation and access efficiency toward bounded update, readout modulation, and output coordination. State-based methods extend beyond state representation and recurrent update toward multiple memory units, selective access, richer readout, and coordinated integration. The shared development is therefore not convergence on one memory substrate or operator, but an expansion in the scope over which memory representation, update, access, readout, and integration are jointly considered.
blocks.zh: 在机制层面,显性记忆和常态方法保留了不同的主导内存接口,但它们明确控制的内存功能范围越来越相重叠. 清晰的模拟方法超越了代表性和获取效率,转向有限度的更新、读出调制和产出协调。 基于国家的方法超越了国家代表制和经常性更新,转向多个记忆单元,有选择地访问,更丰富的读取以及协调的整合. 因此,共享开发并不是在一个内存底部或操作器上趋同,而是扩大内存表达,更新,访问,读取和整合被联合考虑的范围.

blocks.en: At the architecture level, our curated inventory of 59 release-level architecture records spanning 14 major model lineages—drawn primarily from text-centered LLMs and, where relevant, from the autoregressive language backbones of natively multimodal models—shows continued coexistence rather than a universal replacement path. Single-family GQA, MLA, and Sparse Attention backbones remain in use, while Hybrid designs increasingly combine complementary memory capabilities. Within the documented Hybrid architectures, predetermined layer-wise composition remains the principal organizational pattern. A smaller set of recent Sparse Attention systems additionally extends coordination across network depth by sharing or reusing selected KV representations, index states, or candidate decisions. This cross-layer reuse is an additional architectural attribute rather than a subtype of Hybrid composition, and the current evidence remains concentrated in a small number of architecture records.
blocks.zh: 在建筑方面,我们整理的59个发行级建筑记录清单跨越了14个主要示范线——主要取自以文字为主的LLMs,并酌情取自本土多模式模式的自递性语言主干线——显示的是继续共存,而不是一个通用的替换路径。 单家庭GQA,MLA,和Sparse Content等骨干仍在使用中,而混合设计则越来越多地结合了互补的内存能力. 在有文件记载的混合结构中,预先确定的分层构成仍然是主要的组织模式。 一套较小的Sparse Records系统通过分享或重用选定的 KV 表示、索引状态或候选人决定,将协调范围扩大到网络深度。 这种跨层再利用是一种额外的建筑属性,而不是混合构成的子类型,而目前的证据仍然集中在少数建筑记录上.

blocks.en: Taken together, the mechanism-level review and architecture-level analyses also show why attention-centered architectures should not be evaluated through asymptotic complexity alone. Explicit memories retain fine-grained addressability but incur storage and data-movement costs; sparse retrieval depends on index quality, candidate recall, and irregular execution; recurrent states face capacity, interference, and recoverability limits; and heterogeneous designs introduce placement, routing, synchronization, and kernel-design challenges. Meaningful comparison should therefore consider model quality, persistent memory, prefill and decoding cost, retrieval behavior, update stability, routing overhead, and realized hardware utilization under matched budgets and implementation conditions.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,机制一级的审查和结构一级的分析也表明,为什么不应仅仅通过不对称的复杂性来评价以注意力为中心的结构。 清晰的记忆保留了精细的可处理性,但会产生存储和数据移动费用;检索很少取决于指数质量、候选人召回和不规则的执行;经常状态面临能力、干扰和可回收性限制;以及各种设计引入了放置、路由、同步和内核设计方面的挑战。 因此,有意义的比较应考虑模型质量、持续的内存、预填和解码费用、检索行为、更新稳定性、路由管理费用以及在相应的预算和执行条件下实现硬件利用。

blocks.en: The mechanism-level and architecture-level syntheses jointly motivate a forward-looking hypothesis in which persistent contextual memory is organized across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity. Layer-wise composition makes depth a coordinate of capability placement, while emerging cross-layer reuse suggests that depth may also become a coordinate of memory- and routing-artifact persistence. Coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read would determine which memory addresses receive information and which represented units contribute to a query, thereby controlling not only current computation but also the future lifecycle of memory. This remains a design hypothesis whose value depends on whether such organization improves the practical quality–efficiency frontier without introducing prohibitive routing, optimization, memory-management, or hardware costs. The memory-centric lens developed in this survey provides a common vocabulary for relating historically distinct research lines and formulating such testable questions. Overall, efficient sequence architecture design is increasingly concerned with the joint organization, lifecycle, and selective use of contextual memory rather than the optimization of an isolated attention operator.
blocks.zh: 机制层面和架构层面的合成共同激发了一个前瞻性假设,即持久性背景记忆的组织跨越时间范围、网络深度、底物类型和代表性颗粒性。 分层组成使深度成为能力定位的坐标,而新出现的跨层再利用则表明深度也可能成为内存和通路相通持久性的坐标. 协调的Sparse Write和Sparse Read将决定哪些内存地址接收信息,哪些单位代表对查询的贡献,从而不仅控制了目前的计算,而且控制了内存的未来生命周期. 这仍然是一个设计假设,其价值取决于这种组织是否在不引入令人望而却步的路由、优化、内存管理或硬件成本的情况下提高实际质量-效率前沿。 本调查开发的以记忆为中心的透镜提供了一种共同的词汇,用于将历史上不同的研究线联系起来,并形成这样的可测试的问题. 总体而言,高效的序列架构设计越来越关注联合组织,生命周期,以及选择性地使用上下文内存,而不是优化孤立的注意力操作员.

blocks.en: Appendix A Supplementary Materials: Publicly Documented Architecture Inventory
blocks.zh: 附录A 材料:公开记录的建筑清单

blocks.en: This appendix reports the 59 release-level architecture records used in Section 8 . Release record is the unit counted in Table 17 : models released together are grouped when they share the same language-model sequence-mixing architecture, whereas separately released versions remain separate records. Model lineage identifies the broader model family used to obtain the 14-lineage count. The Attention / mixer composition column gives only the principal sequence-mixing mechanisms and, where useful, their layer ratio. A record is labeled Hybrid when its language backbone instantiates two or more distinguishable sequence-mixing or access regimes in separate layers, branches, heads, or token paths; multiple support components jointly forming a single sparse-attention candidate set do not by themselves constitute Hybrid composition. Records with insufficient architectural disclosure are marked Undisclosed and excluded from the Non-Hybrid/Hybrid percentages. Cross-layer reuse is reported separately in Table 17 and the accompanying discussion. For multimodal systems, only the autoregressive language-model backbone is classified. The inventory is purposively curated rather than exhaustive or market-share weighted.
blocks.zh: 本附录报告第8节中使用的59个发布级架构记录。 发行记录是表17所统计的单位:当模型共享相同的语言模型序列混合架构时,一起发行的模型被分组,而单独发行的版本仍然是单独的记录. 模式世系识别出用于得到14行系计数的更广泛的模式家族. 注意/搅拌器组成栏只给出了主要的相序混合机制,并在有用的情况下给出了它们的分层比. 当语言主干线将两个或两个以上可分辨的序列混合或访问系统分出不同的层、分支、头或符号路径时,记录被标记为“混合”;多个支持组件共同构成一个单一的稀有候选集本身并不构成混合构成。 建筑资料披露不充分的记录被标为未披露,并被排除在Non-Hybrid/Hybrid百分比之外。 跨层再利用在表17和所附讨论中分别报告。 对于多式系统,只有自旋式语言模型主干线才被分类. 清单是有目的的,而不是详尽无遗或市场份额加权。

blocks.zh: 表S1:第8节分析的59个公开记录的发布级别架构记录,其分系和混合标签用于得出表17。
